林洙 (梁思成第二任妻子)

description.zh-cn: 梁思成的第二任妻子。
description.en: The second wife of Liang Sicheng.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学的前身。
description.en: The predecessor of Tsinghua University.

en: Society for Research in Chinese Architecture

description.zh-cn: 北洋政府陆军部次长。
description.en: Deputy Minister of the Army of the Beiyang Government.

description.zh-cn: 北宋时期由李诫编著的一部关于建筑设计、构造与施工的官方典籍。
description.en: An official treatise on architectural design, structure, and construction compiled by Li Jie during the Northern Song Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义长女，中国共产党地下党员，在北平和平解放过程中起了重要作用。
description.en: Eldest daughter of Fu Zuoyi, an underground member of the Communist Party of China who played an important role in the peaceful liberation of Beiping.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义的秘书，真实身份是中国共产党安插在傅作义身边的地下党员。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi's secretary, who was actually an underground member of the Communist Party of China placed by his side.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义的堂弟，1957年被打成右派，在劳动教养期间死于三年大饥荒。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi's cousin, labeled a rightist in 1957 and died during the Great Famine while undergoing re-education through labor.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期由阎锡山领导的山西地方军队。
description.en: The local army of Shanxi led by Yan Xishan during the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，由国民政府在华北设立的军事指挥机构。
description.en: A military command established by the Nationalist Government in North China during the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 1936年傅作义部在绥远省抵抗伪蒙军进攻的战役。
description.en: A campaign in 1936 where Fu Zuoyi's forces resisted the invasion of the puppet Mongol army in Suiyuan province.

en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国掌管外交事务的部门。
description.en: The ministry of the Republic of China that manages foreign affairs.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部长，与宋子文签订五亿美元借款协议。
description.en: The U.S. Secretary of the Treasury who signed a $500 million loan agreement with T. V. Soong.

en: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与苏联签订的条约，由宋子文代表中方签订。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Republic of China and the Soviet Union, with T. V. Soong signing on behalf of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于上海市的医院，是宋子文的出生地。
description.en: A hospital in Shanghai, the birthplace of T. V. Soong.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主的第一任丈夫，城阳公主之子。因受兄长薛𫖮谋反牵连，被武则天杖责饿死狱中。
description.en: Princess Taiping's first husband, son of Princess Chengyang. He was implicated in his brother Xue Yi's rebellion and was caned and starved to death in prison by order of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主的第二任丈夫，武则天的堂侄。
description.en: Princess Taiping's second husband, a paternal cousin of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主与薛绍之子。
description.en: Son of Princess Taiping and Xue Shao.

description.zh-cn: 唐代女官、诗人、皇妃。武则天时期的重要政治人物，在唐隆政变中被李隆基所杀。
description.en: A female official, poet, and imperial consort during the Tang dynasty. A key political figure during Wu Zetian's reign, she was killed by Li Longji in the Tanglong Coup.

description.zh-cn: 武则天的外甥，因行为不检，逼奸太平公主的随行宫女，后被流放并于途中处死。
description.en: Wu Zetian's nephew. Due to his misconduct, including assaulting a lady-in-waiting accompanying Princess Taiping, he was exiled and subsequently executed.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，与太平公主有私交。
description.en: An official of the Tang dynasty who had an intimate relationship with Princess Taiping.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗李世民与长孙皇后之女，唐高宗的同母妹妹，薛绍的母亲。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Taizong and Empress Zhangsun, full sister of Emperor Gaozong, and mother of Xue Shao.

description.zh-cn: 汉文帝的皇后，汉景帝刘启之母。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Wen and mother of Emperor Jing (Liu Qi).

description.zh-cn: 西汉吴王，七国之乱的主要发起者。
description.en: King of Wu during the Western Han dynasty and the main instigator of the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 西汉吴王刘濞的太子，因与当时的皇太子刘启（后来的汉景帝）下棋发生争执而被其打死。
description.en: Crown Prince of Liu Pi, the King of Wu. He was killed by the then Crown Prince Liu Qi (later Emperor Jing) during a dispute over a board game.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期的军事家、将领，曾任太尉、丞相。成功平定七国之乱，后遭景帝猜忌下狱绝食而死。
description.en: A military strategist and general of the Western Han dynasty, who served as Grand Marshal and Chancellor. He successfully suppressed the Rebellion of the Seven States but was later imprisoned due to Emperor Jing's suspicion and died on a hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 西汉外戚，窦太后侄，曾参与平定七国之乱。
description.en: A relative of the imperial family by marriage in the Western Han dynasty, nephew of Empress Dowager Dou. He participated in suppressing the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝长子，母栗姬。初为太子，后被废为临江王，最终被迫自杀。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Jing, his mother was Consort Li. Initially the crown prince, he was later demoted to King of Linjiang and ultimately forced to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的妃嫔，皇长子刘荣的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Jing and the mother of his eldest son, Liu Rong.

description.zh-cn: 西汉楚王，与吴王刘濞一同发起七国之乱。
description.en: King of Chu during the Western Han dynasty, who, along with Liu Pi, King of Wu, initiated the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 西汉大臣，晁错的政敌，曾建议汉景帝诛杀晁错以平息七国之乱。
description.en: A minister of the Western Han dynasty and a political rival of Chao Cuo. He advised Emperor Jing to execute Chao Cuo to quell the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 东汉开国皇帝，汉景帝之子长沙定王刘发的后裔。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, a descendant of Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha, who was a son of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝之子，母唐姬，为东汉光武帝刘秀的祖先。
description.en: Son of Emperor Jing and Consort Tang, and an ancestor of Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu) of the Eastern Han.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝之子，母贾夫人，为三国时期蜀汉皇帝刘备的祖先。
description.en: Son of Emperor Jing and Lady Jia, and an ancestor of Liu Bei, emperor of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的妃嫔，长沙定王刘发的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Jing and the mother of Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的妃嫔，赵敬肃王刘彭祖与中山靖王刘胜的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Jing and the mother of Liu Pengzu, King Jingsu of Zhao, and Liu Sheng, King Jing of Zhongshan.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的第一位皇后，后被废黜。
description.en: The first empress of Emperor Jing, who was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄的妻子，曾当选立法委员。
description.en: Wife of Lin Yi-hsiung, formerly served as a member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄的长女，林宅血案的唯一幸存者。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Lin Yi-hsiung and the sole survivor of the Lin family massacre.

description.zh-cn: 发生于1980年2月28日的灭门血案，受害者为时任台湾省议员林义雄的母亲与双胞胎女儿，长女亦受重伤。当时林义雄因美丽岛事件而被羁押。
description.en: A familicide that occurred on February 28, 1980. The victims were the mother and twin daughters of then-Taiwan Provincial Assembly member Lin Yi-hsiung; his eldest daughter was also severely injured. Lin was in custody for the Kaohsiung Incident at the time.

description.zh-cn: 台湾党外运动重要人士，曾任台湾省议会议员。
description.en: An important figure in Taiwan's Tangwai movement, who served as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 指2000年陈水扁当选中华民国总统，实现台湾历史上首次和平的政党轮替。
description.en: Refers to the election of Chen Shui-bian as President of the Republic of China in 2000, marking the first peaceful transfer of power between political parties in Taiwan's history.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新北市贡寮区的核能发电厂，其兴建与否在台湾社会引发长期争议。
description.en: A nuclear power plant located in Gongliao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan, whose construction has been a subject of long-term controversy in Taiwanese society.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁担任中华民国总统期间的行政团队。
description.en: The executive team during Chen Shui-bian's presidency of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在将中华民国立法委员席次减半的政治改革运动。
description.en: A political reform movement aimed at halving the number of seats in the Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄为呼吁政府停止兴建龙门核能发电厂而发起的无限期绝食抗议行动。
description.en: An indefinite hunger strike initiated by Lin Yi-hsiung to urge the government to halt the construction of the Lungmen Nuclear Power Plant.

description.zh-cn: 马英九担任中华民国总统期间的行政团队。
description.en: The executive team during Ma Ying-jeou's presidency of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未的母亲。
description.en: The mother of Ai Weiwei.

description.zh-cn: 艺术家，艾未未的配偶，北京发课文化发展有限公司的法人代表。
description.en: Artist, spouse of Ai Weiwei, and the legal representative of Beijing Fake Cultural Development Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未曾在美国就读的设计学院。
description.en: A design school in the United States that Ai Weiwei attended.

zh-cn: 汶川大地震死难学生调查活动

description.zh-cn: 由艾未未发起的，旨在调查2008年汶川大地震中遇难学生名单的社会活动。
description.en: A social activity initiated by Ai Weiwei to investigate the list of student victims in the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 中国人权律师，曾作为艾未未方法人公司的代理律师处理“发课税案”。
description.en: A Chinese human rights lawyer who represented Ai Weiwei's legal entity company in the 'Fake Tax Case'.

description.zh-cn: 香港亲北京报纸，曾发文称艾未未“五毒俱全”。
description.en: A pro-Beijing newspaper in Hong Kong that published articles accusing Ai Weiwei of being thoroughly corrupt.

description.zh-cn: 香港立法会议员，曾指控艾未未的作品《透视研究：天安门》违反国安法、侮辱国家尊严。
description.en: A member of the Hong Kong Legislative Council who accused Ai Weiwei's work 'Study of Perspective: Tiananmen' of violating the National Security Law and insulting national dignity.

description.zh-cn: 香港西九文化区的视觉文化博物馆，因收藏并计划展出艾未未的争议性作品而引发政治风波，后决定不在开馆时展出相关作品。
description.en: A museum of visual culture in Hong Kong's West Kowloon Cultural District. Its collection and planned exhibition of Ai Weiwei's controversial works sparked political controversy, leading to the decision not to display them at the museum's opening.

description.zh-cn: 瑞士建筑事务所，与艾未未合作设计了北京国家体育场“鸟巢”。
description.en: A Swiss architectural firm that collaborated with Ai Weiwei on the design of the Beijing National Stadium, also known as the 'Bird's Nest'.

description.zh-cn: 2008年北京奥运会主场馆，艾未未作为艺术顾问参与了其设计过程。
description.en: The main stadium for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, for which Ai Weiwei served as the artistic consultant during its design.

en: Yang Jia's attack on Shanghai police

description.zh-cn: 杨佳持刀进入上海闸北公安分局，造成6名警员死亡的事件。艾未未质疑该案司法程序不公并制作了相关纪录片。
description.en: An incident where Yang Jia entered the Zhabei Public Security Bureau in Shanghai with a knife, resulting in the deaths of six police officers. Ai Weiwei questioned the fairness of the judicial process and produced a documentary on the case.

description.zh-cn: 因袭警案被处决的北京青年，艾未未曾为其制作纪录片，质疑司法不公。
description.en: A young man from Beijing who was executed for attacking police. Ai Weiwei made a documentary about him, questioning the fairness of the judicial process.

description.zh-cn: 上海维权人士，艾未未曾声援其返回上海的行动并制作纪录片。
description.en: A Shanghai-based human rights activist whose efforts to return to Shanghai were supported by Ai Weiwei, who also made a documentary about his case.

description.zh-cn: 丹麦玩具公司，曾因拒绝向艾未未出售积木用于政治作品而引发争议，后改变其销售政策。
description.en: A Danish toy company that sparked controversy by refusing to sell bricks to Ai Weiwei for a political artwork, later reversing its sales policy.

description.zh-cn: 维基解密创始人，艾未未曾公开抗议将其引渡至美国的司法程序。
description.en: Founder of WikiLeaks. Ai Weiwei publicly protested the legal proceedings to extradite him to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝妃嫔，皇十三子胤祥、皇十三女和硕温恪公主、皇十五女和硕敦恪公主的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Kangxi Emperor, and the birth mother of the 13th prince Yinxiang, the 13th princess Heshuo Wenke, and the 15th princess Heshuo Dunke.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥第七子，第二代怡亲王。
description.en: The seventh son of Yinxiang and the second Prince Yi.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥嫡福晋，吏部尚书玛尔汉之女。
description.en: The primary consort of Yinxiang, daughter of Marhan, the Minister of Personnel.

description.zh-cn: 正白旗满洲，官至吏部尚书，胤祥岳父。
description.en: A Manchu of the Plain White Banner who served as the Minister of Personnel. He was Yinxiang's father-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥第四女，母嫡福晋兆佳氏。雍正初年被抚养于宫中，后下嫁喀尔喀博尔济锦氏多尔济塞布腾。
description.en: The fourth daughter of Yinxiang with his primary consort Lady Zhaojia. She was raised in the palace during the early Yongzheng era and later married Dorjisebten of the Khalkha Borjigin clan.

description.zh-cn: 喀尔喀博尔济锦氏，和硕和惠公主的丈夫。
description.en: Of the Khalkha Borjigin clan, husband of Princess Heshuo Hehui.

description.zh-cn: 和硕和惠公主与多尔济塞布腾之子，胤祥外孙。
description.en: Son of Princess Heshuo Hehui and Dorjisebten, grandson of Yinxiang.

en: Prince Yi of the First Rank

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭亲王爵位，始封者为康熙帝第十三子胤祥。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty. Its first holder was Yinxiang, the 13th son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝特有的世袭罔替的王爵。胤祥是清朝第九位铁帽子王，也是首位因功绩获此恩封的亲王。
description.en: A special hereditary princely rank in the Qing dynasty that could be passed down without demotion. Yinxiang was the 9th iron-cap prince and the first to receive this honor for his merits.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第十三女，胤祥同胞妹。
description.en: The 13th daughter of the Kangxi Emperor and a full sister of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第十五女，胤祥同胞妹。
description.en: The 15th daughter of the Kangxi Emperor and a full sister of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥第四子，封宁良郡王，母为嫡福晋兆佳氏。
description.en: The fourth son of Yinxiang, granted the title Prince Ning of the Second Rank, his mother was Primary Consort Lady Zhaojia.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥庶福晋之一。
description.en: One of Yinxiang's concubines.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年名士，孙策的谋士，为孙策规划了平定江东的战略。
description.en: A famous scholar in the late Eastern Han dynasty and an advisor to Sun Ce, who devised the strategy for conquering Jiangdong.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年武将，初为刘繇部下，后归顺孙策。
description.en: A military general in the late Eastern Han dynasty, initially served under Liu Yao before surrendering to Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 孙策和孙权的重臣，受孙策临终托孤。
description.en: A key minister serving Sun Ce and Sun Quan, entrusted by Sun Ce on his deathbed to assist Sun Quan.

description.zh-cn: 东汉吴郡太守，被孙策所杀，其门客后刺杀了孙策。
description.en: The Administrator of Wu Commandery during the Eastern Han dynasty, killed by Sun Ce. His retainers later assassinated Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 桥公长女，孙策之妻。
description.en: Elder daughter of Qiao Gong, wife of Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 孙策为奠定孙吴基业而在江东地区进行的一系列军事行动。
description.en: A series of military campaigns conducted by Sun Ce in the Jiangdong region to establish the foundation of Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 泾县山贼总帅，曾袭击孙策，后被孙策收降。
description.en: A bandit leader from Jing County who once attacked Sun Ce but was later pacified and recruited by him.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年人物，大乔和小乔的父亲。
description.en: A figure in the late Eastern Han dynasty, father of Da Qiao and Xiao Qiao.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台北县（今新北市）的立法机关台北县议会的成员。
description.en: Members of the Taipei County Council, the legislative body of Taipei County (now New Taipei City), Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台北市民政局长，现任中国国民党台北市党部主委。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, former Director of the Taipei City Department of Civil Affairs, and current Chairperson of the Kuomintang's Taipei City chapter.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党于2021年发起的一项旨在团结党员、吸引失联党员回归的计划。
description.en: A program launched by the Kuomintang in 2021 aimed at uniting party members and encouraging the return of disconnected members.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，民主进步党籍，现任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, a member of the Democratic Progressive Party, and a current member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台北市副市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former Deputy Mayor of Taipei.

en: Supreme Court of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物、学者，曾任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and scholar, and a former member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，民主进步党籍，现任监察院院长，曾任高雄市市长、中华民国总统府秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Democratic Progressive Party, current President of the Control Yuan, and former Mayor of Kaohsiung and Secretary-General to the President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物、摇滚歌手，曾任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and rock singer, and a former member of the Legislative Yuan.

zh-cn: 2022年台北市第五选举区立法委员林昶佐罢免案

description.zh-cn: 针对时任立法委员林昶佐的罢免投票案，最终因投票率未达门槛而宣告失败。
description.en: A recall election held against then-Legislator Freddy Lim, which ultimately failed to pass due to insufficient voter turnout.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，民主进步党籍。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and a member of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，第41任美国总统，乔治·沃克·布什的父亲。
description.en: American politician, 41st President of the United States, and father of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史学家，南京大学历史学系教授，曾担任杨洁篪的博士导师。
description.en: Chinese historian, professor at the Department of History of Nanjing University, and was Yang Jiechi's doctoral supervisor.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部部长
en: Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部的负责人职位。
description.en: The head position of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

en: Ambassador of China to the United States

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国派驻美利坚合众国的最高级别外交使节。
description.en: The highest-ranking diplomatic representative of the People's Republic of China to the United States of America.

zh-cn: 上海外国语大学附属外国语学校

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国国务总理，被认为是直接布置暗杀宋教仁的执行者。
description.en: Then Premier of the Republic of China, considered to be the direct organizer of Song Jiaoren's assassination.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧的秘书，通过电报“毁宋酬勋”直接安排了刺杀行动。
description.en: Secretary to Zhao Bingjun, who directly arranged the assassination through the telegram 'destroy Song for a reward'.

description.zh-cn: 中华国民共进会会长，负责雇佣凶手武士英执行对宋教仁的暗杀。
description.en: President of the China National Progressive Association, responsible for hiring the assassin Wu Shiying to carry out the assassination of Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 刺杀宋教仁的直接凶手。
description.en: The direct assassin of Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 同盟会女会员及女权运动领袖，因国民党党纲中无“男女平权”而与宋教仁发生冲突。
description.en: A female member of the Tongmenghui and a leader of the women's rights movement, who clashed with Song Jiaoren over the absence of 'gender equality' in the Kuomintang's platform.

description.zh-cn: 由黄兴、宋教仁等人在长沙成立的革命团体，后并入中国同盟会。
description.en: A revolutionary group founded in Changsha by Huang Xing, Song Jiaoren, and others, which later merged into the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治制度，主张内阁由国会多数党领袖组成并对国会负责。宋教仁是其在民国初期的主要倡导者。
description.en: A political system where the cabinet is formed by the leader of the majority party in parliament and is responsible to the parliament. Song Jiaoren was its main advocate in the early Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第一届内阁，由唐绍仪组阁，宋教仁在其中担任农林总长。
description.en: The first cabinet of the Republic of China, formed by Tang Shaoyi, in which Song Jiaoren served as the Minister of Agriculture and Forestry.

description.zh-cn: 位于武昌的由美国圣公会创办的学校，宋教仁曾在此就读。
description.en: A school in Wuchang founded by the American Episcopal Church, where Song Jiaoren studied.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁遇刺的地点。
description.en: The location where Song Jiaoren was assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 华兴会共同创始人之一。
description.en: One of the co-founders of the Huaxinghui.

description.zh-cn: 华兴会共同创始人之一，革命宣传家。
description.en: One of the co-founders of the Huaxinghui and a revolutionary propagandist.

description.zh-cn: 清末新军第六镇统制，革命党人，后被袁世凯派人刺杀。
description.en: Commander of the 6th Division of the New Army in the late Qing Dynasty, a revolutionary, who was later assassinated by order of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 民主革命家，公开斥责袁世凯刺杀宋教仁后，被毒杀于宴席上。
description.en: A democratic revolutionary who was poisoned at a banquet after publicly denouncing Yuan Shikai for assassinating Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 北洋政府时期的军事执法机构，其侦探刺杀了应桂馨。
description.en: A military law enforcement agency during the Beiyang Government period, whose detectives assassinated Ying Guixin.

description.zh-cn: 香港的一所女子中学。
description.en: A girls' secondary school in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 一份在香港出版的中文报纸。
description.en: A Chinese newspaper published in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港的图书出版公司。
description.en: A book publishing company in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 由蔡边村自编自导的纪录片，记录了他寻找20多年未见的生母亦舒的经历。
description.en: A documentary written and directed by Tsai Bian-cun, documenting his search for his birth mother, Yi Shu, whom he had not seen for over 20 years.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议湖南省委员会

description.zh-cn: 在孟加拉管辖区扩大鸦片种植，并通过私人商人向中国走私鸦片，是鸦片贸易的主要推动者之一。
description.en: Expanded opium cultivation in the Bengal Presidency and smuggled it into China via private merchants, being one of the main drivers of the opium trade.

description.zh-cn: 第二次鸦片战争期间，1858年清政府与英、法、美、俄等国在天津签订了一系列不平等条约。这些条约内容包括增开通商口岸、鸦片贸易合法化及战争赔款。其中《天津条约》的换约问题，成为战争扩大的直接原因。
description.en: During the Second Opium War, a series of unequal treaties were signed by the Qing government, notably in Tianjin in 1858 with countries including Britain, France, the US, and Russia. Their terms included opening more treaty ports, legalizing the opium trade, and paying war indemnities. The issue of the ratification of the Treaty of Tianjin specifically became a direct cause for the escalation of the war.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的半岛。根据《北京条约》，界限街以南的部分被割让给英国。
description.en: A peninsula in Hong Kong. The portion south of Boundary Street was ceded to the United Kingdom under the Convention of Peking.

description.zh-cn: 根据《北京条约》等条约割让给俄国的地区。
description.en: A region ceded to Russia under treaties including the Convention of Peking.

description.zh-cn: 指在19世纪至20世纪初，中国（以及日本、朝鲜等）与西方列强签订的一系列权利不对等的条约。鸦片战争后签订的《南京条约》、《天津条约》和《北京条约》均属此类。
description.en: Refers to a series of treaties signed in the 19th and early 20th centuries between China (as well as Japan, Korea, etc.) and Western powers, in which rights were not reciprocal. The treaties of Nanking, Tientsin, and Peking after the Opium Wars are examples.

description.zh-cn: 一个历史名词，指中国从第一次鸦片战争到中华人民共和国成立期间，遭受西方列强、俄国和日本侵略、干涉、瓜分的历史时期。鸦片战争及其后签订的不平等条约被视为这一时期的开端。
description.en: A historical term referring to the period of intervention and subjugation of the Chinese nation by Western powers, Russia and Japan from the First Opium War to the establishment of the People's Republic of China. The Opium Wars and the subsequent unequal treaties are considered the beginning of this period.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，时任两广总督。其处理“亚罗号事件”的方式成为第二次鸦片战争的导火索。在战争初期，因对英法态度强硬，广州城破后被俘，最终绝食死于印度加尔各答。
description.en: A Qing official serving as the Viceroy of Liangguang. His handling of the Arrow Incident became the trigger for the Second Opium War. Due to his hardline stance against Britain and France in the early stages of the war, he was captured after the fall of Guangzhou and died on a hunger strike in Calcutta, India.

description.zh-cn: 1856年10月8日，广东水师登上在香港注册的亚罗号船搜捕海盗，成为英国发动战争的导火索。
description.en: On October 8, 1856, the Guangdong navy boarded the Hong Kong-registered ship Arrow to search for pirates, which became the casus belli for Britain to start the war.

description.zh-cn: 1856年2月，法国籍神父马赖因违禁深入中国内地传教，被广西西林代理知县张鸣凤所捕杀，成为法国发动战争的导火索。
description.en: In February 1856, French priest Auguste Chapdelaine was arrested and executed by the acting magistrate of Xilin, Guangxi, for illegally entering inland China to preach, becoming the casus belli for France to join the war.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年蒙古族将领，在第二次鸦片战争中负责京津地区的防务，指挥了大沽口和八里桥等重要战役。
description.en: A Mongol general of the late Qing dynasty who was responsible for the defense of the Beijing-Tianjin area during the Second Opium War, commanding key battles such as Taku Forts and Baliqiao.

zh-cn: 詹姆斯·布鲁斯，第八代额尔金伯爵

description.zh-cn: 英国全权专使，第二次鸦片战争期间的英方主要代表。为报复清军虐待俘虏，下令焚毁圆明园。
description.en: British High Commissioner and Plenipotentiary, the main British representative during the Second Opium War. He ordered the burning of the Old Summer Palace in retaliation for the torture and death of captives by Qing forces.

description.zh-cn: 法国特命全权专使，第二次鸦片战争期间的法方主要代表。
description.en: French special envoy and plenipotentiary, the main French representative during the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 英国外交官，时任英国驻广州领事，处理亚罗号事件。在通州谈判期间被僧格林沁俘虏并遭受虐待。
description.en: A British diplomat, then British consul in Guangzhou, who handled the Arrow Incident. He was captured and tortured by Sengge Rinchen's forces during the Tongzhou negotiations.

en: Burning of the Old Summer Palace

description.zh-cn: 1860年10月，英法联军在北京郊区对圆明园进行抢劫后，英国专使额尔金下令将其焚毁，以报复清军虐待战俘的行为。
description.en: In October 1860, after looting the Old Summer Palace in the suburbs of Beijing, British High Commissioner Lord Elgin ordered it to be burned down as retaliation for the torture of prisoners of war by Qing forces.

description.zh-cn: 1860年9月21日英法联军与清军主力在北京通州八里桥进行的决战。清军惨败，京师门户洞开。
description.en: The decisive battle between the Anglo-French forces and the main Qing army at Baliqiao, Tongzhou, Beijing, on September 21, 1860. The Qing army was disastrously defeated, leaving the capital exposed.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国东西伯利亚总督穆拉维约夫以武力胁迫清朝黑龙江将军奕山签订的不平等条约，割让黑龙江以北、外兴安岭以南约60万平方公里领土给俄国。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed under military duress by Nikolay Muravyov, Governor-General of Eastern Siberia, and Yishan, the Qing General of Heilongjiang, ceding about 600,000 square kilometers of territory north of the Amur River and south of the Stanovoy Range to Russia.

zh-cn: 动员戡乱时期临时条款
en: Temporary Provisions Effective During the Period of Communist Rebellion

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府为应对国共内战而制定的宪法附加条款，赋予总统紧急权力。
description.en: Additional constitutional articles enacted by the ROC government in response to the Chinese Civil War, granting emergency powers to the president.

en: Encirclement Campaigns against the Central Soviet Area

description.zh-cn: 第一次国共内战期间，国民政府对中共在南方的根据地发动的五次大规模军事围剿。
description.en: Five large-scale military encirclement campaigns launched by the Nationalist Government against the CCP's southern base areas during the First Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 指2024年台湾第十一届立法院中，由在野的中国国民党与台湾民众党联合提出的国会职权修法所引发的一系列政治争议。
description.en: Refers to a series of political controversies in Taiwan in 2024 surrounding amendments to the powers of the Legislative Yuan, jointly proposed by the opposition parties Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP) in the 11th Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾企业家，联华电子创办人。他成立了“反共护台志工联盟”，是推动罢免泛蓝阵营公职人员的主要人物之一。
description.en: Taiwanese entrepreneur and founder of UMC. He established the 'Anti-Communist and Defend Taiwan Volunteer Alliance' and was a key figure in promoting the recall of Pan-Blue camp public officials.

description.zh-cn: 时任新竹市市长，原为台湾民众党籍，后退党。她在大罢免运动中成为罢免对象。
description.en: The incumbent Mayor of Hsinchu City, formerly a member of the Taiwan People's Party before withdrawing. She became a target of recall during the Great Recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党籍南投县议员，为大罢免运动中少数被推进入投票阶段的泛绿阵营公职人员。
description.en: A DPP member of the Nantou County Council, she was one of the few Pan-Green camp public officials whose recall case proceeded to the voting stage during the Great Recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 指赖清德担任中华民国总统期间的行政团队。大罢免的失败被视为对其执政的不信任投票。
description.en: Refers to the executive team during Lai Ching-te's presidency of the Republic of China. The failure of the Great Recall was seen as a vote of no confidence in his administration.

description.zh-cn: 指萨摩、长州、土佐、肥前四个在倒幕运动和明治维新中起主导作用的强藩。
description.en: Refers to the four powerful domains of Satsuma, Chōshū, Tosa, and Hizen, which played a leading role in the anti-shogunate movement and the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治维新初期的政治家，维新三杰之一。早期是新政府的核心人物，后因不满改革而发动西南战争。
description.en: A Japanese politician in the early Meiji period, one of the Three Great Nobles of the Restoration. He was a central figure in the new government but later led the Satsuma Rebellion out of dissatisfaction with the reforms.

description.zh-cn: 由西乡隆盛领导的萨摩士族反对明治政府的叛乱，是最后也是最大规模的士族反乱，也是日本最后一场内战。
description.en: A rebellion of disaffected samurai in Satsuma against the Meiji government, led by Saigō Takamori. It was the last and most serious of the shizoku rebellions, and the last civil war in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 明治政府用县取代旧有的藩，是中央集权化的关键一步。
description.en: The Meiji government's policy of replacing the feudal domains (han) with prefectures, a key step in centralization.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉发表于《时事新报》的著名社论，主张日本应脱离亚洲邻国，与西方文明国家共进退。这一思想对明治政府的外交政策产生了深远影响。
description.en: A famous editorial by Fukuzawa Yukichi, published in 'Jiji Shinpō', advocated that Japan should break from its Asian neighbors and align with Western civilized nations. This idea had a profound impact on the Meiji government's foreign policy.

birth_place.zh-cn: 日本摄津国大坂堂岛新地五丁目中津藩藏屋敷
birth_place.en: Nakatsu Domain Kurayashiki, Dōjima-shinchi 5-chome, Ōsaka, Settsu Province, Japan

death_place.zh-cn: 日本东京府东京市芝区三田二丁目
death_place.en: 2-chōme, Mita, Shiba-ku, Tokyo City, Tokyo Prefecture, Japan

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期重要的启蒙思想家、教育家，庆应义塾大学创立者，对明治维新运动影响深远。他提出了著名的《脱亚论》，并被誉为“日本近代教育之父”。
description.en: A prominent Japanese enlightenment thinker and educator of the Meiji era, as well as an author, writer, teacher, translator, entrepreneur, and journalist. He founded Keio University, was an early advocate for reform in Japan, and proposed the famous 'Datsu-A Ron' (Leaving Asia). He is regarded as one of the founders of modern Japan and is often called 'the father of modern Japanese education'.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末的政治家与军事家，曾担任咸临丸的指挥官，并在江户无血开城中扮演了关键角色。
description.en: A Japanese statesman and naval engineer during the late Edo period. He served as the commander of the Kanrin Maru and played a key role in the bloodless surrender of Edo.

description.zh-cn: 明治政府于1871年至1873年间派遣至美国和欧洲的大型外交使团，旨在考察西方制度与技术，为日本的现代化建设提供蓝图。大久保利通是其主要成员之一。
description.en: A large Japanese diplomatic mission sent by the Meiji government to the United States and Europe between 1871 and 1873, aimed at studying Western institutions and technology to provide a blueprint for Japan's modernization. Ōkubo Toshimichi was one of its key members.

zh-cn: 苏联共产党第二十次代表大会
en: 20th Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏联共产党的一次重要代表大会，赫鲁晓夫在此次会议上发表了批判斯大林的“秘密报告”。
description.en: A significant congress of the CPSU where Khrushchev delivered his "Secret Speech" criticizing Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫提出的苏联外交政策，主张与资本主义国家“和平共处、和平竞赛、和平过渡”。
description.en: A Soviet foreign policy proposed by Khrushchev, advocating for "peaceful coexistence, peaceful competition, and peaceful transition" with capitalist countries.

zh-cn: 苏联共产党第二十二次代表大会
en: 22nd Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏联共产党的一次代表大会，会上苏共公开批判阿尔巴尼亚劳动党，并决定将斯大林遗体移出列宁墓。
description.en: A congress of the CPSU where the party openly criticized the Party of Labour of Albania and decided to remove Stalin's body from Lenin's Mausoleum.

description.zh-cn: 中苏交恶期间，中华人民共和国与苏联在两国边境发生的一系列军事对峙和武装冲突。
description.en: A series of military standoffs and armed clashes between the People's Republic of China and the Soviet Union along their shared border during the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 1969年3月发生于乌苏里江珍宝岛的中苏大规模武装冲突，是中苏边界冲突中最著名的事件。
description.en: A large-scale armed conflict between China and the Soviet Union on Zhenbao Island in the Ussuri River in March 1969, the most famous incident in the Sino-Soviet border conflict.

description.zh-cn: 1971年7月，时任美国国家安全顾问基辛格秘密访问中国，为尼克松访华铺平了道路。
description.en: In July 1971, then-U.S. National Security Advisor Henry Kissinger secretly visited China, paving the way for Nixon's visit.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东于1970年代提出的外交战略构想，主张联合美国、日本、西欧等国家，形成一条线，共同对付苏联的扩张。
description.en: A foreign policy strategy conceived by Mao Zedong in the 1970s, advocating for a united front including the United States, Japan, and Western Europe to form a line against Soviet expansionism.

description.zh-cn: 中国第一个核武器研制计划的代号。
description.en: The codename for China's first nuclear weapons development program.

description.zh-cn: 与赫鲁晓夫相关的去斯大林化政策以及和平共处理论。
description.en: The policies of de-Stalinization and the theory of peaceful coexistence associated with Khrushchev.

description.zh-cn: 1969年8月13日中苏在新疆铁列克提地区发生的边境武装冲突。
description.en: A border armed conflict between China and the Soviet Union in the Tieleketi region of Xinjiang on August 13, 1969.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月，时任苏共中央总书记戈尔ба乔夫访问中国，标志着中苏关系正常化。
description.en: In May 1989, then-General Secretary of the CPSU Gorbachev visited China, marking the normalization of Sino-Soviet relations.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家、记者，时任中国作家协会副主席。他因其支持民主改革的言论对学生产生影响，并在“反对资产阶级自由化”运动中被开除党籍。
description.en: A Chinese writer and journalist, then-Vice Chairman of the Chinese Writers Association. He influenced students with his pro-democratic reform views and was expelled from the party during the 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign'.

description.zh-cn: 对公职人员的任职期限进行限制的制度。
description.en: A system that limits the term of office for public officials.

description.zh-cn: 关于公职人员达到一定年龄或服务年限后退出工作岗位的制度安排。
description.en: Institutional arrangements for public officials to withdraw from their work positions after reaching a certain age or length of service.

description.zh-cn: 始于1980年代中国的旨在改革政治结构和制度的运动。
description.en: A movement that began in the 1980s in China aimed at reforming the political structure and system.

description.zh-cn: 结束日俄战争的和平条约，在美国总统西奥多·罗斯福的斡旋下签订。
description.en: The peace treaty that formally ended the Russo-Japanese War, signed under the mediation of U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt.

description.zh-cn: 美国第26任总统。他曾在日俄战争末期斡旋双方签订《朴茨茅斯条约》。在1912年总统选举中作为进步党候选人参选，导致共和党选票分裂。他强烈批评威尔逊的战时政策。
description.en: The 26th President of the United States. He mediated the signing of the Treaty of Portsmouth at the end of the Russo-Japanese War. He ran as a Progressive Party candidate in the 1912 presidential election, splitting the Republican vote. He was a strong critic of Wilson's wartime policies.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争的失败直接引发了俄国国内的政治动荡和革命。
description.en: The defeat in the Russo-Japanese War was a direct catalyst for political unrest and revolution within Russia.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争期间俄罗斯帝国的沙皇。
description.en: The Tsar of the Russian Empire during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争中的决定性海战，日本联合舰队在此役中几乎全歼俄国第二太平洋舰队。
description.en: The decisive naval battle of the Russo-Japanese War, in which the Japanese Combined Fleet almost completely annihilated the Russian Second Pacific Squadron.

description.zh-cn: 日本在日俄战争胜利后与大韩帝国签订的条约，使韩国成为日本的保护国。
description.en: A treaty signed between Japan and the Korean Empire after Japan's victory in the Russo-Japanese War, making Korea a protectorate of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄罗斯的盟友，在日俄战争爆发时向日本宣战。
description.en: As an ally of Russia, it declared war on Japan at the outbreak of the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 日本与英国于1902年结成的军事同盟，为日本挑战俄国提供了外交支持。
description.en: A military alliance formed between Japan and Great Britain in 1902, which provided diplomatic support for Japan to challenge Russia.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争中规模最大的一场陆战，日军占领奉天，俄军战败撤退。
description.en: The largest land battle of the Russo-Japanese War, resulting in the Japanese capture of Mukden and the retreat of Russian forces.

zh-cn: 2022年贵州省三都县客车侧翻事故

description.zh-cn: 2022年9月18日，一辆载有隔离转运人员的客车在中国贵州省发生侧翻，造成27人死亡的重大事故。
description.en: On September 18, 2022, a bus carrying individuals for quarantine transfer overturned in Guizhou Province, China, causing a major accident with 27 fatalities.

description.zh-cn: 一种应对2019冠状病毒病疫情的公共卫生策略，旨在将病毒视为地方性流行病，并逐步恢复社会正常活动，而不是试图完全消灭病毒。
description.en: A public health strategy for managing the COVID-19 pandemic that aims to treat the virus as an endemic disease and gradually resume normal societal activities rather than attempting to completely eliminate the virus.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官，曾任中华人民共和国外交部发言人。
description.en: Chinese diplomat who served as a spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 由中共中央派出，对地方和中央单位进行巡视监督的临时性机构。
description.en: Temporary bodies dispatched by the CCP Central Committee to conduct inspection and supervision of local and central units.

description.zh-cn: 义和团运动后，清政府与十一国签订的不平等条约，内容包括巨额赔款（庚子赔款）、允许外国驻军等。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed between the Qing government and eleven nations after the Boxer Rebellion, which included massive indemnities (the Boxer Indemnity) and the stationing of foreign troops.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，端郡王。因其子溥儁被立为大阿哥（己亥建储）遭外国公使反对而极度仇外，是操纵义和团运动的清廷主战派首脑之一。
description.en: A prince of the Qing imperial family, Prince Duan. He became intensely anti-foreign after foreign ministers opposed the appointment of his son, Pujun, as the heir apparent (the Jihai Establishment). He was one of the main leaders of the pro-war faction at court that manipulated the Boxer movement.

description.zh-cn: 晚清大臣，主战派核心人物。他向慈禧太后力言义和团“神术可用”，推动清廷利用义和团对抗列强。
description.en: A high-ranking official in the late Qing dynasty and a core member of the pro-war faction. He convinced Empress Dowager Cixi that the Boxers' 'divine skills' could be relied upon, pushing the court to use the Boxers to confront the foreign powers.

description.zh-cn: 晚清官员，曾任山东巡抚、山西巡抚。在山东任上，他将“义和拳”改名为“义和团”，并采取纵容政策，助长了运动的兴起。调任山西后，策动并纵容了针对传教士和平民的大屠杀。
description.en: A late Qing official who served as Governor of Shandong and Shanxi. In Shandong, he renamed the 'Boxer Fists' to 'Boxer United in Righteousness' (Yihetuan) and adopted a policy of appeasement, fueling the movement's rise. After being transferred to Shanxi, he orchestrated and condoned massacres of missionaries and civilians.

description.zh-cn: 德国驻华公使。他在北京街头被清军神机营军官恩海射杀，此事件成为八国联军发动大规模军事行动的直接导火索之一。
description.en: The German envoy to China. He was shot and killed on a Beijing street by En Hai, an officer of the Qing Manchu Banner Corps. This incident became one of the direct triggers for the large-scale military intervention by the Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 清军神机营霆字枪队章京，在北京街头射杀了德国公使克林德。
description.en: An officer of the Qing Manchu Banner Corps (Shenjiying) who shot and killed the German minister Clemens von Ketteler on a Beijing street.

description.zh-cn: 晚清大臣，主和派官员，庚子被祸五大臣之一。因反对清廷对外宣战和利用义和团而被慈禧太后处死。
description.en: A late Qing official and a member of the pro-peace faction, one of the 'Five Ministers Executed in 1900'. He was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi for opposing the declaration of war and the use of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 晚清大臣，主和派官员，庚子被祸五大臣之一。因反对清廷对外宣战和利用义和团而被慈禧太后处死。
description.en: A late Qing official and a member of the pro-peace faction, one of the 'Five Ministers Executed in 1900'. He was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi for opposing the declaration of war and the use of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，湘军重要将领，曾任两江总督。他是“东南互保”的主要策划者之一，拒绝执行清廷的宣战命令。
description.en: A prominent and influential official in the late Qing dynasty, an important general of the Xiang Army, and former Viceroy of Liangjiang. He was a key architect of the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China', refusing to carry out the imperial court's declaration of war.

description.zh-cn: 晚清将领，甘军首领。他率领的甘军是围攻北京外国使馆和抵抗八国联军的主力部队之一。
description.en: A late Qing general and leader of the Kansu Braves. His troops were one of the main forces besieging the foreign legations in Beijing and resisting the Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 英国海军中将，领导了八国联军的第一次远征（西摩尔远征），试图从天津进军北京解救被围的使馆区，但被义和团和清军击退。
description.en: A British Royal Navy admiral who led the first expedition of the Eight-Nation Alliance (the Seymour Expedition) in an attempt to relieve the besieged legations in Beijing from Tianjin, but was repulsed by Boxers and Qing troops.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军为镇压义和团运动而发动的军事入侵。联军先后攻占大沽炮台、天津和北京，最终迫使清政府签订《辛丑条约》。
description.en: A military invasion launched by the Eight-Nation Alliance to suppress the Boxer Rebellion. The coalition forces captured the Taku Forts, Tianjin, and Beijing, ultimately forcing the Qing government to sign the Boxer Protocol.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后试图废黜光绪皇帝，立端郡王载漪之子溥儁为大阿哥（皇储）的政治事件。因遭各国公使反对而未成功，加深了慈禧及主战派对外国的仇视。
description.en: A political event where Empress Dowager Cixi attempted to depose the Guangxu Emperor and install Pujun, son of Prince Duan (Zaiyi), as the heir apparent. The plan failed due to opposition from foreign ministers, which deepened the hostility of Cixi and the pro-war faction towards foreigners.

description.zh-cn: 1928年北伐期间，国民革命军在济南与日本军队发生的武装冲突，导致中方人员重大伤亡。
description.en: An armed conflict between the National Revolutionary Army and Japanese troops in Jinan during the Northern Expedition in 1928, resulting in significant Chinese casualties.

description.zh-cn: 1927年8月，国民革命军在南京龙潭地区击败孙传芳军队的一次关键性战役。
description.en: A decisive battle in August 1927 where the National Revolutionary Army defeated Sun Chuanfang's forces in the Longtan area of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院总理周恩来的逝世事件。
中国人民解放军少将，时任北京卫戍区司令员。
中华人民共和国武装力量的组成部分，是不脱离生产的群众武装组织。
四五天安门事件的前奏，南京市民和学生为悼念周恩来、抗议《文汇报》而发起的游行示威活动。
上海市的一家综合性日报。在文革后期受“四人帮”控制。
一部讲述南京大屠杀期间通过照片胶卷揭露日军暴行的电影。中国网民借用该电影主题，将江油事件代称为“江油照相馆”，以讽刺政府暴力执法和信息封锁。
description.en: A film about exposing Japanese atrocities during the Nanjing Massacre through photographic film. Chinese netizens used the film's theme to coin the term 'Jiangyou Photo Studio' for the Jiangyou incident, satirizing the government's violent enforcement and information blockade.

description.zh-cn: 在四川成都举办的国际体育赛事。江油事件发生在该运动会开幕前夕，给地方官员带来了维持稳定的巨大政治压力，可能影响了他们对事件的处理方式。
description.en: An international sports event held in Chengdu, Sichuan. The Jiangyou incident occurred just before its opening, placing immense political pressure on local officials to maintain stability, which likely influenced their handling of the situation.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed in China. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed by Baidu. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed in China. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed in China. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 威京总部集团主席，京华城案核心人物之一，被控为获取不当容积率而行贿官员。
description.en: Chairman of the Core Pacific Group, a central figure in the Core Pacific City case, accused of bribing officials to obtain improper floor area ratio.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党籍台北市议员，被控在京华城案中收受贿赂，为威京集团游说市府官员。
description.en: Kuomintang (KMT) Taipei City Councilor, accused of accepting bribes in the Core Pacific City case to lobby city government officials on behalf of the Core Pacific Group.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲市府时期的台北市长办公室主任，因京华城案被控违背职务收受贿赂罪。
description.en: Director of the Taipei City Mayor's Office during Ko Wen-je's administration, accused of accepting bribes against his duties in the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 前台北市政府兵役局局长，后任威京集团子公司董事长，在京华城案中承认行贿。
description.en: Former Director of the Taipei City Government's Department of Military Service, later became the chairman of a Core Pacific Group subsidiary. He admitted to bribery in the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 民进党籍台北市议员，在议会对柯文哲市府给予京华城高容积率提出质疑。
description.en: Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei City Councilor who questioned the Ko Wen-je administration's granting of a high floor area ratio to Core Pacific City in the city council.

description.zh-cn: 民进党籍政治人物，曾任台北市议员，早期曾指控官员图利京华城。
description.en: Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) politician and former Taipei City Councilor who had previously accused officials of improperly benefiting Core Pacific City.

description.zh-cn: 前台北市副市长，以证人身份表示在任内反对京华城增加容积率。
description.en: Former Deputy Mayor of Taipei, who testified as a witness that he opposed increasing the floor area ratio for Core Pacific City during his tenure.

description.zh-cn: 审理京华城案的法院，曾裁定羁押及交保多名被告。
description.en: The court responsible for trying the Core Pacific City case, which has made rulings on the detention and bail of several defendants.

description.zh-cn: 位于台北市松山区的已停业购物中心，其改建为京华广场的过程引发了容积率争议。
description.en: A defunct shopping mall located in Songshan District, Taipei. Its redevelopment into Core Pacific Plaza sparked the floor area ratio controversy.

description.zh-cn: 台湾关于都市更新的法律。京华城改建案被指违法引用此条例以获取容积奖励，因其并非都市更新案。
description.en: A Taiwanese law concerning urban regeneration. The Core Pacific City redevelopment project was accused of illegally citing this act to obtain floor area ratio bonuses, as it was not an urban renewal case.

description.zh-cn: 西魏和北周的将领，隋文帝杨坚的父亲，被追尊为隋武元帝。
description.en: A general of the Western Wei and Northern Zhou dynasties, father of Emperor Wen of Sui (Yang Jian), posthumously honored as Emperor Wuyuan of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚的母亲，被追尊为元明皇后。
description.en: Mother of Emperor Wen of Sui (Yang Jian), posthumously honored as Empress Yuanming.

description.zh-cn: 中国南北朝时期的北朝之一，最后被杨坚篡位，建立隋朝。
description.en: One of the Northern dynasties during the Northern and Southern dynasties period in China, which was eventually usurped by Yang Jian, who established the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北周最后一位皇帝，被迫禅位于杨坚。
description.en: The last emperor of the Northern Zhou dynasty, who was forced to abdicate the throne to Yang Jian.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚的长子，原为太子，后被废黜。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Wen of Sui, originally the crown prince, he was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 中国南北朝时期的南朝最后一个朝代，被隋文帝所灭。
description.en: The last of the Southern Dynasties during the Northern and Southern dynasties period in China, conquered by Emperor Wen of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 中国南北朝时期存在于江陵地区的一个割据政权，后被隋文帝所废。
description.en: A small state that existed in the Jiangling area during the Northern and Southern dynasties period, which was later abolished by Emperor Wen of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝在位期间开皇年号下出现的政治稳定、社会经济繁荣的时期。
description.en: A period of political stability and socioeconomic prosperity during the Kaihuang era of Emperor Wen of Sui's reign.

description.zh-cn: 北周末年官员，与郑译等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政。
description.en: An official in the late Northern Zhou dynasty who, along with Zheng Yi and others, forged an edict to support Yang Jian as regent.

description.zh-cn: 北周末年官员，与刘昉等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政。
description.en: An official in the late Northern Zhou dynasty who, along with Liu Fang and others, forged an edict to support Yang Jian as regent.

description.zh-cn: 北周将领，杨坚专政后起兵反对，兵败自杀。
description.en: A Northern Zhou general who launched a rebellion against Yang Jian after he took power, but was defeated and committed suicide.

description.zh-cn: 北周赵王，宇文泰之子。曾试图谋杀杨坚未遂，后被杨坚诛杀。
description.en: Prince of Zhao of Northern Zhou, son of Yuwen Tai. He attempted to assassinate Yang Jian but failed, and was later executed by Yang Jian.

description.zh-cn: 北周齐王，曾向北周武帝警示杨坚相貌非常，应尽早除掉。
description.en: Prince of Qi of Northern Zhou, who warned Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou that Yang Jian had an extraordinary appearance and should be eliminated early.

zh-cn: 隋仁寿宫唐九成宫遗址

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚的逝世地。
description.en: The place of death of Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的儿子。
description.en: Son of Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的儿子。
description.en: Son of Luo Ruiqing.

en: State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of the People's Republic of China.

en: Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的公安主管机关，后改组为中华人民共和国公安部。
description.en: The public security authority in the early days of the People's Republic of China, later reorganized into the Ministry of Public Security of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命前夕，时任解放军总参谋长罗瑞卿被林彪等人指控“反党篡军”而遭批判、撤职的政治事件。
description.en: A political incident on the eve of the Cultural Revolution, where the then PLA Chief of General Staff Luo Ruiqing was accused by Lin Biao and others of 'opposing the Party and usurping the army,' leading to his criticism and dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的高级领导人，曾任中共中央军委工作人员。
description.en: A senior leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who once worked for the CPC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在此次会议上，罗瑞卿受到批判，是“罗瑞卿事件”的关键环节。
description.en: At this conference, Luo Ruiqing was criticized, which was a key part of the 'Luo Ruiqing Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的出生地，位于四川省。
description.en: The birthplace of Luo Ruiqing, located in Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的逝世地，位于西德巴登-符腾堡州。
description.en: The place of death of Luo Ruiqing, located in Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg, West Germany.

description.zh-cn: 晚清主张引进、仿造西方的科学技术，以“自强”、“求富”为口号，来维护清朝统治的官僚集团。
description.en: A bureaucratic faction in the late Qing dynasty that advocated for the introduction and imitation of Western science and technology under the slogans of 'self-strengthening' and 'seeking wealth' to maintain Qing rule.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期的一个政治派别，以敢于弹劾权贵、作风清廉、言辞激烈著称。
description.en: A political faction in the late Qing dynasty known for its integrity, sharp criticism, and daring to impeach powerful officials.

description.zh-cn: 晚清维新派人士，自立军起义的领导者。
description.en: A reformist in the late Qing dynasty and leader of the Self-Supporting Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期的一位军事将领，因在中法战争中取得镇南关大捷而闻名。
description.en: A military general in the late Qing dynasty, famous for the victory at the Battle of Zhennan Pass during the Sino-French War.

description.zh-cn: 中法战争期间，清军在广西镇南关（今友谊关）一带击败法军的一场关键战役。
description.en: A key battle during the Sino-French War where Qing forces defeated the French army near Zhennan Pass (now Youyi Guan) in Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 由张之洞撰写，系统阐述其“中学为体，西学为用”思想的著作。
description.en: A work written by Zhang Zhidong that systematically elaborates his idea of 'Chinese learning as the essence, Western learning for practical use'.

description.zh-cn: 清末由同盟会发动，在湖南、江西边界的萍乡、浏阳、醴陵地区爆发的武装起义。
description.en: An armed uprising launched by the Tongmenghui in the late Qing dynasty in the Pingxiang, Liuyang, and Liling areas on the border of Hunan and Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞的从兄，清朝大臣。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong's cousin and an official of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞的长子。
description.en: Eldest son of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞的幼子。
description.en: Youngest son of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，戊戌六君子之一，张之洞的弟子。
description.en: An official in the late Qing dynasty, one of the Six Gentlemen of the Hundred Days' Reform, and a disciple of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清末怪杰，精通多种语言，曾任张之洞幕僚。
description.en: An eccentric scholar in the late Qing dynasty, proficient in multiple languages, who served as an aide to Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清代古琴家，曾为张之洞的古琴老师。
description.en: A guqin master of the Qing dynasty who taught Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在湖北和湖南地区的最高军政长官职位。
description.en: The highest-ranking civil and military position in the Huguang (Hubei and Hunan) region during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 美国前第一夫人，乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什的妻子，乔治·沃克·布什的母亲。
description.en: Former First Lady of the United States, wife of George H. W. Bush and mother of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，曾任佛罗里达州州长，乔治·沃克·布什的弟弟。
description.en: American politician, former Governor of Florida, and younger brother of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任副总统。
description.en: American politician who served as Vice President during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在2000年美国总统选举中作为民主党候选人与乔治·沃克·布什竞争。
description.en: American politician who ran as the Democratic candidate against George W. Bush in the 2000 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在2000年共和党总统初选中与乔治·沃克·布什竞争。
description.en: American politician who competed against George W. Bush in the 2000 Republican presidential primary.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任国防部长。
description.en: American politician who served as Secretary of Defense during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家、外交家和退役四星将军，曾在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任美国国务卿。
description.en: An American politician, diplomat, and retired four-star general who served as the U.S. Secretary of State during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任国务卿。
description.en: American politician who served as Secretary of State during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治人物，前英国首相，在伊拉克战争等议题上与布什政府紧密合作。
description.en: British politician and former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom who worked closely with the Bush administration, particularly on the Iraq War.

description.zh-cn: 基地组织创始人，被美国政府认定为九一一袭击事件的主谋。
description.en: Founder of al-Qaeda, identified by the U.S. government as the mastermind behind the September 11 attacks.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚合众国的国家元首、政府首脑与三军统帅。
description.en: The head of state, head of government, and commander-in-chief of the armed forces of the United States of America.

description.zh-cn: 美国德克萨斯州的政府首脑。
description.en: The head of government of the U.S. state of Texas.

description.zh-cn: 阿富汗的伊斯兰原教旨主义运动和军事组织，在2001年被美国领导的联军推翻。
description.en: An Islamic fundamentalist movement and military organization in Afghanistan, overthrown by a U.S.-led coalition in 2001.

description.zh-cn: 一个由奥萨玛·本·拉登创立的伊斯兰军事组织，被美国认定为九一一袭击事件的策划者。
description.en: An Islamic military organization founded by Osama bin Laden, identified by the U.S. as the planner of the September 11 attacks.

description.en: A global military, political, legal, and ideological struggle launched by the United States and its allies in response to the September 11 attacks.

description.zh-cn: 美国及其盟友为推翻塔利班政权、铲除基地组织势力而在阿富汗发动的战争。
description.en: A war launched by the United States and its allies in Afghanistan to overthrow the Taliban regime and eliminate al-Qaeda forces.

description.en: An extremely destructive hurricane in August 2005 that caused severe damage along the U.S. Gulf Coast, especially in the city of New Orleans.

description.zh-cn: 于右任在上海创办的具有革命倾向的日报。
description.en: A daily newspaper with revolutionary tendencies founded by Yu Youren in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 于右任在上海法租界创办的日报，因报导伊藤博文遇刺事件，遭清廷控告后被查封停刊。
description.en: A daily newspaper founded by Yu Youren in the Shanghai French Concession, which was sued by the Qing government and subsequently shut down for its coverage of the assassination of Itō Hirobumi.

description.zh-cn: 于右任创办的积极宣传民主革命的报纸。
description.en: A newspaper founded by Yu Youren that actively promoted democratic revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府负责交通与通信事务的部门。
description.en: The department of the ROC government responsible for transportation and communications.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，曾推举于右任为陕西靖国军总司令。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who nominated Yu Youren as the commander-in-chief of the Shaanxi Pacification Army.

description.zh-cn: 台湾社会运动人士，曾参与破坏玉山上的于右任铜像。
description.en: A Taiwanese social activist involved in the vandalism of the Yu Youren statue on Yushan.

description.zh-cn: 于右任次子，曾任中华民国外交官。
description.en: Yu Youren's second son, who served as a diplomat for the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 于右任女婿，于念慈的丈夫。
description.en: Yu Youren's son-in-law, husband of Yu Nianci.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，曾任人民公正党署理主席。他曾是安华的长期追随者，但后来两人关系破裂，成为政治对手。他在2020年马来西亚政治危机中扮演了关键角色，带领一批议员退出公正党，导致希望联盟政府倒台。
description.en: Malaysian politician, former Deputy President of the People's Justice Party (PKR). He was a long-time follower of Anwar, but their relationship later soured, turning them into political rivals. He played a key role in the 2020 Malaysian political crisis by leading a faction of MPs out of PKR, which led to the collapse of the Pakatan Harapan government.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第十六任最高元首。在2022年大选出现悬峙议会后，他委任安华·依布拉欣为第十任首相。
description.en: The 16th Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia. Following the hung parliament result of the 2022 general election, he appointed Anwar Ibrahim as the 10th Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，安华·依布拉欣与旺阿兹莎的长女。人民公正党副主席，曾任国会议员。2023年被其父安华委任为首相经济和金融高级顾问。
description.en: Malaysian politician, the eldest daughter of Anwar Ibrahim and Wan Azizah Wan Ismail. She is a vice-president of the People's Justice Party (PKR) and a former Member of Parliament. In 2023, she was appointed by her father, Anwar, as a senior adviser on economics and finance to the Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 一个由安华·依布拉欣的支持者在“烈火莫熄”运动后成立的多元种族政党。安华是该党的实权领袖和现任主席。
description.en: A multi-racial political party formed by supporters of Anwar Ibrahim following the "Reformasi" movement. Anwar is the party's de facto leader and current president.

description.zh-cn: 1998年安华被革职后，其支持者发起的社会政治改革运动，要求司法独立、反对贪腐和裙带关系。该运动直接促成了人民公正党的诞生。
description.en: A socio-political reform movement initiated by Anwar's supporters after his dismissal in 1998, calling for judicial independence and an end to corruption and cronyism. The movement directly led to the formation of the People's Justice Party (PKR).

description.zh-cn: 安华·依布拉欣先后两次被控以鸡奸罪名，这些审判被广泛认为是出于政治动机，旨在终结其政治生涯。第一次定罪于2004年被推翻，第二次定罪后他于2018年获得全面特赦。
description.en: Anwar Ibrahim was twice charged with sodomy in trials widely seen as politically motivated to end his political career. The first conviction was overturned in 2004, and after the second, he received a full royal pardon in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 1987年马来西亚政府以内安法令进行的一次大逮捕行动。时任教育部长安华因派遣不谙华文的教师出任华小高职而引发的争议是此事件的导火索之一。
description.en: A major crackdown under the Internal Security Act by the Malaysian government in 1987. The controversy sparked by then-Education Minister Anwar's appointment of non-Mandarin-speaking teachers to senior positions in Chinese primary schools was one of the triggers for this event.

description.zh-cn: 刘仰峤之女，文化大革命期间北京师范大学女附中革命师生代表会主席。
description.en: Daughter of Liu Yangqiao, and the chair of the Revolutionary Teachers and Students Representative Council at Beijing Normal University Affiliated Girls' Middle School during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国马萨诸塞州波士顿的私立研究型大学。
description.en: A private research university in Boston, Massachusetts, United States.

description.zh-cn: 卞仲耘的丈夫。
description.en: Husband of Bian Zhongyun.

description.zh-cn: 美国芝加哥大学学者，研究文革历史，发表文章指控宋彬彬对卞仲耘之死负有责任。
description.en: A scholar at the University of Chicago who studies the history of the Cultural Revolution and published articles holding Song Binbin responsible for the death of Bian Zhongyun.

description.en: A senior industrial vocational high school in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, from which Fu Zhaolin graduated.

description.en: A top science and technology university in Tokyo, Japan, where Fu Zhaolin studied abroad.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府下设的部门，傅兆林曾在此任职。
description.en: A department under the Taiwan Provincial Government where Fu Zhaolin worked.

description.zh-cn: 日治台湾高雄州旗山郡下辖的行政区，现为高雄市美浓区。为傅兆林的出生地。
description.en: An administrative district under Kizan District, Takao Prefecture, during the Japanese rule of Taiwan, now Meinong District, Kaohsiung City. It is the birthplace of Fu Zhaolin.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾花莲县的县辖市，为傅兆林的逝世地。
description.en: A county-administered city in Hualien County, Taiwan, where Fu Zhaolin passed away.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省的县，傅兆林曾在此工作并主导重大基础建设。
description.en: A county in Taiwan Province, Republic of China, where Fu Zhaolin worked and led major infrastructure projects.

description.en: A county in Taiwan Province, Republic of China, where Fu Zhaolin led major infrastructure projects.

description.en: Chinese politician, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Hong Kong Liaison Office.

description.en: Chinese politician, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Macau Liaison Office.

description.en: Chinese politician, successor to Xia Baolong as Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.en: Chinese politician, predecessor to Xia Baolong as Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.en: Chinese economist, former President of Peking University, and doctoral advisor to Xia Baolong.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中国人民解放军控制天津后设立的军事管制机构。

description.en: Former Yang di-Pertuan Agong (Supreme Head of State) of Malaysia.
