description.zh-cn: 在九月政争期间，王金平被国民党考纪会决议撤销党籍，面临失去不分区立委及立法院长资格的危机。后经司法诉讼及国民党新任主席朱立伦停止诉讼，才确认党籍。
description.en: During the September Strife, the KMT Discipline Committee resolved to revoke Wang Jin-pyng's party membership, facing the crisis of losing his legislator-at-large status and his position as President of the Legislative Yuan. His membership was only confirmed after legal proceedings and the new KMT Chairman Eric Chu's decision to drop the lawsuit.

description.zh-cn: 因被指控在王金平的关说案中涉入，曾勇夫被迫请辞法务部部长。
description.en: Tseng Yung-fu was forced to resign as Minister of Justice due to his alleged involvement in the lobbying case concerning Wang Jin-pyng.

description.zh-cn: 国民党新任主席朱立伦宣布停止对王金平党籍案的诉讼，确认其保有党籍。
description.en: The new KMT chairman, Eric Chu, announced the cessation of the lawsuit concerning Wang Jin-pyng's party membership, confirming that he retained his membership.

description.zh-cn: 为回应太阳花学运，立法院长王金平承诺在《两岸协议监督条例》完成立法前，不召集《服贸协议》的相关党团协商会议，实际上搁置了该协议。
description.en: In response to the Sunflower Student Movement, Legislative Yuan President Wang Jin-pyng promised not to convene party caucus negotiations on the Service Trade Agreement until the Cross-Strait Agreement Supervisory Bill was enacted, effectively shelving the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 为结束太阳花学运，王金平承诺优先处理《两岸协议监督条例》的立法，将其作为审查《服贸协议》的前提条件。
description.en: To end the Sunflower Student Movement, Wang Jin-pyng promised to prioritize the legislation of the Cross-Strait Agreement Supervisory Bill as a precondition for reviewing the Service Trade Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 林锡山长期担任立法院秘书长，是时任立法院院长王金平的幕僚长。
description.en: Lin Hsi-shan served for a long time as the Secretary-General of the Legislative Yuan, acting as the chief of staff to then-President of the Legislative Yuan Wang Jin-pyng.

position.en: Vice President of the Legislative Yuan

description.zh-cn: 王金平在刘松藩担任立法院院长期间，任立法院副院长。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng served as the Vice President of the Legislative Yuan while Liu Sung-pan was the President.

description.zh-cn: 王金平在连战担任中国国民党主席期间，任副主席。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng served as Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang while Lien Chan was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 白行简是白居易的弟弟。
description.en: Bai Xingjian is Bai Juyi's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 与元稹订交，成为终身的好友，二人齐名，号“元白”。
description.en: Became friends with Yuan Zhen, forming a lifelong friendship. They were equally famous and known as 'Yuan-Bai'.

description.zh-cn: 晚年与刘禹锡唱和甚多，人称为“刘白”。
description.en: In his later years, he frequently exchanged poems with Liu Yuxi, and they were known as 'Liu-Bai'.

description.zh-cn: 在白居易早年拜访时，顾况对其诗篇大加赞赏并为之延誉，使其声名大振。
description.en: When Bai Juyi visited him in his early years, Gu Kuang highly praised his poems and helped promote his reputation, making him famous.

description.zh-cn: 当唐宪宗对白居易的直言感到不快时，李绛为白居易辩护，认为这是其忠心的表现。
description.en: When Emperor Xianzong was displeased with Bai Juyi's directness, Li Jiang defended Bai Juyi, arguing it was a sign of his loyalty.

description.zh-cn: 在武元衡遇刺案后，因白居易越职言事及被诽谤，唐宪宗将其贬为江州司马。
description.en: After the assassination of Wu Yuanheng, Emperor Xianzong demoted Bai Juyi to Sima of Jiangzhou because he overstepped his authority and was slandered.

description.zh-cn: 曾褒白居易为“诗仙”，并在其去世后作吊唁诗，评价其一生。
description.en: He praised Bai Juyi as the 'Poet Immortal' and wrote a eulogy poem after his death, summarizing his life.

description.zh-cn: 倡导新乐府运动，主张“文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作”。
description.en: Advocated the New Yuefu Movement, proposing that 'essays should be written for the times, and poems should be created for events'.

description.zh-cn: 在江州司马任上创作了长篇叙事诗《琵琶行》。
description.en: Authored the long narrative poem 'Song of the Pipa Player' while serving as Sima of Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 亲自编辑了自己的文集《白氏长庆集》。
description.en: Personally edited his own literary collection, 'Collected Works of Bai Juyi'.

description.zh-cn: 为《白氏长庆集》作序并协助编成。
description.en: Wrote the preface for and assisted in the compilation of the 'Collected Works of Bai Juyi'.

description.zh-cn: 《长恨歌》是关于唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情故事。
description.en: The 'Song of Everlasting Regret' is about the love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.

description.zh-cn: 《长恨歌》是关于唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情故事。
description.en: The 'Song of Everlasting Regret' is about the love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.

description.zh-cn: 郑小龙是古龙与郑月霞的儿子。
description.en: Zheng Xiaolong is the son of Gu Long and Zheng Yuexia.

description.zh-cn: 1957年秋，古龙考入淡江英专（淡江大学前身）夜间部英语科，后因谋生而辍学。
description.en: In the autumn of 1957, Gu Long was admitted to the English Department of the Evening Division at Tamkang English College (the predecessor of Tamkang University), but later dropped out to make a living.

description.zh-cn: 传闻古龙在离家出走后，曾短暂加入学生帮派四海帮。
description.en: It is rumored that after running away from home, Gu Long briefly joined the student gang, the Four Seas Gang.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡代表香港《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了小说《绝代双骄》的诞生。
description.en: Representing Hong Kong's Ming Pao newspaper, Ni Kuang commissioned a manuscript from Gu Long, which led to the creation of the novel 'Juedai Shuangjiao'.

description.zh-cn: 金庸在自己封笔后，于1972年亲自为旗下的《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了《陆小凤》系列的创作，此举有世代传承的意味。
description.en: After retiring from writing, Jin Yong personally invited Gu Long in 1972 to write for his newspaper Ming Pao, which led to the creation of the 'Lu Xiaofeng Series'. This act was seen as a passing of the torch between generations.

description.zh-cn: 香港邵氏公司于1976年将古龙的小说改编成电影，大获成功，开创了古龙的电影时代，使其作品声名鹊起。
description.en: In 1976, Hong Kong's Shaw Brothers Studio successfully adapted Gu Long's novels into films, initiating the Gu Long movie era and skyrocketing the popularity of his works.

description.zh-cn: 在1980年的吟松阁事件中，因古龙不愿向柯俊雄敬酒，柯的友人叶庆辉等人用刀刺伤古龙，导致其身受重伤。
description.en: During the 1980 Yinsong Pavilion incident, Gu Long was unwilling to offer a toast to Ko Chun-hsiung. As a result, Ko's associate Ye Qinghui and others stabbed and severely injured Gu Long.

description.zh-cn: 1974年，《中国时报》因认为小说《天涯‧明月‧刀》的理念过于前卫，在连载中途将其停止刊登（腰斩）。
description.en: In 1974, the China Times discontinued the serialization of the novel 'Tianya, Mingyue, Dao' midway, deeming its concepts too avant-garde.

description.zh-cn: 古龙于1938年6月7日出生于香港。
description.en: Gu Long was born in Hong Kong on June 7, 1938.

description.zh-cn: 古龙去世后，时任行政院长俞国华为其墓碑题字“英才早凋”，此举是对其文学成就的官方肯定和纪念。
description.en: After Gu Long's death, then-Premier Yu Kuo-hwa inscribed 'A brilliant talent passed away too soon' on his tombstone, an act of official recognition and commemoration of his literary achievements.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是王思聪的父亲。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is the father of Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 王健林出生于四川省绵阳专区第二人民医院。
description.en: Wang Jianlin was born in the Second People's Hospital of Mianyang Prefecture, Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 1978年进入大连陆军学院学习，1979年8月毕业。
description.en: He entered the Dalian Army Academy for studies in 1978 and graduated in August 1979.

description.zh-cn: 1983年就读辽宁大学党政专修班，1986年毕业获得经济管理专业的学位。
description.en: He attended the Party and Government Cadre training class at Liaoning University from 1983, graduating in 1986 with a degree in Economic Management.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是大连万达集团股份有限公司的董事长。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is the Chairman of Dalian Wanda Group.

description.zh-cn: 王健林接手大连足球队后，成立了大连万达足球俱乐部。
description.en: After taking over the Dalian football team, Wang Jianlin founded the Dalian Wanda Football Club.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，万达集团以26亿美元并购了全球第二大影院公司AMC。
description.en: In 2012, Wanda Group acquired AMC, the world's second-largest cinema chain, for $2.6 billion.

description.zh-cn: 2012年底，万达集团成立万达文化产业集团。
description.en: At the end of 2012, Wanda Group established the Wanda Cultural Industry Group.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团将13个万达文化旅游项目以438.44亿人民币出售给融创中国。
description.en: Wanda Group sold 13 Wanda Cultural Tourism projects to Sunac China for 43.844 billion RMB.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团将旗下77家酒店项目以199.06亿人民币出售给富力地产。
description.en: Wanda Group sold 77 of its hotel projects to R&F Properties for 19.906 billion RMB.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团与中国足协达成战略合作，承诺三年内至少出资5亿元人民币，全面支援中国足球振兴。
description.en: Wanda Group reached a strategic partnership with the Chinese Football Association, promising to invest at least 500 million RMB over three years to fully support the revitalization of Chinese football.

description.zh-cn: 在百万大裁军的背景下，王健林从军队转业，进入地方政府工作，为其后来的商业生涯奠定了基础。
description.en: Against the backdrop of the one-million-man military reduction, Wang Jianlin transitioned from the army to local government, laying the foundation for his later business career.

description.zh-cn: 由于冠状病毒大流行，王健林的房地产和影视事业都急剧下降，导致其财富缩水并跌出富豪榜前列。
description.en: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, Wang Jianlin's real estate and film businesses declined sharply, causing his wealth to shrink and drop him from the top ranks of the rich list.

description.zh-cn: 王义全是参加过长征的中国工农红军成员。
description.en: Wang Yiquan was a member of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army who participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军进行了长征军事转移。
description.en: The Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army undertook the Long March military retreat.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是康熙帝的第八子。
description.en: Yinsi was the eighth son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允禩的生母是良妃卫氏。
description.en: Yinsi's biological mother was Consort Liang, née Wei.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，将允禩革去爵位、开除宗籍、勒令改名，并将其圈禁于宗人府，允禩最终在拘禁中病故。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor stripped Yinsi of his titles, expelled him from the imperial clan, forced him to change his name, and imprisoned him in the Imperial Clan Court, where Yinsi eventually died.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是雍正帝的异母弟。
description.en: Yinsi was the younger half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允禩在九子夺嫡中失败，未能继承皇位，并为其后来的悲惨结局埋下伏笔。
description.en: Yinsi failed in the nine sons' succession struggle, did not inherit the throne, which foreshadowed his later tragic end.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是九子夺嫡事件中的核心人物之一，是“八爷党”的首领。
description.en: Yinsi was one of the central figures in the nine sons' succession struggle, leading the 'Eighth Prince's faction'.

description.zh-cn: 在九子夺嫡期间，允禩是争夺储君之位的主要人物之一，与时为皇太子的胤礽形成政治对立。
description.en: During the nine sons' succession struggle, Yinsi was one of the main contenders for the position of crown prince, forming a political opposition to the then Crown Prince Yinreng.

description.zh-cn: 在争储后期，允禩转而支持皇十四子胤禵继承大统，二人结成政治同盟。
description.en: In the later stages of the succession struggle, Yinsi shifted his support to the 14th prince, Yinti, to inherit the throne, forming a political alliance.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆四十三年，乾隆帝下旨恢复允禩的原名，并将其及其子孙重新录入玉牒，恢复宗籍。
description.en: In 1778, the Qianlong Emperor issued an edict to restore Yinsi's original name and re-admit him and his descendants into the imperial genealogy, restoring their clan status.

description.zh-cn: 郭络罗氏是允禩的嫡福晋。
description.en: Guoluoluo was the primary consort of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 雍正四年正月，雍正帝下令革去郭络罗氏的福晋头衔，并将其逐回母家。
description.en: In January 1726, the Yongzheng Emperor ordered that Guoluoluo be stripped of her title as consort and sent back to her maternal home.

description.zh-cn: 弘旺是允禩的儿子。
description.en: Hongwang was the son of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝下令将弘旺改名为“菩萨保”。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor ordered Hongwang's name to be changed to 'Pusabao'.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝即位后，下令恢复弘旺的原名。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Qianlong Emperor ordered the restoration of Hongwang's original name.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝下令将获罪的皇三子弘时过继给允禩为子嗣。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor ordered his disgraced third son, Hongshi, to be adopted into Yinsi's lineage as his heir.

description.zh-cn: 康熙三十七年，17岁的允禩受封为多罗贝勒。
description.en: In 1698, the 17-year-old Yinsi was ennobled as a Duoluo Beile.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，允禩任理藩院尚书。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, Yinsi served as the Minister of the Lifan Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，允禩负责管理工部事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, Yinsi was in charge of the affairs of the Ministry of Works.

description.zh-cn: 雍正四年，允禩被削去宗籍后，发往正蓝旗卓鼐佐领下。
description.en: In 1726, after being expelled from the imperial clan, Yinsi was dispatched to the Plain Blue Banner under Zuoling Zhuo Nai.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 郭络罗氏是安亲王岳乐的外孙女。
description.en: Guoluoluo was the maternal granddaughter of Prince An Yue Le.

description.zh-cn: 允禩幼时由惠妃抚养。
description.en: Yinsi was raised by Consort Hui during his childhood.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是胤禔的异母弟。
description.en: Yinsi was the younger half-brother of Yinzhi.

description.zh-cn: 康熙四十二年，康熙帝命令书法家何焯为允禩的侍读。
description.en: In 1703, the Kangxi Emperor ordered the calligrapher He Zhuo to be Yinsi's attendant-reader.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是和硕悫靖公主的异母兄。
description.en: Yinsi was the elder half-brother of Princess Heshuo Quejing.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央政治局委员，接受中共中央总书记习近平的领导。
description.en: As a member of the Politburo, he is under the leadership of CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 在担任天津市市长期间，市委书记是李鸿忠。
description.en: During his tenure as Mayor of Tianjin, the Municipal Party Secretary was Li Hongzhong.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中共重庆市委副书记和重庆市市长期间，市委书记是孙政才。
description.en: During his tenure as Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Chongqing, the Municipal Party Secretary was Sun Zhengcai.

description.zh-cn: 在担任重庆市市长期间，孙政才被免职后，市委书记是陈敏尔。
description.en: During his tenure as Mayor of Chongqing, after Sun Zhengcai was removed from office, the Municipal Party Secretary was Chen Min'er.

description.zh-cn: 参加哈佛大学商学院高级管理培训班的学习。
description.en: Attended the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School.

position.zh-cn: 副总裁，党委书记，总裁；总经理、党组副书记
position.en: Vice President, Party Secretary, President; General Manager, Deputy Party Secretary

description.zh-cn: 1996年晋升公司副总裁；1998年起兼任党委书记；2004年4月任北方工业公司总裁。2008年10月至2013年4月任总经理、党组副书记。
description.en: Promoted to Vice President in 1996; served concurrently as Party Secretary from 1998; appointed President of Norinco in April 2004. From October 2008 to April 2013, served as General Manager and Deputy Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十届一中全会上当选为中共中央政治局委员，晋升副国级。
description.en: Was elected as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee at the First Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, promoted to a sub-national level leader.

description.zh-cn: 在十四届全国人大一次会议上，经国务院总理李强提名，当选为国务院副总理。
description.en: At the First Session of the 14th National People's Congress, he was elected Vice Premier of the State Council upon nomination by Premier Li Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替陈求发担任中共辽宁省委书记。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Chen Qiufa as Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 郝鹏接替张国清担任中共辽宁省委书记。
description.en: Hao Peng succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替王东峰担任天津市市长。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Wang Dongfeng as Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 廖国勋接替张国清担任天津市市长。
description.en: Liao Guoxun succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替黄奇帆担任重庆市市长。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Huang Qifan as Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 唐良智接替张国清担任重庆市市长。
description.en: Tang Liangzhi succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 作为国家主席习近平特别代表出席在德黑兰举行的伊朗已故总统莱希吊唁活动。
description.en: As the special representative of President Xi Jinping, attended the memorial service for the late Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi in Tehran.

description.zh-cn: 率国务院工作组紧急赶赴甘肃、青海地震灾区指导抗震救灾工作。
description.en: Led a State Council working group to the earthquake-stricken areas in Gansu and Qinghai to guide the earthquake relief work.

description.zh-cn: 赴广东梅州指导梅大高速茶阳路段塌方灾害应急处置工作。
description.en: Went to Meizhou, Guangdong, to guide the emergency response to the collapse on the Meizhou-Dabu Expressway.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来是薄一波的次子。
description.en: Bo Xilai is the second son of Bo Yibo.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来是胡明之子。
description.en: Bo Xilai is the son of Hu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来与薄谷开来于1987年结婚。
description.en: Bo Xilai and Bo Gu Kailai married in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 李望知是薄熙来与前妻李丹宇所生的长子。
description.en: Li Wangzhi is the eldest son of Bo Xilai and his ex-wife Li Danyu.

description.zh-cn: 薄瓜瓜是薄熙来与妻子薄谷开来所生的幼子。
description.en: Bo Guagua is the youngest son of Bo Xilai and his wife Bo Gu Kailai.

description.zh-cn: 对海伍德死亡案的复查揭示了薄熙来家庭的犯罪行为，成为其被立案调查的关键原因之一。
description.en: The re-investigation of the Neil Heywood death case exposed the criminal activities of Bo Xilai's family, becoming a key reason for the official investigation against him.

description.zh-cn: 文强是薄熙来“打黑”运动中的重点打击对象，最终被判处死刑。
description.en: Wen Qiang was a key target in Bo Xilai's 'strike black' campaign and was ultimately sentenced to death.

description.zh-cn: 王立军与薄熙来决裂后，进入美国领事馆，揭露了薄家的内幕，成为薄熙来的主要政治对手。
description.en: After breaking with Bo Xilai, Wang Lijun entered the U.S. consulate and exposed the Bo family's secrets, becoming Bo's primary political adversary.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，时任总理温家宝反对薄熙来晋升为副总理，并在2012年两会记者会上公开批评重庆市委，对薄熙来的倒台起到了关键作用。
description.en: Then-Premier Wen Jiabao reportedly opposed Bo Xilai's promotion to Vice Premier and played a key role in his downfall by publicly criticizing the Chongqing Municipal Committee at a 2012 press conference.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，薄熙来在重庆发起窃听行动，其监控对象包括时任中共中央总书记胡锦涛。
description.en: Bo Xilai reportedly initiated an eavesdropping operation in Chongqing, with targets including then-General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来在主政重庆期间，推行了以“唱红打黑”和注重民生为特点的“重庆模式”。
description.en: During his tenure in Chongqing, Bo Xilai promoted the 'Chongqing Model', characterized by 'singing red songs and striking black' and a focus on people's livelihood.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来担任商务部长期间，中国商务部颁给蚁力神公司直销执照。
description.en: While Bo Xilai was Minister of Commerce, the Ministry of Commerce granted a direct selling license to the Yilishen company.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，薄熙来被关押在北京市立水桥北苑少管所，并参加劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Bo Xilai was detained at the Lishuiqiao Beiyuan Juvenile Detention Center in Beijing and participated in labor.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是醇贤亲王奕𫍽的第五子。
description.en: Zaifeng was the fifth son of Yixuan, Prince Chun the First.

description.zh-cn: 载沣的生母是奕𫍽的侧福晋刘佳氏。
description.en: Zaifeng's biological mother was Yixuan's secondary consort, Lady Liuja.

description.zh-cn: 奕𫍽是道光皇帝的第七子。
description.en: Yixuan was the seventh son of the Daoguang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是光绪帝（载湉）的异母弟。
description.en: Zaifeng was the younger half-brother of the Guangxu Emperor (Zaitian).

description.zh-cn: 嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏是载沣的元配妻子。
description.en: Primary Consort Gūwalgiya was Zaifeng's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏是大学士荣禄之女。
description.en: Primary Consort Gūwalgiya was the daughter of the Grand Secretary Ronglu.

description.zh-cn: 溥杰是载沣的次子。
description.en: Pujie was the second son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 溥任是载沣的第四子。
description.en: Puren was the fourth son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后在临终前发布懿旨，授载沣为摄政王，监国辅佐幼帝。
description.en: Before her death, Empress Dowager Cixi issued an edict appointing Zaifeng as the Prince-Regent to govern and assist the young emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在决定权力交接时，张之洞建议给予载沣摄政王的封号，并被慈禧太后采纳。
description.en: During the power transition, Zhang Zhidong suggested giving Zaifeng the title of Prince-Regent, which was adopted by Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 根据慈禧太后的安排，载沣作为摄政王在遇到重大事件时，需请示隆裕太后懿旨施行。
description.en: According to Empress Dowager Cixi's arrangements, Zaifeng, as the Prince-Regent, was required to seek instructions from Empress Dowager Longyu for implementation when encountering major events.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义的爆发动摇了清朝的统治，导致载沣的摄政权力迅速瓦解。
description.en: The outbreak of the Wuchang Uprising shook the rule of the Qing dynasty, leading to the rapid collapse of Zaifeng's regency power.

description.zh-cn: 在袁世凯的劝说下，隆裕太后命令载沣辞去监国摄政王职位。
description.en: Persuaded by Yuan Shikai, Empress Dowager Longyu ordered Zaifeng to resign from his position as Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 在辛亥革命的浪潮中，载沣被迫辞去监国摄政王的职务。
description.en: In the tide of the Xinhai Revolution, Zaifeng was forced to resign from his position as Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝的实际统治者，载沣的肖像被印在1910年大清银行发行的兑换券上。
description.en: As the de facto ruler of the Qing dynasty, Zaifeng's portrait was printed on the exchange notes issued by the Ta-Ching Government Bank in 1910.

description.zh-cn: 庚子事变后，载沣被授为头等专使，赴德国为德国公使被杀一事道歉。
description.en: After the Boxer Rebellion, Zaifeng was appointed as a first-class special envoy to Germany to apologize for the killing of the German minister.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是清朝皇族成员，并担任过军机大臣、监国摄政王等要职。
description.en: Zaifeng was a member of the Qing imperial family and held important positions such as Grand Councilor and Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 载沣于光绪九年（1883年）出生于北京太平湖醇亲王府。
description.en: Zaifeng was born in the Prince Chun Mansion at Taiping Lake, Beijing, in 1883 (the 9th year of the Guangxu reign).

description.zh-cn: 载沣在北京病故，并葬于北京西郊福田公墓。
description.en: Zaifeng died of illness in Beijing and was buried in the Futian Cemetery in the western suburbs of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 肖建华出生于山东省泰安地区肥城县（今肥城市）安驾庄镇夏辉村。
description.en: Xiao Jianhua was born in Xiahui Village, Anjiazhuang Town, Feicheng County (now Feicheng City), Tai'an Prefecture, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，年仅14岁的肖建华作为泰安市高考状元进入北京大学法律系就读。
description.en: In 1986, at the age of 14, Xiao Jianhua entered the Law Department of Peking University as the top scorer of the college entrance examination in Tai'an City.

description.zh-cn: 在校期间曾担任全国学联副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the All-China Students' Federation during his time at the university.

description.zh-cn: 对被告人肖建华数罪并罚，决定执行有期徒刑13年，并处罚金人民币650万元。
description.en: Sentenced the defendant Xiao Jianhua to 13 years in prison for multiple crimes and imposed a fine of RMB 6.5 million.

description.zh-cn: 据《纽约时报》报道，肖建华在六四事件期间与校方合作试图平息抗议，毕业后在北京大学的资助下经商，其财富被认为与此段经历有关。
description.en: According to The New York Times, Xiao Jianhua cooperated with the university to quell protests during the 1989 Tiananmen Square incident. He started his business with funding from Peking University after graduation, and his wealth is believed to be related to this experience.

description.zh-cn: 据《纽约时报》报道，毕业之后，肖建华在北京大学的直接资助下步入了商界。
description.en: According to The New York Times, after graduation, Xiao Jianhua entered the business world with direct funding from Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 《纽约时报》发文揭秘了肖建华和马云之间的隐秘商业联系。
description.en: The New York Times published an article revealing the secret business connections between Xiao Jianhua and Jack Ma.

description.zh-cn: 肖建华被认为是曾伟巨额财富的前台操作者。
description.en: Xiao Jianhua is considered to have been the frontman managing the immense wealth of Zeng Wei.

description.zh-cn: 依法委托市场机构接管明天系旗下的华夏人寿、天安财险、天安人寿、易安财险、新时代信托和新华信托六家机构。
description.en: Legally entrusted market institutions to take over six institutions under the Tomorrow Group: Huaxia Life, Tian'an P&C, Tian'an Life, Yi'an P&C, New Times Trust, and Xinhua Trust.

description.zh-cn: 依法委托机构托管明天系旗下的新时代证券、国盛证券、国盛期货。
description.en: Legally entrusted institutions to take custody of New Times Securities, Guosheng Securities, and Guosheng Futures under the Tomorrow Group.

description.zh-cn: 明天系参与了太平洋证券的上市操作。后因国家开发银行副行长王益被查，事件被揭发，导致肖建华出国，明天系逐步转让部分持股。
description.en: The Tomorrow Group participated in the listing operation of Pacific Securities. After China Development Bank Vice Governor Wang Yi was investigated, the incident was exposed, causing Xiao Jianhua to go abroad and the Tomorrow Group to gradually sell off some of its shareholdings.

description.zh-cn: 王益被双规（调查）与太平洋证券上市黑幕有关。
description.en: Wang Yi's investigation was related to the scandal surrounding the listing of Pacific Securities.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共一大代表，是中国共产党的创始人之一。
description.en: As a delegate to the First National Congress of the CCP, he was one of the founders of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 因张国焘投靠中国国民党而被开除党籍。
description.en: Expelled from the party after defecting to the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在投靠国民党后，加入军统从事反共特务活动。
description.en: After defecting to the Kuomintang, he joined the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics to engage in anti-communist secret service activities.

description.zh-cn: 在长征途中，因坚持南下和反对中共中央北上决定而与毛泽东等人产生严重分歧，并另立“中央”，导致党内分裂。1937年3月遭到毛泽东等人的批判斗争。
description.en: During the Long March, he had serious disagreements with Mao Zedong and others over his insistence on going south and opposing the Central Committee's decision to go north. He established a rival 'Central Committee', leading to a split in the party. He was criticized and struggled against by Mao Zedong and others in March 1937.

description.zh-cn: 向毛泽东报告了张国焘要求武力解决分歧的密电，促使毛泽东率领中央纵队先行北上。
description.en: Reported to Mao Zedong about Zhang Guotao's secret cable demanding a forceful resolution of their differences, which prompted Mao to lead the central column north ahead of schedule.

description.zh-cn: 在校期间参加了五四运动，并担任北京学联主席，是北京学运领袖之一。
description.en: During his school years, he participated in the May Fourth Movement, served as the chairman of the Beijing Students' Federation, and was one of the leaders of the Beijing student movement.

description.zh-cn: 发动了白雀园肃反运动。
description.en: Launched the Baiqueyuan Purge.

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦在秦庄襄王元年（前249年）被任命为相邦，至秦王政十年（前237年）被罢免。
description.en: Lü Buwei was appointed Chancellor in the first year of King Zhuangxiang of Qin (-249) and was dismissed in the tenth year of King Zheng of Qin's reign (-237).

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦在赵国邯郸结识当时作为人质的嬴异人，认为其“奇货可居”，于是资助并帮助他返回秦国，通过游说华阳夫人使其被立为嫡子，最终登上王位。
description.en: In Handan, the capital of Zhao, Lü Buwei met Ying Yiren who was a hostage there. Believing him to be a 'rare commodity', Lü funded and assisted his return to Qin. By persuading Lady Huayang, he had Yiren established as the legitimate heir, ultimately enabling him to ascend the throne.

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦招揽门客，合力编撰了《吕氏春秋》。
description.en: Lü Buwei recruited scholars and retainers to collaboratively compile the 'Lüshi Chunqiu'.

description.zh-cn: 秦庄襄王元年（前249年），吕不韦奉命灭亡东周国。
description.en: In the first year of King Zhuangxiang's reign (-249), Lü Buwei was ordered to conquer the state of Eastern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 在灭亡东周国时，奉命诛杀东周君。
description.en: During the conquest of the Eastern Zhou, he was ordered to execute the Lord of Eastern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 秦王政十年（前237年），秦始皇下令调查并平定了嫪毐发动的叛乱，并将其诛杀。
description.en: In the tenth year of his reign (-237), Qin Shi Huang ordered an investigation and suppressed the rebellion launched by Lao Ai, subsequently having him executed.

description.zh-cn: 在平定嫪毐之乱后，秦始皇将母亲赵姬软禁，并毒杀了她与嫪毐的两个私生子。
description.en: After suppressing the Lao Ai rebellion, Qin Shi Huang placed his mother, Queen Dowager Zhao, under house arrest and poisoned her two illegitimate sons with Lao Ai.

description.zh-cn: 嫪毐集团发动叛乱，此事牵连了吕不韦，导致其被秦王政免除相邦职务。
description.en: The rebellion launched by Lao Ai's faction implicated Lü Buwei, leading to his dismissal from the post of Chancellor by King Zheng of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 秦庄襄王（异人）被其父秦孝文王（安国君）立为子嗣。
description.en: King Zhuangxiang (Yiren) was established as the heir by his father, King Xiaowen (Lord Anguo).

description.zh-cn: 在吕不韦的游说下，无子的华阳夫人收养异人为义子，并说服安国君立其为子嗣。
description.en: Persuaded by Lü Buwei, the childless Lady Huayang adopted Yiren as her son and convinced Lord Anguo to establish him as the heir.

description.zh-cn: 秦庄襄王继位后，任命吕不韦为相邦，封为文信侯。
description.en: After ascending the throne, King Zhuangxiang appointed Lü Buwei as Chancellor and ennobled him as Marquis Wenxin.

description.zh-cn: 根据该页面的信息框，老子是影响吕不韦的人物之一。
description.en: According to the infobox on this page, Laozi was one of the figures who influenced Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 根据该页面的信息框，诸子百家是影响吕不韦的因素之一。
description.en: According to the infobox on this page, the Hundred Schools of Thought were one of the factors that influenced Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦出生于浙江宁波。
description.en: Tu Youyou was born in Ningbo, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1981年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Tu Youyou joined the Communist Party of China in 1981.

position.zh-cn: 终身研究员兼首席研究员、中药研究所青蒿素研究中心主任、博士研究生导师
position.en: Lifetime Researcher and Chief Researcher, Director of the Artemisinin Research Center at the Institute of Chinese Materia Medica, Doctoral Supervisor

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦自1955年毕业后被分配至中医研究院（中国中医科学院前身）工作至今。
description.en: Since graduating in 1955, Tu Youyou has been assigned to work at the Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine (the predecessor of the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences).

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1951年考入北京大学医学院，1955年毕业于北京医学院（后并入北京大学医学部）。
description.en: Tu Youyou was admitted to Peking University Medical College in 1951 and graduated from Beijing Medical College (later merged into Peking University Health Science Center) in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1948年进入效实中学学习。
description.en: Tu Youyou entered Xiaoshi High School to study in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1950年转入宁波中学并于1951年毕业。
description.en: Tu Youyou transferred to Ningbo High School in 1950 and graduated in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦及其团队发现了抗疟药青蒿素。
description.en: Tu Youyou and her team discovered the antimalarial drug artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦及其团队发现了抗疟药双氢青蒿素。
description.en: Tu Youyou and her team discovered the antimalarial drug dihydroartemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦在中医研究院工作初期，曾与老师楼之岑副教授一同研究中药。
description.en: In the early days of her work at the Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Tu Youyou studied traditional Chinese medicine with her teacher, Associate Professor Lou Zhicen.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于2025年当选为美国国家科学院外籍院士。
description.en: Tu Youyou was elected as a foreign associate of the U.S. National Academy of Sciences in 2025.

description.zh-cn: 1969年，时任国务院总理的周恩来组建了523项目，旨在研发抗疟药物。
description.en: In 1969, then-Premier Zhou Enlai established Project 523 to develop antimalarial drugs.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦从葛洪的《肘后备急方》中关于“青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁，尽服之”的记载获得灵感，改用乙醚低温萃取，从而成功提取出青蒿素。
description.en: Tu Youyou was inspired by the record in Ge Hong's 'A Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies' which stated 'a handful of sweet wormwood, steeped in two sheng of water, wring out the juice, and drink it all'. This led her to switch to low-temperature extraction with ether, successfully extracting artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院于2017年1月9日将2016年度国家最高科学技术奖授予屠呦呦。
description.en: The State Council of the People's Republic of China awarded the 2016 State Preeminent Science and Technology Award to Tu Youyou on January 9, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国主席习近平于2019年9月17日授予屠呦呦共和国勋章。
description.en: On September 17, 2019, President of the People's Republic of China Xi Jinping awarded Tu Youyou the Medal of the Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在屠呦呦获得诺贝尔奖后，时任国务院总理李克强致函表示祝贺，推动了对她的认可。
description.en: After Tu Youyou won the Nobel Prize, then-Premier Li Keqiang sent a congratulatory letter, promoting her recognition.

description.zh-cn: 微软创始人比尔·盖茨将屠呦呦获得诺贝尔奖列为“2015年6大好消息”之一，提升了其国际声誉。
description.en: Microsoft founder Bill Gates listed Tu Youyou's Nobel Prize win as one of 'The Top 6 Good-News Stories of 2015', enhancing her international reputation.

description.zh-cn: 姚庆三是屠呦呦的舅舅，屠呦呦幼年曾居住于其家中。
description.en: Yao Qingsan is Tu Youyou's maternal uncle. Tu Youyou lived in his home during her childhood.

description.zh-cn: 姚咏白是屠呦呦的外祖父。
description.en: Yao Yongbai is Tu Youyou's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 屠宗年是屠呦呦的曾祖父。
description.en: Tu Zongnian is Tu Youyou's great-grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝是清朝的第六位皇帝，于1735年即位。1796年禅位后作为太上皇继续执政至1799年驾崩。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor was the sixth emperor of the Qing Dynasty, ascending the throne in 1735. After abdicating in 1796, he continued to rule as Emperor Emeritus until his death in 1799.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆六十年九月三日，乾隆帝立十五子永琰（即嘉庆帝）为皇太子，并宣布次年禅让皇位。
description.en: On the third day of the ninth month of the 60th year of the Qianlong reign, the Qianlong Emperor appointed his 15th son, Yongyan (the future Jiaqing Emperor), as Crown Prince and announced his abdication for the following year.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝禅位后，全国改用嘉庆年号，但北京紫禁城内为表示尊崇，仍继续使用乾隆年号，直至乾隆帝驾崩。
description.en: After the Qianlong Emperor's abdication, the Jiaqing era name was adopted nationwide. However, out of respect, the Qianlong era name continued to be used within the Forbidden City in Beijing until the former emperor's death.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝（弘历）是雍正帝的庶子。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor (Hongli) was a son of the Yongzheng Emperor by a concubine.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝在宣布禅位的同时，下诏次年改元为嘉庆。
description.en: While announcing his abdication, the Qianlong Emperor decreed that the era name would be changed to 'Jiaqing' the following year.

description.zh-cn: 郎世宁是服务于乾隆帝的宫廷画家，创作了包括《清高宗乾隆帝朝服像》在内的许多作品。
description.en: Giuseppe Castiglione was a court painter who served the Qianlong Emperor and created many works, including the 'The Qianlong Emperor in Ceremonial Armour'.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝下定决心禁烟后，多次召见林则徐，并任命其为钦差大臣，前往广东主持禁烟事宜，对其高度信任和倚重。
description.en: After deciding to ban opium, the Daoguang Emperor summoned Lin Zexu multiple times and appointed him as the Imperial Commissioner to oversee the prohibition in Guangdong, placing great trust and reliance on him.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐的虎门销烟行动激化了中英矛盾，成为第一次鸦片战争的直接导火索。
description.en: Lin Zexu's destruction of opium at Humen intensified Sino-British conflicts and served as the direct trigger for the First Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 琦善与林则徐政见长期不合，在鸦片战争期间，他与穆彰阿等人向道光帝诬告林则徐，将战争责任归咎于他，并废除了林则徐的防务政策。
description.en: Qishan had long-standing political disagreements with Lin Zexu. During the Opium War, he, along with Mujaangga and others, falsely accused Lin Zexu to the Daoguang Emperor, blaming him for the war and dismantling his defense policies.

description.zh-cn: 作为朝中主和派首领，穆彰阿嫉妒并排挤林则徐，在鸦片战争后阻挠林则徐的复起。
description.en: As a leader of the peace faction in the court, Mujaangga was jealous of and marginalized Lin Zexu, obstructing his potential reinstatement after the Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 作为军机大臣，王鼎是林则徐在朝中的坚定支持者。在林则徐被贬后，他为林则徐竭力辩护，并力图使其复出，最终为之尸谏。
description.en: As a Grand Councilor, Wang Ding was a staunch supporter of Lin Zexu in the court. After Lin's demotion, he vigorously defended him and tried to secure his return to office, ultimately committing suicide in protest.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐视怡和洋行创始人威廉·渣甸为最大的鸦片商人，是其禁烟运动的主要打击对象。
description.en: Lin Zexu considered William Jardine, founder of Jardine, Matheson & Co., to be the biggest opium trader and the main target of his anti-opium campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在禁烟和鸦片战争初期，林则徐与英国驻华商务总监查理·义律进行了直接的政治和军事对抗。
description.en: During the anti-opium campaign and the early stages of the Opium War, Lin Zexu was in direct political and military confrontation with Charles Elliot, the British Chief Superintendent of Trade.

description.zh-cn: 在虎门之战中，广东水师提督关天培率军抵抗英军进攻，最终战死殉国。
description.en: In the Battle of Humen, Guangdong Fleet Admiral Guan Tianpei led his troops to resist the British attack and was killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在广州主持禁烟期间，组织人力翻译外国书报，编成《四洲志》，以了解西方世界。
description.en: While overseeing the opium ban in Guangzhou, Lin Zexu organized the translation of foreign books and newspapers, compiling them into the 'Gazetteer of the Four Continents' to understand the Western world.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在新疆期间，对俄罗斯帝国的扩张保持高度警惕，并预言其将是中国的长远祸患。
description.en: During his exile in Xinjiang, Lin Zexu was highly vigilant about the expansion of the Russian Empire and predicted it would become a long-term threat to China.

description.zh-cn: 1914年，宋霭龄和孔祥熙在日本横滨结婚。
description.en: In 1914, Soong Ai-ling and H. H. Kung married in Yokohama, Japan.

description.zh-cn: 宋霭龄是宋美龄的姐姐。
description.en: Soong Ai-ling was the elder sister of Soong Mei-ling.

description.zh-cn: 1910年毕业后任孙中山秘书，“二次革命”失败后去日本，仍任孙中山秘书。
description.en: After graduating in 1910, she served as Sun Yat-sen's secretary. After the failure of the Second Revolution, she went to Japan and continued to serve as his secretary.

description.zh-cn: “二次革命”失败后，宋霭龄随父去日本。
description.en: After the failure of the Second Revolution, Soong Ai-ling went to Japan with her father.

description.zh-cn: 孔令俊是孔祥熙的次女。
description.en: Kong Lingjun was the second daughter of H. H. Kung.

description.zh-cn: 担任宋美龄与蒋介石的媒人。
description.en: Acted as the matchmaker for Soong Mei-ling and Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 担任宋美龄与蒋介石的媒人。
description.en: Acted as the matchmaker for Soong Mei-ling and Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 根据徐家涵的说法，“连蒋介石遇事也让她三分”。
description.en: According to Xu Jiahan, 'even Chiang Kai-shek would defer to her in certain matters'.

description.zh-cn: 被《纽约时报》形容为“宋家神话的创造者，是使宋家王朝掌权的设计者”。
description.en: Described by The New York Times as 'the creator of the Soong myth and the architect of the Soong dynasty's rise to power'.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英于1992年与罗浩结婚。
description.en: Song Zuying married Luo Hao in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 宋佳玲是宋祖英的妹妹。
description.en: Song Jialing is Song Zuying's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英出生于湖南省古丈县。
description.en: Song Zuying was born in Guzhang County, Hunan Province.

degree.zh-cn: 民族声乐专业毕业，艺术学博士学位
degree.en: Graduated in Ethnic Vocal Music, Doctor of Arts degree

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英毕业于中国音乐学院民族声乐专业，并获得艺术学博士学位。
description.en: Song Zuying graduated from the China Conservatory of Music with a major in Ethnic Vocal Music and holds a Doctor of Arts degree.

description.zh-cn: 1988年10月，金铁霖在“金龙杯”全国歌手邀请赛后收宋祖英为学生，对其声乐事业产生了重要影响。
description.en: In October 1988, after the 'Golden Dragon Cup' National Singer Invitational Competition, Jin Tielin accepted Song Zuying as his student, significantly influencing her vocal career.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英于1999年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Song Zuying joined the Communist Party of China in 1999.

description.zh-cn: 2013年至2018年，宋祖英担任海政文工团团长。
description.en: From 2013 to 2018, Song Zuying served as the head of the PLA Navy Political Work Department Song and Dance Troupe.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英曾任中国音乐家协会副主席。
description.en: Song Zuying served as the Vice Chairman of the Chinese Musicians' Association.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英曾任第九届全国人大代表。
description.en: Song Zuying was a deputy to the 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英曾任第十届、十一届、十二届全国政协委员。
description.en: Song Zuying served as a member of the 10th, 11th, and 12th National Committees of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在北京奥运会闭幕式上与多明哥共同演唱了主题歌《爱的火焰》。
description.en: Co-performed the theme song 'The Flame of Love' with Plácido Domingo at the closing ceremony of the Beijing Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 在上海世博会开幕式上与成龙共同演唱歌曲。
description.en: Co-performed a song with Jackie Chan at the opening ceremony of the Shanghai Expo.

description.zh-cn: 在2011台北小巨蛋个人演唱会上与周华健同台演出。
description.en: Performed on the same stage with Wakin Chau at her 2011 solo concert at the Taipei Arena.

description.zh-cn: 在2011台北小巨蛋个人演唱会上与周杰伦同台演出。
description.en: Performed on the same stage with Jay Chou at her 2011 solo concert at the Taipei Arena.

description.zh-cn: 2007年，宋祖英接受杨澜《天下女人》节目的访问。
description.en: In 2007, Song Zuying was interviewed by Yang Lan on the program 'Her Village'.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙出生于山西省太谷县。
description.en: H. H. Kung was born in Taigu County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙于1894年从潞河书院毕业。
description.en: H. H. Kung graduated from Luhe Academy in 1894.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙于1905年毕业于欧柏林学院，后于1926年获赠名誉博士学位。
description.en: H. H. Kung graduated from Oberlin College in 1905 and was awarded an honorary doctorate in 1926.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙于1907年在耶鲁大学取得矿物学硕士学位。
description.en: H. H. Kung obtained a Master's degree in Mineralogy from Yale University in 1907.

description.zh-cn: 1907年，孔祥熙在家乡太谷县创办了铭贤学堂。
description.en: In 1907, H. H. Kung founded the Ming Hsien School in his hometown of Taigu County.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙曾先后担任行政院副院长（1933-1945）和院长（1938-1939）。
description.en: H. H. Kung served successively as Vice Premier (1933-1945) and Premier (1938-1939) of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 时任财政部长孔祥熙于1935年11月3日颁布《财政部改革币制令》，推行法币政策。
description.en: As Minister of Finance, H. H. Kung issued the 'Ministry of Finance Decree on Currency Reform' on November 3, 1935, implementing the Fapi policy.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙宣布对中国银行实行管制，要求增发股票，将控制权交给政府。
description.en: H. H. Kung announced that the government would take control of the Bank of China, requiring it to issue additional shares to transfer control to the government.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙宣布对交通银行实行管制，要求增发股票，将控制权交给政府。
description.en: H. H. Kung announced that the government would take control of the Bank of Communications, requiring it to issue additional shares to transfer control to the government.

description.zh-cn: 在宋子文与上海金融家矛盾加深后，蒋介石让孔祥熙接替宋子文出任财政部长。
description.en: After the conflict between T. V. Soong and Shanghai financiers intensified, Chiang Kai-shek had H. H. Kung replace Soong as Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 义和团运动期间，孔祥熙及其家人因运动导致的暴力而被迫依靠乡亲收容才得以脱险。
description.en: During the Boxer Rebellion, H. H. Kung and his family were forced to rely on fellow villagers for shelter to escape the violence caused by the movement.

description.zh-cn: 傅斯年在国民参政会上揭发孔祥熙贪污舞弊，不久后孔被免去财政部长职位。
description.en: Fu Ssu-nien exposed H. H. Kung's corruption at the People's Political Council, leading to Kung's dismissal from the post of Minister of Finance shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 中国银行总经理张公权反对孔祥熙的赤字财政政策，并联合交通银行拒绝提供财力支援。
description.en: Chang Kia-ngau, general manager of the Bank of China, opposed H. H. Kung's deficit financial policy and, along with the Bank of Communications, refused to provide financial support.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国曾批评孔祥熙为“大资产阶级”。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo once criticized H. H. Kung as a 'big bourgeois'.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国曾批评宋子文为“大资产阶级”。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo once criticized T. V. Soong as a 'big bourgeois'.

description.zh-cn: 通过在新民报报道孔祥熙之女孔令俊滥用特权的“飞狗事件”，引发了公众对孔祥熙家族的强烈不满。
description.en: By reporting on the 'Flying Dog Incident', where H. H. Kung's daughter Kong Lingjun abused her privileges, in the 'Xin Min Bao', it sparked strong public dissatisfaction with the Kung family.

description.zh-cn: 土木之变中明英宗被俘，为朱祁钰（时为郕王）继位成为景泰帝提供了直接契机。
description.en: The capture of Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis provided the direct opportunity for Zhu Qiyu (then Prince of Cheng) to ascend the throne as the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在明英宗被俘后，联合其他大臣拥立郕王朱祁钰为皇帝。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong was captured, he, along with other ministers, supported the enthronement of the Prince of Cheng, Zhu Qiyu, as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在明英宗被俘后，首先任命朱祁钰为监国，为其后登基铺平了道路。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong was captured, she first appointed Zhu Qiyu as regent, paving the way for his subsequent enthronement.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝即位后，任命于谦为兵部尚书，领导京师保卫战。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Jingtai Emperor appointed Yu Qian as the Minister of War to lead the Defense of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 明军在北京保卫战中击退了瓦剌的进攻。
description.en: The Ming army repelled the Oirat invasion during the Defense of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 即位后，恢复了叔叔景泰帝的皇帝尊号，并上谥号“恭仁康定景皇帝”。
description.en: After ascending the throne, he restored his uncle the Jingtai Emperor's imperial title and gave him the posthumous name 'Gongren Kangding Jing Huangdi'.

description.zh-cn: 南明弘光帝为景泰帝追上庙号“代宗”和更长的谥号。
description.en: The Hongguang Emperor of the Southern Ming posthumously honored the Jingtai Emperor with the temple name 'Daizong' and a longer posthumous title.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝死后，明英宗下令唐皇贵妃为其殉葬。
description.en: After the Jingtai Emperor's death, Emperor Yingzong ordered Imperial Noble Consort Tang to be buried alive as a human sacrifice.

description.zh-cn: 成功劝谏明英宗，使被废的汪皇后免于为景泰帝殉葬。
description.en: Successfully persuaded Emperor Yingzong to spare the deposed Empress Wang from being sacrificed for the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡是林彪的女儿。
description.en: Lin Liheng is the daughter of Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡是叶群的女儿。
description.en: Lin Liheng is the daughter of Ye Qun.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡于1944年8月31日出生于延安。
description.en: Lin Liheng was born in Yan'an on August 31, 1944.

description.zh-cn: 1962年进入清华大学电子工程系就读。
description.en: Enrolled in the Department of Electronic Engineering at Tsinghua University in 1962.

description.zh-cn: 从清华大学转学至北京大学中文系。
description.en: Transferred from Tsinghua University to the Department of Chinese at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间担任《空军报》副总编。
description.en: Served as Deputy Editor-in-Chief of the Air Force News during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 林彪在九一三事件中因飞机坠毁而身亡。
description.en: Lin Biao was killed in the September 13 Incident due to a plane crash.

description.zh-cn: 九一三事件后，林立衡虽然告发有功，但仍需接受审查，期间曾试图自杀。
description.en: After the September 13 Incident, although Lin Liheng reported the escape plan, she was still subjected to investigation, during which she attempted suicide.

description.zh-cn: 在林立衡写信求助后，毛泽东于1974年7月31日批示解除了对她的审查。
description.en: After Lin Liheng wrote a letter asking for help, Mao Zedong issued an instruction on July 31, 1974, to lift the investigation against her.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡曾在位于郑州的汽车厂工作后，调至中国社会科学院工作。
description.en: After working in a car factory in Zhengzhou, Lin Liheng was transferred to work at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 林彪一行人乘坐的飞机在温都尔汗坠毁。
description.en: The plane carrying Lin Biao and his party crashed in Öndörkhaan.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡六岁时曾跟随父亲林彪至莫斯科养病。
description.en: At the age of six, Lin Liheng followed her father Lin Biao to Moscow for medical treatment.

description.zh-cn: 与张清林结婚后，林立衡曾在郑州的一家汽车厂工作。
description.en: After marrying Zhang Qinglin, Lin Liheng worked at a car factory in Zhengzhou.

description.zh-cn: 孝慈高皇后是明太祖朱元璋的结发妻子和皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaoci Gao was the primary wife and empress of Emperor Taizu of Ming (Zhu Yuanzhang).

description.zh-cn: 马公是孝慈高皇后的父亲，郑媪是她的母亲。
description.en: Ma Gong was the father, and Zheng Ao was the mother of Empress Xiaoci Gao.

description.zh-cn: 郭子兴是孝慈高皇后的义父。
description.en: Guo Zixing was the adoptive father of Empress Xiaoci Gao.

description.zh-cn: 郭子兴曾听信谗言猜疑朱元璋。
description.en: Guo Zixing once grew suspicious of Zhu Yuanzhang due to slander.

description.zh-cn: 孝慈高皇后出生于宿州。
description.en: Empress Xiaoci Gao was born in Suzhou.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋登基当日，册封马氏为皇后。
description.en: On the day of his enthronement, Zhu Yuanzhang proclaimed Lady Ma as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 洪武二年，朱元璋追封岳父马公为徐王。
description.en: In the second year of the Hongwu era, Zhu Yuanzhang posthumously enfeoffed his father-in-law Ma Gong as the Prince of Xu.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载朱标为马皇后所生，但其生母存在争议。
description.en: Official histories record Zhu Biao as the son of Empress Ma, but his maternity is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载朱㭎为马皇后所生，但其生母存在争议。
description.en: Official histories record Zhu Gang as the son of Empress Ma, but his maternity is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载朱棣为马皇后所生，但其生母存在争议。
description.en: Official histories record Zhu Di as the son of Empress Ma, but his maternity is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载朱橚为马皇后所生，但其生母存在争议。
description.en: Official histories record Zhu Su as the son of Empress Ma, but his maternity is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 宁国公主是孝慈高皇后的女儿。
description.en: Princess Ningguo was the daughter of Empress Xiaoci Gao.

description.zh-cn: 安庆公主是孝慈高皇后的女儿。
description.en: Princess Anqing was the daughter of Empress Xiaoci Gao.

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京太常寺志》等记载，朱棣的生母为䂵妃。
description.en: According to records such as the 'Nanjing Taichang Si Zhi', Zhu Di's biological mother was Consort Gong.

description.zh-cn: 杨宪诬告李文忠不法。
description.en: Yang Xian falsely accused Li Wenzhong of misconduct.

description.zh-cn: 在杨宪诬告李文忠后，马皇后劝说朱元璋不要轻易将李文忠召回，保住了他的职位。
description.en: After Yang Xian falsely accused Li Wenzhong, Empress Ma persuaded Zhu Yuanzhang not to recall him rashly, thus securing his position.

description.zh-cn: 为被判死罪的宋濂求情，使其最终得以赦免。
description.en: She pleaded for Song Lian, who was sentenced to death, leading to his eventual pardon.

description.zh-cn: 劝谏朱元璋不要诛杀富民沈秀（沈万三），使其免于一死。
description.en: She advised Zhu Yuanzhang against executing the wealthy civilian Shen Xiu (Shen Wansan), thereby saving his life.

description.zh-cn: 孝慈高皇后于洪武十五年九月葬于孝陵。
description.en: Empress Xiaoci Gao was buried in the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum in September of the 15th year of the Hongwu era.

description.zh-cn: 追尊祖母马皇后为“孝慈昭宪至仁文德承天顺圣高皇后”。
description.en: Posthumously honored his grandmother Empress Ma with the title 'Empress Xiaoci Zhaoxian Zhiren Wende Chengtian Shunsheng Gao'.

description.zh-cn: 重尊母亲马氏为“孝慈昭宪至仁文德承天顺圣高皇后”。
description.en: Re-honored his mother Lady Ma with the title 'Empress Xiaoci Zhaoxian Zhiren Wende Chengtian Shunsheng Gao'.

description.zh-cn: 再次追尊马皇后为“孝慈贞化哲顺仁徽成天育圣至德高皇后”。
description.en: Again posthumously honored Empress Ma with the title 'Empress Xiaoci Zhenhua Zheshun Renhui Chengtian Yusheng Zhide Gao'.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋常将马皇后的贤慧比作唐太宗时的长孙皇后。
description.en: Zhu Yuanzhang often compared the wisdom and virtue of Empress Ma to that of Empress Zhangsun of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 奇皇后是元朝的末代皇后，孝慈高皇后是明朝的开国皇后，存在朝代接替关系。
description.en: Empress Gi was the last empress of the Yuan dynasty, and Empress Xiaoci Gao was the founding empress of the Ming dynasty, representing a dynastic succession.

description.zh-cn: 孝慈高皇后去世后，其孙媳马皇后（明惠帝皇后）成为后来的明朝皇后，存在接替关系。
description.en: After the death of Empress Xiaoci Gao, her grandson's wife, Empress Ma (Empress of the Jianwen Emperor), became a subsequent empress of the Ming dynasty, indicating a succession.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是道光帝旻宁的第六子。
description.en: Yixin was the sixth son of the Daoguang Emperor, Minning.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是孝静成皇后的亲生儿子。
description.en: Yixin was the biological son of Empress Xiao Jing Cheng.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝选择传位于皇四子奕𬣞而非更有才干的奕䜣，并采取措施暗示奕䜣争储失败。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor chose his fourth son Yizhu as successor over the more talented Yixin, and took measures to signal that Yixin's bid for the throne had failed.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝因奕䜣为其母请求太后封号一事感到不快，借故免去奕䜣的军机大臣等职务，导致兄弟反目。
description.en: The Xianfeng Emperor was displeased by Yixin's request for an empress dowager title for his mother and used it as a pretext to dismiss Yixin from his post as Grand Councilor, leading to their estrangement.

description.zh-cn: 在辛酉政变中联合，之后慈安太后长期支持奕䜣，制衡慈禧太后的权势。
description.en: They allied in the Xinyou Coup, and afterwards, Empress Dowager Ci'an consistently supported Yixin, balancing the power of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 因奕䜣功高震主，慈禧太后对他长期猜忌，并在1865年首次尝试罢免其职务，最终于1884年通过“甲申易枢”将其彻底逐出权力核心。
description.en: Due to Yixin's significant power and achievements, Empress Dowager Cixi grew suspicious of him, first attempting to dismiss him in 1865 and eventually removing him completely from the core of power in 1884 through the 'Jiashen Coup'.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是辛酉政变的主要策划者和执行者，联合两宫皇太后推翻了顾命八大臣的统治。
description.en: Yixin was the main planner and executor of the Xinyou Coup, allying with the two Empress Dowagers to overthrow the rule of the Eight Regent Ministers.

description.zh-cn: 慈安太后与奕䜣、慈禧太后密谋，联合发动了辛酉政变。
description.en: Empress Dowager Ci'an conspired with Yixin and Empress Dowager Cixi to jointly launch the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是洋务派的代表人物、主要发起者及领袖，倡导并主持洋务运动。
description.en: Yixin was a representative figure, main initiator, and leader of the Self-Strengthening Movement, advocating for and presiding over it.

description.zh-cn: 清廷采纳了奕䜣的建议，首次设立专门的外交机构——总理各国事务衙门，并由其担任首席大臣。
description.en: The Qing court adopted Yixin's proposal to establish the Zongli Yamen, the first dedicated foreign affairs office, with him serving as its head.

description.zh-cn: 在奕䜣等人主持下，清朝平息了太平天国运动。
description.en: Under the leadership of Yixin and others, the Qing dynasty suppressed the Taiping Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣受命与英法联军谈判议和，签署《北京条约》，结束了战争。
description.en: Yixin was ordered to negotiate peace with the Anglo-French forces, signing the Convention of Peking and ending the war.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣作为钦差大臣，代表清廷与英、法、俄等国签订了《北京条约》。
description.en: As the imperial commissioner, Yixin represented the Qing court in signing the Convention of Peking with Britain, France, and Russia.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣命山东巡抚丁宝祯将违制出京的慈禧心腹太监安德海捕拿并就地正法。
description.en: Yixin ordered Ding Baozhen, the Governor of Shandong, to capture and execute An Dehai, a favored eunuch of Cixi, for leaving the capital in violation of rules.

description.zh-cn: 同治帝因奕䜣劝谏其停止修治圆明园等事而痛斥他，并将其及其子撤职降级（后被两宫太后恢复）。
description.en: The Tongzhi Emperor berated Yixin for advising him to stop renovating the Old Summer Palace and other matters, and dismissed him and his son from their posts (later restored by the two empress dowagers).

description.zh-cn: 中日甲午战争爆发后，慈禧碍于危机形势再度起用奕䜣，命其担任领班军机大臣等职。
description.en: After the outbreak of the First Sino-Japanese War, Cixi reappointed Yixin due to the crisis, making him the head of the Grand Council and other positions.

description.zh-cn: 晚年的奕䜣对光绪帝意图发动的维新变法运动极力抵制、屡加阻挠。
description.en: In his later years, Yixin strongly resisted and repeatedly obstructed the reform movement that the Guangxu Emperor intended to launch.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣病逝前向光绪帝表达对翁同龢的反对之意，促使光绪帝罢黜了翁同龢。
description.en: Before his death, Yixin expressed his opposition to Weng Tonghe to the Guangxu Emperor, which prompted the emperor to dismiss Weng.

description.zh-cn: 瓜尔佳氏是奕䜣的嫡福晋（正妻）。
description.en: Lady Gūwalgiya was Yixin's primary consort.

description.zh-cn: 瓜尔佳氏是大学士桂良的庶女。
description.en: Lady Gūwalgiya was a daughter of the Grand Secretary Guiliang by a concubine.

description.zh-cn: 荣寿固伦公主是奕䜣的长女。
description.en: Princess Rongshou was the eldest daughter of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 载澂是奕䜣的长子。
description.en: Zaicheng was the eldest son of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 载滢是奕䜣的次子。
description.en: Zaiying was the second son of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 溥伟是载滢的长子，后被过继给载澂。
description.en: Puwei was the eldest son of Zaiying and was later adopted by Zaicheng.

description.zh-cn: 溥伟被过继给已故的伯父载澂为嗣子，以承袭恭亲王爵位。
description.en: Puwei was adopted by his deceased uncle Zaicheng as his heir to inherit the title of Prince Gong.

description.zh-cn: 杨开慧是杨昌济的女儿。
description.en: Yang Kaihui is the daughter of Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸英是杨开慧的长子。
description.en: Mao Anying is the eldest son of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸英是毛泽东的长子。
description.en: Mao Anying is the eldest son of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸青是杨开慧的次子。
description.en: Mao Anqing is the second son of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸青是毛泽东的次子。
description.en: Mao Anqing is the second son of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸龙是杨开慧的幼子。
description.en: Mao Anlong is the youngest son of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸龙是毛泽东的幼子。
description.en: Mao Anlong is the youngest son of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，毛泽东在井冈山与贺子珍结婚。
description.en: In 1928, Mao Zedong married He Zizhen in the Jinggang Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 杨开慧7岁时入读长沙第四十初级小学（长沙市稻田中学前身之一）。
description.en: At the age of 7, Yang Kaihui enrolled in the 40th Primary School of Changsha (one of the predecessors of Changsha Daotian Middle School).

description.zh-cn: 1920年，杨开慧进入福湘女中学习。
description.en: In 1920, Yang Kaihui enrolled in Fuxiang Girls' Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 据传闻，蔡元培曾向何键发电报，要求保释杨开慧，但未成功。
description.en: According to rumors, Cai Yuanpei sent a telegram to He Jian requesting the release of Yang Kaihui, but was unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 1949年后，杨开慧的家乡板仓乡为纪念她而改名为开慧乡。
description.en: After 1949, Yang Kaihui's hometown, Bancang Township, was renamed Kaihui Township in her memory.

description.zh-cn: 1918年夏，杨昌济应聘为北京大学教授。
description.en: In the summer of 1918, Yang Changji was appointed as a professor at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 为悼念杨开慧并回复李淑一而创作该词。
description.en: Authored this poem to mourn Yang Kaihui and in reply to Li Shuyi.

description.zh-cn: 李淑一于1957年春节写信给毛泽东，促使毛泽东回信并附上该词。
description.en: Li Shuyi wrote to Mao Zedong during the 1957 Spring Festival, prompting him to reply with this poem.

description.zh-cn: 李淑一是柳直荀的妻子。
description.en: Li Shuyi is the wife of Liu Zhixun.

description.zh-cn: 苗华于1969年12月参军，2025年10月17日被开除军籍。
description.en: Miao Hua joined the army in December 1969 and was expelled from the military on October 17, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 苗华于1973年9月入党，2025年10月17日被开除党籍。
description.en: Miao Hua joined the Party in September 1973 and was expelled on October 17, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 苗华接替张阳担任中央军事委员会政治工作部主任。
description.en: Miao Hua succeeded Zhang Yang as Director of the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 苗华接替刘晓江，担任中国人民解放军海军政治委员。
description.en: Miao Hua succeeded Liu Xiaojiang as Political Commissar of the PLA Navy.

description.zh-cn: 苗华卸任中国人民解放军海军政治委员，由秦生祥接任。
description.en: Miao Hua stepped down as Political Commissar of the PLA Navy and was succeeded by Qin Shengxiang.

description.zh-cn: 苗华接替到龄退休的李长才，担任兰州军区政治委员。
description.en: Miao Hua succeeded the retiring Li Changcai as Political Commissar of the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 苗华卸任兰州军区政治委员，由刘雷接任。
description.en: Miao Hua stepped down as Political Commissar of the Lanzhou Military Region and was succeeded by Liu Lei.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央研究决定对涉嫌严重违纪的苗华停职检查。
description.en: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China decided to suspend Miao Hua from his duties for investigation into suspected serious violations of discipline.

description.zh-cn: 正式免除苗华的中华人民共和国中央军事委员会委员职务。
description.en: Formally removed Miao Hua from his position as a member of the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 开除苗华党籍。
description.en: Expelled Miao Hua from the party.

description.zh-cn: 开除苗华军籍。
description.en: Expelled Miao Hua from the military.

description.zh-cn: 郝明珠是习仲勋的第一任妻子，两人于1935年结婚，1944年初冬离婚。
description.en: Hao Mingzhu was Xi Zhongxun's first wife; they married in 1935 and divorced in the early winter of 1944.

description.zh-cn: 郝明珠出生于陕西省安定县（现子长市）。
description.en: Hao Mingzhu was born in Anding County (present-day Zichang City), Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 郝明珠曾任陕西省第五届人大常委会委员。
description.en: Hao Mingzhu served as a member of the 5th Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 习和平是郝明珠的长女。
description.en: Xi Heping was the eldest daughter of Hao Mingzhu.

description.zh-cn: 习和平是习仲勋的长女。
description.en: Xi Heping was the eldest daughter of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 习正宁是郝明珠的长子。
description.en: Xi Zhengning was the eldest son of Hao Mingzhu.

description.zh-cn: 习正宁是习仲勋的长子。
description.en: Xi Zhengning was the eldest son of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 吴岱峰是郝明珠的姨父。
description.en: Wu Daifeng was Hao Mingzhu's maternal uncle-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 1948年8月21日，王光美与刘少奇于西柏坡结婚。
description.en: On August 21, 1948, Wang Guangmei married Liu Shaoqi in Xibaipo.

description.zh-cn: 王治昌是王光美的父亲。
description.en: Wang Zhichang is the father of Wang Guangmei.

degree.zh-cn: 物理学学士、物理学硕士
degree.en: Bachelor of Physics, Master of Physics

description.zh-cn: 1945年毕业于辅仁大学，获物理学学士与硕士学位。
description.en: Graduated from Fu Jen University in 1945 with bachelor's and master's degrees in physics.

description.zh-cn: 1948年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争胜利前夕结识了中共辅仁大学工委领导人崔月犁。
description.en: Before the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, she got to know Cui Yueli, the leader of the CCP working committee at Fu Jen University.

description.zh-cn: 外国媒体多以“第一夫人”称呼王光美，引起毛泽东夫人江青不满。
description.en: Foreign media often referred to Wang Guangmei as the 'First Lady', which caused dissatisfaction for Mao Zedong's wife, Jiang Qing.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中，王光美遭到批斗并被投入秦城监狱，直至1978年12月恢复人身自由。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Wang Guangmei was subjected to struggle sessions and imprisoned in Qincheng Prison until her personal freedom was restored in December 1978.

description.zh-cn: 1966年6月，出任清华大学工作组顾问的王光美严厉打击蒯大富，在清华掀起“反蒯运动”。
description.en: In June 1966, as an advisor to the work group at Tsinghua University, Wang Guangmei severely cracked down on Kuai Dafu, launching the 'Anti-Kuai Movement' at Tsinghua.

description.zh-cn: 策划“智擒王光美”事件，将王光美扣押，并于同年4月10日组织了对她的批斗大会。
description.en: Orchestrated the 'deceitful capture of Wang Guangmei' event, detaining her, and organized a struggle session against her on April 10 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中与江青等人力主处死王光美。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, along with Jiang Qing and others, strongly advocated for the execution of Wang Guangmei.

description.zh-cn: 在林彪、江青等人力主处死王光美时，批示“刀下留人”，使其幸免于死。
description.en: When Lin Biao, Jiang Qing, and others strongly advocated for Wang Guangmei's execution, Mao Zedong intervened with the instruction 'spare her from the blade', saving her life.

description.zh-cn: 王光美在四清运动前期，带工作队到河北桃园大队搞试点，总结出“桃园经验”。
description.en: In the early stage of the Four Cleanups Movement, Wang Guangmei led a work team to Taoyuan Brigade in Hebei to conduct a pilot project, from which she summarized the 'Taoyuan Experience'.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中，王光美因其的“桃园经验”而遭到造反派批斗。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Wang Guangmei was targeted and subjected to struggle sessions by rebels because of her 'Taoyuan Experience'.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠改投冯玉祥的部队，并在其麾下任职多年。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong joined Feng Yuxiang's troops and served under his command for many years.

description.zh-cn: 因战事不利，张自忠恐为其直属长官石友三所害，遂率部脱离。
description.en: Due to unfavorable battle conditions, Zhang Zizhong feared he would be harmed by his direct superior Shi Yousan and thus led his troops to leave.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠在宋哲元担任军长的第二十九军中任师长。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong served as a division commander in the 29th Army, which was commanded by Song Zheyuan.

description.zh-cn: 七七事变后，张自忠归于中央政府节制，受军事委员会委员长蒋中正指挥。
description.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, Zhang Zizhong came under the control of the central government and was commanded by Chiang Kai-shek, the Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠率部在南瓜店与日军激战，最终壮烈殉国。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong led his troops in a fierce battle against the Japanese army at Nanguadian and was ultimately killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠在枣宜会战期间阵亡。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong was killed in action during the Battle of Zaoyang-Yichang.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠殉国后，国民政府明令褒扬，并追晋其为陆军二级上将。
description.en: After Zhang Zizhong's death, the Nationalist Government issued a commendation and posthumously promoted him to General, Second Class of the Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国民政部追认张自忠为革命烈士。
description.en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China posthumously recognized Zhang Zizhong as a revolutionary martyr.

description.zh-cn: 在延安各界举行的追悼大会上，毛泽东为张自忠送上“尽忠报国”的挽词。
description.en: At a memorial service held in Yan'an, Mao Zedong sent a eulogy for Zhang Zizhong with the words 'Loyally serving the country'.

description.zh-cn: 在纪念抗战胜利69周年座谈会上，习近平将张自忠列为中国人民不畏强暴、以身殉国的杰出代表。
description.en: At a symposium commemorating the 69th anniversary of the victory of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, Xi Jinping listed Zhang Zizhong as an outstanding representative of the Chinese people who defied brute force and sacrificed their lives for the country.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇于1900年5月10日与九条节子（后来的贞明皇后）结婚。
description.en: Emperor Taishō married Kujō Sadako (later Empress Teimei) on May 10, 1900.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇由其祖母中山庆子（明治天皇的生母）负责养育。
description.en: Emperor Taishō was raised by his grandmother, Nakayama Yoshiko (the biological mother of Emperor Meiji).

description.zh-cn: 秩父宫雍仁亲王是大正天皇的次子。
description.en: Prince Chichibu was the second son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王是大正天皇的三子。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu was the third son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 三笠宫崇仁亲王是大正天皇的幼子。
description.en: Prince Mikasa was the youngest son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇曾就读于学习院但中途退学。
description.en: Emperor Taishō attended the Gakushūin but dropped out.

description.zh-cn: 嘉仁于1912年7月30日继位为大正天皇。
description.en: Yoshihito succeeded to the throne as Emperor Taishō on July 30, 1912.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇在位期间担任帝国大元帅。
description.en: Emperor Taishō held the rank of Marshal-Admiral during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 因大正天皇健康状况不佳，皇太子裕仁于1921年开始摄政。
description.en: Due to Emperor Taishō's poor health, Crown Prince Hirohito was appointed Regent in 1921.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇驾崩后，皇太子裕仁继位成为昭和天皇。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Taishō, Crown Prince Hirohito succeeded him as Emperor Shōwa.

description.zh-cn: 1907年，朝鲜统监伊藤博文说服当时为皇太子的嘉仁访问韩国。
description.en: In 1907, Resident-General of Korea Itō Hirobumi persuaded then-Crown Prince Yoshihito to visit Korea.

description.zh-cn: 1907年，皇太子嘉仁访问韩国，受到皇帝纯宗的迎接。
description.en: In 1907, Crown Prince Yoshihito visited Korea and was received by Emperor Sunjong.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇在位期间，日本逼迫袁世凯领导的中国北洋政府签署“二十一条”及“中日民四条约”。
description.en: During Emperor Taishō's reign, Japan forced the Beiyang Government of China, led by Yuan Shikai, to sign the 'Twenty-One Demands' and the 'Sino-Japanese Treaty of 1915'.

description.zh-cn: “大正民主”时期的民主化浪潮影响到当时的日属台湾，促使林献堂等人发起台湾议会设置请愿运动。
description.en: The wave of democratization during the 'Taishō democracy' period influenced then-Japanese-ruled Taiwan, prompting figures like Lin Hsien-tang to initiate the Petition Movement for the Establishment of a Taiwanese Parliament.

description.zh-cn: 关东大地震是发生在大正天皇统治后期的重大灾难，加深了其“不幸的大正”的公众印象。
description.en: The Great Kantō earthquake was a major disaster during the later part of Emperor Taishō's reign, contributing to his public image as the 'unfortunate Taishō'.

description.zh-cn: 允礽是康熙帝的第二子。
description.en: Yunreng was the second son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允礽的生母是孝诚仁皇后。
description.en: Yunreng's birth mother was Empress Xiaochengren.

description.zh-cn: 瓜尔佳氏是允礽的嫡福晋（正室）。
description.en: Lady Guwalgiya was the primary consort of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 李佳氏是允礽的侧福晋。
description.en: Lady Ligiya was a secondary consort of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 允礽是雍正帝（胤禛）的异母兄。
description.en: Yunreng was the elder half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor (Yinzhen).

description.zh-cn: 允礽是允禔的异母弟。
description.en: Yunreng was the younger half-brother of Yinzhi.

description.zh-cn: 允礽是承祜的同母弟。
description.en: Yunreng was the younger full brother of Chenghu.

description.zh-cn: 弘晳是允礽的第二子。
description.en: Hongxi was the second son of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 允礽出生于北京紫禁城。
description.en: Yunreng was born in the Forbidden City, Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 册封年仅一周岁的允礽为皇太子，并亲自教导，寄予厚望。
description.en: Appointed the one-year-old Yunreng as Crown Prince, personally tutored him, and had high expectations for him.

description.zh-cn: 允礽曾两度被立为皇太子。
description.en: Yunreng was twice appointed as Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 奉康熙帝之命担任允礽的老师。
description.en: Was appointed by the Kangxi Emperor to be a tutor to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 奉康熙帝之命担任允礽的老师。
description.en: Was appointed by the Kangxi Emperor to be a tutor to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 向允礽教授理学。
description.en: Taught Neo-Confucianism to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 奉康熙帝之命担任允礽的老师（詹事）。
description.en: Was appointed by the Kangxi Emperor to be a tutor (Supervisor of the Household) to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 奉康熙帝之命担任允礽的老师（少詹事）。
description.en: Was appointed by the Kangxi Emperor to be a tutor (Junior Supervisor of the Household) to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 自14岁起，允礽与皇长子允禔开始了高压的竞争关系。
description.en: From the age of 14, Yunreng entered into a high-pressure, competitive relationship with the eldest prince, Yinzhi.

description.zh-cn: 因允礽在康熙帝亲征噶尔丹期间患病时“侍疾无忧色”，父子情份产生裂痕。
description.en: Because Yunreng showed 'no sign of worry while attending to the sick emperor' during Kangxi's campaign against Galdan, a rift formed in their father-son relationship.

description.zh-cn: 在允礽死后，雍正帝追封其为和硕理密亲王。
description.en: After Yunreng's death, the Yongzheng Emperor posthumously created him Prince Limi of the First Rank.

position.en: Prince Limi of the First Rank (posthumous)

description.zh-cn: 允礽死后被追封为和硕理密亲王。
description.en: Yunreng was posthumously created Prince Limi of the First Rank after his death.

description.zh-cn: 因避雍正帝（胤禛）的名讳，允礽的名字由“胤礽”被改为“允礽”。
description.en: To avoid the naming taboo of the Yongzheng Emperor (Yinzhen), Yunreng's name was changed from 'Yinreng' to 'Yunreng'.

description.zh-cn: 作为维新派的主要发起者和领袖，康有为策划并主导了整个戊戌变法的进程。
description.en: As the main initiator and leader of the reformist faction, Kang Youwei planned and directed the entire process of the Hundred Days' Reform.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌政变后，下令革职并通缉康有为。
description.en: After the Wuxu Coup, she ordered Kang Youwei to be dismissed from his post and be arrested.

description.zh-cn: 1917年，康有为与张勋合作，共同策划并拥立溥仪复辟。
description.en: In 1917, Kang Youwei collaborated with Zhang Xun to jointly plan and support Puyi's restoration.

description.zh-cn: 康有为是张勋复辟的主要同谋者之一，积极参与了拥立溥仪的行动。
description.en: Kang Youwei was one of the main conspirators in the Zhang Xun Restoration, actively participating in the effort to restore Puyi to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 康有为主张君主立宪，反对孙文的革命主张，视其为主要政治对手，并于1905年密令刺杀孙文。晚年，他强烈反对孙文的联俄容共政策。
description.en: Kang Youwei advocated for constitutional monarchy and opposed Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary ideas, viewing him as a primary political rival. In 1905, he secretly ordered Sun's assassination. In his later years, he strongly opposed Sun's policy of allying with Russia and admitting communists.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌变法失败后，康有为在加拿大组织成立保皇会，以“保救大清皇帝”为名，鼓吹君主立宪。
description.en: After the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform, Kang Youwei founded the Baohuanghui (Protect the Emperor Society) in Canada to advocate for constitutional monarchy under the banner of 'saving the Great Qing Emperor'.

description.zh-cn: 在1912年宣统退位、中华民国成立后，康有为持续反对共和制，坚持君主立宪的保皇立场。
description.en: After the abdication of the Xuantong Emperor and the establishment of the Republic of China in 1912, Kang Youwei continuously opposed the republican system, adhering to his royalist stance of constitutional monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 密奏慈禧太后，称康有为等人欲借助日本前首相伊藤博文之力行“合邦”之举，此举促使慈禧太后下定决心发动政变。
description.en: Secretly reported to Empress Dowager Cixi that Kang Youwei and others intended to use the influence of former Japanese Prime Minister Itō Hirobumi to form a 'federation', which prompted Cixi to resolve to launch a coup.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，康有为被视为“中国历史上最大的保皇派”，其墓地被红卫兵掘开，遗骸被掘墓鞭打并游街示众。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Kang Youwei was labeled 'the biggest royalist in Chinese history'. His tomb was desecrated by Red Guards, and his remains were exhumed, beaten, and paraded through the streets.

description.zh-cn: 1966年8月，红卫兵掘开康有为墓，将其遗骸损毁。
description.en: In August 1966, Red Guards excavated Kang Youwei's tomb and destroyed his remains.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清与胡锦涛于1970年2月结婚，两人是清华大学的同班同学。
description.en: Liu Yongqing married Hu Jintao in February 1970; they were classmates at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 胡海青是刘永清的女儿。
description.en: Hu Haiqing is the daughter of Liu Yongqing.

description.zh-cn: 胡海青是胡锦涛的女儿。
description.en: Hu Haiqing is the daughter of Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清于1959年考入清华大学水利系，1965年毕业。
description.en: Liu Yongqing was admitted to the Department of Hydraulic Engineering at Tsinghua University in 1959 and graduated in 1965.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清于1953年入读重庆市巴蜀中学校。
description.en: Liu Yongqing enrolled in Chongqing Bashu Secondary School in 1953.

position.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一配偶
position.en: First Spouse of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记期间，刘永清作为其夫人履行“第一配偶”的职责。
description.en: During Hu Jintao's tenure as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Liu Yongqing fulfilled the duties of the "First Spouse" as his wife.

description.zh-cn: 1982年胡锦涛调入共青团中央后，刘永清在团中央下属的中青旅担任副总经理。
description.en: After Hu Jintao was transferred to the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League in 1982, Liu Yongqing served as the deputy general manager of CYTS, a subsidiary of the league.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清1940年10月3日出生于中华民国时期的山东省。
description.en: Liu Yongqing was born on October 3, 1940, in Shandong Province during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清接替王冶坪（江泽民夫人）成为中华人民共和国第一配偶。
description.en: Liu Yongqing succeeded Wang Yeping (wife of Jiang Zemin) as the First Spouse of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 彭丽媛（习近平夫人）接替刘永清成为中华人民共和国第一配偶。
description.en: Peng Liyuan (wife of Xi Jinping) succeeded Liu Yongqing as the First Spouse of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，刘永清于1969年3月被下放到宁夏青铜峡五七干校。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Liu Yongqing was sent to the May Seventh Cadre School in Qingtongxia, Ningxia, in March 1969.

description.zh-cn: 刘永平是刘永清的姐姐。
description.en: Liu Yongping is Liu Yongqing's elder sister.

description.zh-cn: 常芝青是刘永清的舅舅。
description.en: Chang Zhiging is Liu Yongqing's maternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 常芝青与姚依林交好。
description.en: Chang Zhiging was on good terms with Yao Yilin.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清与朱琳是重庆市巴蜀中学校的校友。
description.en: Liu Yongqing and Zhu Lin were schoolmates at Chongqing Bashu Secondary School.

description.zh-cn: 朱琳是李鹏的夫人。
description.en: Zhu Lin is the wife of Li Peng.

description.zh-cn: 胡海峰现任中华人民共和国民政部副部长。
description.en: Hu Haifeng currently serves as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡海青的丈夫是茅道林。
description.en: Hu Haiqing's husband is Mao Daolin.

description.zh-cn: 2006年，刘永清与时任美国第一夫人劳拉·布什在白宫会面。
description.en: In 2006, Liu Yongqing met with then-U.S. First Lady Laura Bush at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 1998年6月25日，刘永清以胡锦涛夫人身份首次亮相，迎接时任美国总统比尔·克林顿。
description.en: On June 25, 1998, Liu Yongqing made her first public appearance as Hu Jintao's wife to welcome then-U.S. President Bill Clinton.

description.zh-cn: 龚正作为国家教委出国访问学者，赴美国金门大学进修公共管理专业。
description.en: As a visiting scholar sponsored by the State Education Commission, Gong Zheng went to Golden Gate University in the United States for advanced studies in public administration.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任杭州市委书记期间，张鸿铭任副书记兼市长。
description.en: While Gong Zheng was the Party Secretary of Hangzhou, Zhang Hongming served as the Deputy Secretary and Mayor.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任山东省省长期间，刘家义任省委书记。
description.en: While Gong Zheng was the Governor of Shandong Province, Liu Jiayi served as the Provincial Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任上海市市长期间，李强任市委书记。
description.en: While Gong Zheng served as Mayor of Shanghai, Li Qiang was the Municipal Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任上海市市长期间，陈吉宁任市委书记。
description.en: While Gong Zheng serves as Mayor of Shanghai, Chen Jining is the Municipal Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 在上海台北双城论坛上会面并握手。
description.en: Met and shook hands at the Shanghai-Taipei City Forum.

description.zh-cn: 刘鹤是第十九届中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: Liu He was a member of the 19th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 马英九于1968年6月正式加入中国国民党。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou officially joined the Kuomintang in June 1968.

description.zh-cn: 马英九毕业于国立台湾大学法律学系法学组，获得法学学士学位。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou graduated from the Law Department of National Taiwan University with a Bachelor of Laws degree.

description.zh-cn: 马英九于1977年获得纽约大学法学硕士学位。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou obtained a Master of Laws degree from New York University in 1977.

description.zh-cn: 马英九于1981年获得哈佛大学司法学博士学位。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou obtained a Doctor of Juridical Science (S.J.D.) degree from Harvard University in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 1981年，在钱复的推荐下，马英九返回台湾担任时任总统蒋经国的英文翻译。
description.en: In 1981, under the recommendation of Fredrick Chien, Ma Ying-jeou returned to Taiwan to serve as the English translator for then-President Chiang Ching-kuo.

description.zh-cn: 2000年国民党总统选举败选后，原属李登辉派系的马英九率先向李登辉逼宫，要求其辞去党主席职务。
description.en: After the KMT's defeat in the 2000 presidential election, Ma Ying-jeou, originally part of Lee Teng-hui's faction, led the charge to force Lee to resign as party chairman.

description.zh-cn: 2007年，马英九因特别费案被起诉而辞去中国国民党主席职务。
description.en: In 2007, Ma Ying-jeou resigned as Chairman of the Kuomintang after being indicted in the special allowance fund case.

description.zh-cn: 2009年6月1日，在萨尔瓦多卸任总统的国宴上，马英九与时任美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿会面。
description.en: On June 1, 2009, at a state banquet for the outgoing president of El Salvador, Ma Ying-jeou met with then-U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton.

description.zh-cn: 马英九出席竞选总部成立大会，支持国民党2024年总统选举候选人侯友宜。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou attended the campaign headquarters establishment rally to support KMT's 2024 presidential candidate Hou Yu-ih.

description.zh-cn: 马英九作为见证人，参与并协调侯友宜与柯文哲关于2024年总统选举的政党协商。
description.en: As a witness, Ma Ying-jeou participated in and coordinated the party negotiations between Hou Yu-ih and Ko Wen-je regarding the 2024 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 马英九多次表示反对并无法接受“一国两制”方案。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou has repeatedly stated his opposition to and unacceptance of the 'one country, two systems' formula.

position.en: President of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 马英九担任第十二、十三任中华民国总统。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou served as the 12th and 13th President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 马英九曾两度担任中国国民党主席。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou served as the Chairman of the Kuomintang on two separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 马英九担任第二、三届直辖市民选台北市市长。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou served as the 2nd and 3rd popularly elected Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 在在景山学校完成小学、初中与高中学业。
description.en: Completed primary, junior high, and senior high school education at Beijing Jingshan School.

description.zh-cn: 在基本系进修并获得大专学位。
description.en: Studied in the basic department and obtained an associate degree.

description.zh-cn: 与许其亮一同担任中共中央军事委员会副主席和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: Served alongside Xu Qiliang as Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Military Commission and the PRC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 与何卫东一同担任中共中央军事委员会副主席和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: Has been serving alongside He Weidong as Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Military Commission and the PRC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张又侠接替范长龙出任中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: Zhang Youxia succeeded Fan Changlong as Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张又侠接替常万全出任中国人民解放军总装备部部长。
