description.en: Zhang Youxia succeeded Chang Wanquan as Minister of the PLA General Armament Department.

description.zh-cn: 张又侠卸任中央军委装备发展部部长后，该职务由李尚福接任。
description.en: After Zhang Youxia stepped down as Minister of the Equipment Development Department of the CMC, he was succeeded by Li Shangfu.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，时任沈阳军区司令员的张又侠陪同国防部长梁光烈访问美国。
description.en: In 2012, Zhang Youxia, then Commander of the Shenyang Military Region, accompanied Minister of National Defense Liang Guanglie on a visit to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 作为连长参加1979年中越战争，并因表现出色获得晋升。
description.en: Participated in the 1979 Sino-Vietnamese War as a company commander and was promoted for his outstanding performance.

description.zh-cn: 在老山战役中担任一一九团团长，指挥部队攻占关键高地，为战役取得决定性胜利立下首功。
description.en: Served as the commander of the 119th Regiment during the Battle of Laoshan, leading his troops to capture key high grounds and playing a primary role in the decisive victory of the battle.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁与白崇禧、黄绍竑合作，统一广西全省，是新桂系的核心领导人物。
description.en: Li Zongren cooperated with Bai Chongxi and Huang Shaohong to unify the entire province of Guangxi; they were the core leaders of the New Guangxi clique.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁在1929年的蒋桂战争和1930年的中原大战中与蒋介石为敌。在1948年的副总统选举中，他违背蒋的意愿参选并击败了蒋支持的候选人孙科。
description.en: Li Zongren was an enemy of Chiang Kai-shek in the Chiang-Gui War of 1929 and the Central Plains War of 1930. In the 1948 vice presidential election, he ran against Chiang's wishes and defeated the Chiang-backed candidate, Sun Fo.

description.zh-cn: 在1948年中华民国副总统选举中，李宗仁经过四轮投票最终击败了蒋介石支持的孙科，当选为副总统。
description.en: In the 1948 Republic of China vice presidential election, Li Zongren defeated the Chiang Kai-shek-backed Sun Fo after four rounds of voting to become Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 1952年监察院通过对李宗仁的弹劾案，指其“违法失职”。此案最终导致其于1954年被国民大会罢免。
description.en: In 1952, the Control Yuan passed an impeachment case against Li Zongren for 'violation of law and dereliction of duty'. This case ultimately led to his removal by the National Assembly in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁在抗日战争期间指挥第五战区部队取得台儿庄会战的胜利，使其名震一时，极大地提升了他的声望。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Li Zongren commanded the troops of the 5th War Area to victory in the Battle of Taierzhuang, which made him famous and greatly enhanced his prestige.

description.zh-cn: 国民党在第二次国共内战中的失败，导致李宗仁作为代总统的政府垮台，并最终迫使他流亡美国。
description.en: The KMT's defeat in the Second Chinese Civil War led to the collapse of the government with Li Zongren as acting president, ultimately forcing him into exile in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来促成并具体安排了李宗仁于1965年从海外返回中国大陆，并在“文化大革命”期间对他予以保护。
description.en: Zhou Enlai facilitated and specifically arranged for Li Zongren's return from overseas to mainland China in 1965, and provided him with protection during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁在美国期间通过口述自己的生平经历，促成了《李宗仁回忆录》的诞生。
description.en: During his time in the United States, Li Zongren's oral recounting of his life experiences led to the creation of "The Memoirs of Li Tsung-jen".

description.zh-cn: 唐德刚作为历史学家，对李宗仁进行口述历史采访，并执笔记录整理成书，出版了《李宗仁回忆录》。
description.en: As a historian, T. K. Tong conducted oral history interviews with Li Zongren, and then wrote, compiled, and published "The Memoirs of Li Tsung-jen".

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁是新桂系军阀集团的首领。
description.en: Li Zongren was the leader of the New Guangxi clique warlord group.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，李宗仁担任第五战区司令长官。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Li Zongren served as the Commander-in-Chief of the 5th War Area.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁当选为行宪后第一任中华民国副总统。
description.en: Li Zongren was elected as the first Vice President of the Republic of China under the Constitution.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋介石引退后，李宗仁以副总统身份代理总统职权。
description.en: After Chiang Kai-shek's retirement, Li Zongren, as Vice President, acted as the President.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在2002年至2007年任中共浙江省委书记期间，黄坤明先后主政湖州、嘉兴，是其下属。黄坤明被认为是习近平的重要亲信之一。
description.en: While Xi Jinping was the Party Secretary of Zhejiang from 2002 to 2007, Huang Kunming served as the head of Huzhou and Jiaxing, making him a subordinate. Huang is considered a key confidant of Xi.

description.zh-cn: 习近平出任中共中央总书记后不久，将黄坤明上调至中共中央宣传部任职。
description.en: Shortly after Xi Jinping became General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, he promoted Huang Kunming to a position in the Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明被广泛认为是闽江新军的主要成员。
description.en: Huang Kunming is widely regarded as a key member of the Minjiang New Army.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，黄坤明与时任三明市市长蔡奇一同被调往浙江省任职。
description.en: In 1999, Huang Kunming, along with Cai Qi, who was then the mayor of Sanming, were both transferred to Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明接替李希出任中共广东省委书记。
description.en: Huang Kunming succeeded Li Xi as the Party Secretary of Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 在刘奇葆担任中共中央宣传部部长期间，黄坤明担任其副手。
description.en: While Liu Qibao was the Minister of the Central Propaganda Department, Huang Kunming served as his deputy.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明接替刘奇葆出任中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Huang Kunming succeeded Liu Qibao as the Minister of the Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 据《南华早报》原主编王向伟撰文称，黄坤明曾于2022年底向习近平反映尽快结束清零政策的紧迫性，从而间接推动了该政策的终结。
description.en: According to an article by Wang Xiangwei, former editor-in-chief of the South China Morning Post, Huang Kunming reported the urgency of ending the zero-COVID policy to Xi Jinping at the end of 2022, thereby indirectly contributing to its termination.

description.zh-cn: 1988年至1993年就读于清华大学热能工程系空调专业。
description.en: Studied in the Air Conditioning major of the Department of Thermal Engineering at Tsinghua University from 1988 to 1993.

description.zh-cn: 从清华大学毕业后，胡海清到清华同方工作。
description.en: After graduating from Tsinghua University, Hu Haiqing worked at Tsinghua Tongfang.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛曾坚决反对女儿胡海清出国留学，并在其擅自前往比利时后，勒令其回国。
description.en: Hu Jintao strongly opposed his daughter Hu Haiqing's plan to study abroad and ordered her to return to China after she went to Belgium without his permission.

description.zh-cn: 移居美国后，胡海清与丈夫茅道临拒绝了父亲胡锦涛多次要求他们回国的请求。
description.en: After moving to the United States, Hu Haiqing and her husband Mao Daolin refused her father Hu Jintao's repeated requests for them to return to China.

description.zh-cn: 移居美国后，茅道临与妻子胡海清拒绝了岳父胡锦涛多次要求他们回国的请求。
description.en: After moving to the United States, Mao Daolin and his wife Hu Haiqing refused his father-in-law Hu Jintao's repeated requests for them to return to China.

description.zh-cn: 田凤山于2003年10月被双规。
description.en: Tian Fengshan was subjected to 'Shuanggui' in October 2003.

description.zh-cn: 尉健行将金铮反映的关于胡海清承包医院一事转告了胡锦涛。
description.en: Wei Jianxing relayed the information from Jin Zheng about Hu Haiqing's contracting of the hospital to Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成与林徽因于1928年结婚，直至1955年林徽因逝世。
description.en: Liang Sicheng married Lin Huiyin in 1928, and they remained married until her death in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成于1962年与林洙结婚，直至1972年自己逝世。
description.en: Liang Sicheng married Lin Zhu in 1962, and they remained married until his own death in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 1946年回国后创办了清华大学营建学系（建筑系）。
description.en: After returning to China in 1946, he founded the Department of Construction (Architecture) at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成被作为“反动学术权威”受到批判、抄家，并在贫病交加中去世。
description.en: Liang Sicheng was criticized and his home was ransacked as a 'reactionary academic authority', and he died in poverty and illness.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，梁思成为躲避战乱，被迫离开北平，携全家前往西南地区。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Liang Sicheng was forced to leave Beiping and flee to the southwest with his family to escape the war.

description.zh-cn: 时任北洋政府陆军部次长金永炎的轿车撞伤了骑摩托车的梁思成，导致其右腿骨折，脊椎受伤，并最终落下残疾。
description.en: A car belonging to Jin Yongyan, then Deputy Minister of the Army of the Beiyang Government, hit Liang Sicheng on his motorcycle, causing a fracture in his right leg, spinal injuries, and leaving him with a permanent disability.

position.en: Head of the Department of Architecture at Northeastern University

description.zh-cn: 梁思成在东北大学任教时，张学良时任该校校长。
description.en: When Liang Sicheng taught at Northeastern University, Zhang Xueliang was the president of the university.

description.zh-cn: 共同提出《关于中央人民政府行政中心位置的建议》，即“梁陈方案”，旨在保护北京古城。
description.en: They jointly proposed the 'Proposal on the Location of the Central People's Government Administrative Center', known as the 'Liang-Chen Proposal', aiming to protect the ancient city of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 主持了首都人民英雄纪念碑的建筑设计。
description.en: He presided over the architectural design of the Monument to the People's Heroes in the capital.

description.zh-cn: 据称，梁思成曾建议盟军在对日本进行轰炸时保护奈良的古建筑，但此说法存在争议，缺乏直接证据支持。
description.en: It is claimed that Liang Sicheng advised the Allied forces to protect the ancient architecture of Nara during the bombing of Japan, but this claim is disputed and lacks direct supporting evidence.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义于1915年入保定陆军军官学校第5期步兵科，1918年毕业。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi entered the 5th Infantry Division of Baoding Military Academy in 1915 and graduated in 1918.

position.zh-cn: 晋军军官、第二战区北路军总司令
position.en: Jin Army Officer, Commander of the Northern Route Army of the Second War Area

description.zh-cn: 傅作义毕业后加入阎锡山领导的晋军，长期在其麾下任职，直至1938年12月出任第八战区副司令长官后摆脱其控制。
description.en: After graduation, Fu Zuoyi joined the Jin Army led by Yan Xishan and served under him for a long time, until he broke free from his control after being appointed Deputy Commander of the Eighth War Area in December 1938.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义长期在阎锡山的晋军中服役并屡立战功，从中校升至中将。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi served in Yan Xishan's Jin Army for a long time, earning numerous military merits and rising from lieutenant colonel to lieutenant general.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义在中原大战中作为阎锡山部将与蒋介石的中央军作战；在第二次国共内战期间，作为华北国军最高指挥官与共产党作战，服从于身为国民政府首脑的蒋介石，但随着战局不利，最终选择和平解放北平，与蒋介石决裂。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi fought against Chiang Kai-shek's Central Army as a general of Yan Xishan during the Central Plains War; during the Second Chinese Civil War, as the supreme commander of the Nationalist forces in North China, he fought against the Communists under Chiang Kai-shek's leadership, but eventually chose the peaceful liberation of Beiping as the war situation deteriorated, breaking with Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义指挥其部队在绥远击退了伪蒙军的进攻，取得了百灵庙大捷。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi commanded his troops to repel the attack of the puppet Mongol army in Suiyuan, achieving a major victory at Bailingmiao.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义仿照中国共产党领导的八路军的建军经验，在其部队中成立政治工作机构，并制定类似《三大纪律八项注意》的纪律。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi modeled the army-building experience of the Eighth Route Army led by the Communist Party of China, establishing political work agencies in his troops and formulating disciplines similar to the 'Three Main Rules of Discipline and Eight Points for Attention'.

description.zh-cn: 在平津战役中，傅作义的部队接连遭受失败，其嫡系部队损失惨重，最终促使其决定与中共和谈。
description.en: During the Pingjin Campaign, Fu Zuoyi's forces suffered successive defeats, with his core troops sustaining heavy losses, which ultimately prompted him to negotiate peace with the Communists.

description.zh-cn: 1947年12月，蒋介石任命傅作义为华北剿匪总司令部总司令，统一指挥华北五省军队。
description.en: In December 1947, Chiang Kai-shek appointed Fu Zuoyi as the Commander-in-Chief of the North China Bandit Suppression Headquarters, unifying the command of troops in five provinces of North China.

description.zh-cn: 傅冬是傅作义的长女。
description.en: Fu Dong is Fu Zuoyi's eldest daughter.

description.zh-cn: 傅冬作为中共地下党员，在其父傅作义身边工作，不断进行劝说，为促成北平和平解放起了重要作用。
description.en: As an underground member of the CCP, Fu Dong worked alongside her father Fu Zuoyi and continuously persuaded him, playing a crucial role in bringing about the peaceful liberation of Beiping.

description.zh-cn: 董其武是傅作义的部下，曾接替傅作义担任绥远省政府主席，并在傅作义的影响下率部起义。
description.en: Dong Qiwu was a subordinate of Fu Zuoyi, succeeded him as the Chairman of the Suiyuan Provincial Government, and led his troops in an uprising under Fu's influence.

position.zh-cn: 水利部/水利电力部部长
position.en: Minister of Water Resources / Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，傅作义长期担任水利部及后来的水利电力部部长，是时任国务院总理周恩来的下属。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Fu Zuoyi served for a long time as the Minister of Water Resources and later the Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power, subordinate to then-Premier Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发之初，周恩来将傅作义列入应予保护的干部名单中，对其进行保护。
description.en: At the beginning of the Cultural Revolution, Zhou Enlai included Fu Zuoyi in a list of cadres to be protected, thereby protecting him.

description.zh-cn: 据蒋介石日记记载，傅作义于1963年派专人带去亲笔书写的“悉贡所能”四字，向蒋介石秘密表达意向。
description.en: According to Chiang Kai-shek's diary, Fu Zuoyi sent a special messenger in 1963 with a handwritten note of four characters, 'sī gòng suǒ néng' (I will do all I can), secretly conveying his intentions to Chiang.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义的堂弟傅作恭在甘肃夹边沟农场劳动教养期间，因三年大饥荒而去世。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi's cousin, Fu Zuogong, died during the Great Famine while undergoing re-education through labor at Jiabiangou Farm in Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，傅作义作为国民党高级将领，与毛泽东领导的共产党军队为敌，并曾发表致毛泽东的公开电进行谴责。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, Fu Zuoyi, as a high-ranking Nationalist general, was an enemy of the Communist forces led by Mao Zedong and once issued a public telegram condemning him.

description.zh-cn: 宋霭龄是宋子文的大姐。
description.en: Soong Ai-ling is T. V. Soong's eldest sister.

description.zh-cn: 宋美龄是宋子文的妹妹。
description.en: Soong Mei-ling is T. V. Soong's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 宋子良是宋子文的弟弟。
description.en: Song Ziliang is T. V. Soong's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是蒋中正的妻兄（大舅子）。
description.en: T. V. Soong was Chiang Kai-shek's brother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是孔祥熙的妻弟。
description.en: T. V. Soong was H. H. Kung's brother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是孙中山的妻弟。
description.en: T. V. Soong was Sun Yat-sen's brother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 早年于上海圣约翰大学求学。
description.en: Studied at St. John's University in Shanghai in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 1915年于哈佛大学经济学毕业。
description.en: Graduated from Harvard University with a degree in economics in 1915.

description.zh-cn: 在哥伦比亚大学研究所就读。
description.en: Attended graduate school at Columbia University.

description.zh-cn: 1923年起，宋子文担任孙中山的英文秘书。
description.en: Beginning in 1923, T. V. Soong served as Sun Yat-sen's English Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文曾多次担任行政院副院长、代理院长及院长职务。
description.en: T. V. Soong served multiple times as Vice Premier, Acting Premier, and Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 1933年，宋子文因在军费及预算问题上与蒋介石发生激烈冲突，甚至被蒋掌掴，遂辞去财长等职务。
description.en: In 1933, T. V. Soong had a fierce conflict with Chiang Kai-shek over military spending and budget issues, was even slapped by Chiang, and subsequently resigned from his post as Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 1935年4月起，宋子文接任中国银行董事长。
description.en: From April 1935, T. V. Soong took over as the Chairman of the Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文与张学良是好友，曾在西安事变中出面调解。
description.en: T. V. Soong and Zhang Xueliang were friends, and Soong mediated during the Xi'an Incident.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文在西安事变时飞赴西安参与谈判调解。
description.en: During the Xi'an Incident, T. V. Soong flew to Xi'an to participate in negotiations and mediation.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文代表国民政府与时任美国财政部长摩根索签订了五亿美元借款协议。
description.en: T. V. Soong, on behalf of the Nationalist Government, signed a $500 million loan agreement with then-U.S. Secretary of the Treasury Henry Morgenthau Jr.

description.zh-cn: 1945年，宋子文赴苏联同斯大林会谈，并签订《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: In 1945, T. V. Soong went to the Soviet Union to meet with Stalin and sign the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文代表中华民国政府签订了《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: T. V. Soong signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance on behalf of the government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡适在日记中评价宋子文为“如此自私自利的小人”，显示了对其个人的负面看法。
description.en: Hu Shih described T. V. Soong in his diary as 'such a selfish villain,' indicating a negative personal opinion of him.

description.zh-cn: 据称杜鲁门曾大骂宋家为“贼”，但此说法的真实性存疑。
description.en: Truman allegedly called the Soong family 'thieves,' although the authenticity of this claim is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文于1947年9月至1949年1月担任广东省政府主席。
description.en: T. V. Soong served as the Chairman of the Guangdong Provincial Government from September 1947 to January 1949.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文出生于上海市同仁医院。
description.en: T. V. Soong was born in Shanghai Tongren Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文与时任美国总统罗斯福会谈，罗斯福表示愿意向中国提供援助。
description.en: T. V. Soong met with then-U.S. President Roosevelt, who expressed willingness to provide aid to China.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是宋氏家族的核心成员之一。
description.en: T. V. Soong was one of the core members of the Soong family.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是唐高宗李治的女儿。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the daughter of Emperor Gaozong of Tang (Li Zhi).

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是武则天的女儿。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the daughter of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是唐中宗李显的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Emperor Zhongzong of Tang (Li Xian).

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是安定思公主的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Princess Andingsi.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是李弘的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Li Hong.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是李贤的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Li Xian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主于681年下嫁薛绍，此段婚姻因688年薛绍被赐死而结束。
description.en: Princess Taiping married Xue Shao in 681. The marriage ended with Xue Shao's forced death in 688.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主于690年改嫁武攸暨，此段婚姻因712年武攸暨去世而结束。
description.en: Princess Taiping remarried to Wu Youji in 690. The marriage ended with Wu Youji's death in 712.

description.zh-cn: 薛崇简是太平公主的儿子。
description.en: Xue Chongjian was the son of Princess Taiping.

description.zh-cn: 薛崇简是薛绍的儿子。
description.en: Xue Chongjian was the son of Xue Shao.

description.zh-cn: 薛绍是城阳公主的儿子。
description.en: Xue Shao was the son of Princess Chengyang.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主因参与诛杀张昌宗、张易之兄弟而在神龙政变中有功。
description.en: Princess Taiping was credited for her role in the Shenlong Coup due to her participation in the execution of the Zhang brothers (Zhang Changzong and Zhang Yizhi).

description.zh-cn: 因薛绍的兄长薛𫖮参与李冲谋反，武则天下令将薛绍杖责一百，饿死狱中。
description.en: Because Xue Shao's brother, Xue Yi, participated in Li Chong's rebellion, Wu Zetian ordered Xue Shao to be caned one hundred times and starved to death in prison.

description.zh-cn: 安乐公主曾试图诬陷太平公主，两人敌对关系明显白热化。
description.en: Princess Anle once attempted to frame Princess Taiping, and their adversarial relationship became overtly intense.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主与上官婉儿一同草拟中宗遗诏，在上官婉儿被杀后，太平公主十分哀伤，并出资厚葬及搜集其文集。
description.en: Princess Taiping and Shangguan Wan'er jointly drafted Emperor Zhongzong's final edict. After Shangguan Wan'er's execution, Princess Taiping was deeply saddened, funded her grand burial, and collected her literary works.

description.zh-cn: 薛崇简是李隆基（后来的唐玄宗）的党羽，在太平公主倒台后仅被流放而得以幸免。
description.en: Xue Chongjian was a partisan of Li Longji (later Emperor Xuanzong) and was spared execution, only being exiled after Princess Taiping's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 贺兰敏之在太平公主年幼时曾逼奸其随行宫女（一说为太平公主本人），此事是导致其被处死的原因之一。
description.en: When Princess Taiping was young, Helan Minzhi assaulted her lady-in-waiting (some sources say it was the princess herself), which was one of the reasons leading to his execution.

description.zh-cn: 因贺兰敏之逼奸太平公主的宫女等劣迹，武则天大怒，下令将其流放并于途中处死。
description.en: Enraged by Helan Minzhi's misdeeds, including the assault on Princess Taiping's lady-in-waiting, Wu Zetian ordered him to be exiled and executed en route.

description.zh-cn: 史书记载太平公主与崔湜有私交。
description.en: Historical records indicate that Princess Taiping had an intimate relationship with Cui Shi.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主将张昌宗进献给母亲武则天，使其成为权倾一时的男宠。
description.en: Princess Taiping introduced Zhang Changzong to her mother Wu Zetian, enabling him to become a powerful male favorite.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝刘启是汉文帝刘恒的长子。
description.en: Emperor Jing (Liu Qi) was the eldest son of Emperor Wen (Liu Heng).

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝刘启的母亲是汉文帝的窦皇后。
description.en: The mother of Emperor Jing (Liu Qi) was Empress Dou of Emperor Wen.

description.zh-cn: 窦皇后是汉文帝的皇后。
description.en: Empress Dou was the empress of Emperor Wen.

description.zh-cn: 吴王刘濞是七国之乱的主要发起者和领导者。
description.en: Liu Pi, the King of Wu, was the main initiator and leader of the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 楚王刘戊与吴王刘濞一同领导了七国之乱。
description.en: Liu Wu, the King of Chu, co-led the Rebellion of the Seven States with Liu Pi, the King of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 在七国之乱爆发后，汉景帝为平息叛乱，采纳袁盎等人的建议，将晁错腰斩于东市。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Rebellion of the Seven States, Emperor Jing, in an attempt to quell the rebellion, adopted the advice of Yuan Ang and others and had Chao Cuo executed by waist-chop at the East Market.

description.zh-cn: 袁盎是晁错的政敌，他向汉景帝献策诛杀晁错以平叛乱。
description.en: Yuan Ang was a political rival of Chao Cuo and advised Emperor Jing to execute Chao Cuo to suppress the rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 刘启为太子时，因与吴国太子刘贤下棋发生争执，用棋盘打死了刘贤。
description.en: When Liu Qi was the crown prince, he killed Liu Xian, the Crown Prince of Wu, by striking him with a chessboard during a dispute over a game.

description.zh-cn: 刘贤是吴王刘濞的太子。
description.en: Liu Xian was the crown prince of Liu Pi, the King of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 因其子刘贤被太子刘启打死，吴王刘濞从此怨恨刘启和朝廷。
description.en: Because his son Liu Xian was killed by Crown Prince Liu Qi, Liu Pi, the King of Wu, harbored resentment towards Liu Qi and the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝派太尉周亚夫领兵，在三个月内成功平定了七国之乱。
description.en: Emperor Jing dispatched Grand Marshal Zhou Yafu to lead troops, and he successfully suppressed the Rebellion of the Seven States within three months.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝派大将军窦婴与太尉周亚夫一同镇压七国之乱。
description.en: Emperor Jing dispatched General-in-chief Dou Ying along with Grand Marshal Zhou Yafu to suppress the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 平定七国之乱后，周亚夫因与汉景帝意见不合而遭猜忌，后被以谋反罪下狱，绝食而死。
description.en: After suppressing the Rebellion of the Seven States, Zhou Yafu was suspected by Emperor Jing due to disagreements, later imprisoned on charges of treason, and died on a hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 前150年，汉景帝废黜太子刘荣，将其贬为临江王，后刘荣被以“侵占庙地”罪名逼迫自杀。
description.en: In 150 BCE, Emperor Jing deposed Crown Prince Liu Rong, demoting him to King of Linjiang. Liu Rong was later forced to commit suicide on the charge of 'encroaching on temple grounds'.

description.zh-cn: 刘荣是汉景帝的长子。
description.en: Liu Rong was the eldest son of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 刘荣的生母是汉景帝的妃嫔栗姬。
description.en: Liu Rong's birth mother was Consort Li, a consort of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 栗姬是汉景帝的妃嫔。
description.en: Consort Li was a consort of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝刘彻是汉景帝的儿子。
description.en: Emperor Wu (Liu Che) was the son of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝刘彻的生母是汉景帝的王皇后。
description.en: The birth mother of Emperor Wu (Liu Che) was Empress Wang of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 前150年四月，汉景帝立王氏为皇后。
description.en: In the fourth month of 150 BCE, Emperor Jing installed Lady Wang as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 薄皇后是汉景帝的第一位皇后，于前151年被废。
description.en: Empress Bo was the first empress of Emperor Jing and was deposed in 151 BCE.

description.zh-cn: 周亚夫在汉景帝时期先后担任太尉（前154-前149）和丞相（前150-前147）。
description.en: Zhou Yafu served Emperor Jing successively as Grand Marshal (154-149 BCE) and Chancellor (150-147 BCE).

description.zh-cn: 晁错在汉景帝时期担任御史大夫。
description.en: Chao Cuo served as Grandee Secretary during the reign of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 长沙定王刘发是汉景帝的儿子，母唐姬。
description.en: Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha, was the son of Emperor Jing and Consort Tang.

description.zh-cn: 东汉光武帝刘秀是长沙定王刘发的后裔。
description.en: Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu) of the Eastern Han was a descendant of Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 中山靖王刘胜是汉景帝的儿子，母贾夫人。
description.en: Liu Sheng, King Jing of Zhongshan, was the son of Emperor Jing and Lady Jia.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉昭烈帝刘备是中山靖王刘胜的后裔。
description.en: Emperor Zhaolie (Liu Bei) of Shu Han was a descendant of Liu Sheng, King Jing of Zhongshan.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，林义雄担任郭雨新竞选立法委员团队的法律顾问。
description.en: In 1975, Lin Yi-hsiung served as the legal counsel for Kuo Yu-hsin's legislative election campaign team.

description.zh-cn: 美丽岛事件发生后，林义雄于1979年12月13日遭到政府逮捕，后被军事法庭判处12年有期徒刑。
description.en: After the Kaohsiung Incident, Lin Yi-hsiung was arrested by the government on December 13, 1979, and later sentenced to 12 years in prison by a military tribunal.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄的长女林奂均在林宅血案中身受重伤。
description.en: Lin Yi-hsiung's eldest daughter, Lin Huan-chun, was severely injured in the Lin family massacre.

description.zh-cn: 林宅血案发生后，时任总统蒋经国同意让林义雄交保出狱以料理丧事。
description.en: After the Lin family massacre, then-President Chiang Ching-kuo agreed to release Lin Yi-hsiung on bail to handle funeral arrangements.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉总统发布特赦令，宣告林义雄等人的美丽岛事件罪刑无效。
description.en: President Lee Teng-hui issued a special pardon, declaring the criminal sentences of Lin Yi-hsiung and others from the Kaohsiung Incident null and void.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄于1986年加入民主进步党，后因理念不合于2006年退出。
description.en: Lin Yi-hsiung joined the Democratic Progressive Party in 1986 and later withdrew in 2006 due to ideological differences.

description.zh-cn: 在1996年总统选举的民主进步党党内初选中，彭明敏击败林义雄，成为民进党总统候选人。
description.en: In the Democratic Progressive Party's primary for the 1996 presidential election, Peng Ming-min defeated Lin Yi-hsiung to become the DPP's presidential candidate.

description.zh-cn: 因反对时任党主席许信良的修宪方向，林义雄公开批评许信良并提出“罢免许主席”行动。
description.en: Due to his opposition to the constitutional amendment direction of then-DPP Chairman Hsu Hsin-liang, Lin Yi-hsiung publicly criticized Hsu and proposed a 'Recall Chairman Hsu' campaign.

description.zh-cn: 担任党主席期间，林义雄通过《台湾前途决议文》并强势主导党内提名，为陈水扁参选并当选总统铺平了道路，促成了台湾首次政党轮替。
description.en: During his chairmanship, Lin Yi-hsiung pushed through the 'Resolution on Taiwan's Future' and strongly guided the party's nomination process, paving the way for Chen Shui-bian's candidacy and election as president, which led to Taiwan's first party alternation.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁于2000年当选总统，完成了台湾首次政党轮替。
description.en: Chen Shui-bian's election as president in 2000 completed Taiwan's first party alternation.

description.zh-cn: 在在野党压力下，陈水扁政府妥协，宣布恢复兴建龙门核能发电厂。
description.en: Under pressure from opposition parties, the Chen Shui-bian administration compromised and announced the resumption of the construction of the Lungmen Nuclear Power Plant.

description.zh-cn: 因陈水扁政府宣布恢复兴建核四，林义雄无法接受并辞去民进党首席顾问，双方关系出现裂痕。
description.en: Due to the Chen Shui-bian administration's announcement to resume construction of the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant, Lin Yi-hsiung found it unacceptable and resigned as chief advisor to the DPP, leading to a rift in their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄发起“诚信立国”运动，并以绝食静坐等方式，成功推动立法院席次减半的修宪案。
description.en: Lin Yi-hsiung initiated the 'Build the Nation on Integrity' movement and, through methods like hunger strikes and sit-ins, successfully pushed for the constitutional amendment to halve the number of legislative seats.

description.zh-cn: 在2006年民进党主席补选中，林义雄发表公开信，呼吁有意参选总统者不宜参选党主席，此举被视为针对游锡堃。
description.en: In the 2006 DPP chairmanship by-election, Lin Yi-hsiung issued an open letter urging those with presidential ambitions not to run for party chairman, a move seen as targeting Yu Shyi-kun.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，林义雄出面劝进蔡英文参选民主进步党主席。
description.en: In 2008, Lin Yi-hsiung came forward to persuade Tsai Ing-wen to run for the chairmanship of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄的无限期禁食行动最终迫使马英九政府于2014年4月27日宣布核四一号机封存、二号机停工。
description.en: Lin Yi-hsiung's indefinite hunger strike ultimately forced the Ma Ying-jeou administration to announce on April 27, 2014, that Unit 1 of the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant would be sealed and Unit 2 construction would be halted.

description.zh-cn: 太阳花学运期间，林义雄前往立法院议场外静坐声援，直至运动结束。
description.en: During the Sunflower Student Movement, Lin Yi-hsiung went to sit in protest outside the Legislative Yuan in support of the movement until it concluded.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未是诗人艾青的儿子。
description.en: Ai Weiwei is the son of the poet Ai Qing.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未是高瑛的儿子。
description.en: Ai Weiwei is the son of Gao Ying.

description.zh-cn: 路青是艾未未的配偶。
description.en: Lu Qing is the spouse of Ai Weiwei.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未于1957年5月18日出生于北京。
description.en: Ai Weiwei was born in Beijing on May 18, 1957.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未于1978年入读北京电影学院动画系。
description.en: Ai Weiwei enrolled in the Animation Department of the Beijing Film Academy in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未于1981年前往美国，后入读纽约帕森设计学院。
description.en: Ai Weiwei went to the United States in 1981 and later enrolled at Parsons School of Design in New York.

description.zh-cn: 中国当局于2011年4月3日将艾未未秘密关押81天，释放后发起“发课税案”对其进行打压，并扣押其护照直至2015年7月。
description.en: Chinese authorities secretly detained Ai Weiwei for 81 days starting April 3, 2011. After his release, they launched the 'Fake Tax Case' to suppress him and confiscated his passport until July 2015.

description.zh-cn: 2009年8月，成都公安人员在酒店殴打艾未未致其脑出血。2011年4月，北京公安主导了对艾未未的秘密关押和后续的税务案件调查。
description.en: In August 2009, Chengdu police officers assaulted Ai Weiwei in a hotel, causing a cerebral hemorrhage. In April 2011, Beijing police led his secret detention and the subsequent tax case investigation.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，时任北京市公安局局长傅政华主导了对艾未未的审讯和迫害。
description.en: According to reports, Fu Zhenghua, then director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau, led the interrogation and persecution of Ai Weiwei.

description.zh-cn: 汶川大地震中大量校舍坍塌导致学生遇难，促使艾未未发起了公民调查。
description.en: The collapse of numerous school buildings during the Wenchuan earthquake, which resulted in student casualties, prompted Ai Weiwei to launch the citizens' investigation.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未应律师邀请，作为证人前往成都为四川维权人士谭作人出庭作证。
description.en: At the invitation of a lawyer, Ai Weiwei traveled to Chengdu to appear in court as a witness for Sichuan rights activist Tan Zuoren.

description.zh-cn: 在杨佳被处决后，艾未未撰写博客并制作纪录片《一个孤僻的人》，质疑杨佳袭警案的司法公正性。
description.en: After Yang Jia was executed, Ai Weiwei wrote blog posts and produced the documentary 'One Recluse' to question the judicial fairness of Yang Jia's case of attacking police.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未探视并采访了被迫滞留日本成田机场的维权人士冯正虎，并制作纪录片《美好生活》声援其回家。
description.en: Ai Weiwei visited and interviewed activist Feng Zhenghu, who was forced to stay at Japan's Narita Airport, and produced the documentary 'A Beautiful Life' to support his return home.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未作为艺术顾问，参与了国家体育场“鸟巢”的设计工作。
description.en: As an artistic consultant, Ai Weiwei participated in the design work for the National Stadium, the 'Bird's Nest'.

description.zh-cn: 浦志强作为发课公司的代理律师，在“发课税案”中为艾未未方提供法律辩护。
description.en: As the legal counsel for Fake Ltd., Pu Zhiqiang provided legal defense for Ai Weiwei's side in the 'Fake Tax Case'.

description.zh-cn: 自艾未未被捕后，《环球时报》发表多篇社评，如《法律不会为特立独行者弯曲》，对其进行批评。
description.en: After Ai Weiwei's arrest, the Global Times published multiple editorials criticizing him, such as 'The Law Will Not Bend for Mavericks'.

description.zh-cn: 香港《文汇报》连续发文，称艾未未“五毒俱全”，涉嫌多宗罪名。
description.en: The Hong Kong newspaper Wen Wei Po published a series of articles accusing Ai Weiwei of being 'thoroughly corrupt' and involved in multiple crimes.

description.zh-cn: 2015年9月，乐高公司以作品含政治动机为由，拒绝向艾未未出售积木。该决定在引发公众抗议后于2016年1月被撤销。
description.en: In September 2015, The Lego Group refused to sell bricks to Ai Weiwei, citing political motives in his work. The decision was reversed in January 2016 following public outcry.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥是清圣祖康熙帝的第十三子。
description.en: Yinxiang was the 13th son of the Kangxi Emperor of Qing.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥的生母是敬敏皇贵妃章佳氏。
description.en: Yinxiang's birth mother was Imperial Noble Consort Jingmin of the Janggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥（皇十三子）与雍正帝（皇四子胤禛）是康熙帝的儿子，为异母兄弟。
description.en: Yinxiang (the 13th prince) and the Yongzheng Emperor (the 4th prince Yinzhen) were sons of the Kangxi Emperor, making them half-brothers.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，极大地提拔和重用胤祥，任命其为总理事务大臣，封为和硕怡亲王，并担任首席军机大臣等要职，赐予世袭罔替的铁帽子王爵位，是雍正朝的核心支柱。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor greatly promoted and relied on Yinxiang, appointing him Grand Minister of State Affairs, creating him Prince Yi of the First Rank, and having him serve as the first Chief Grand Council Minister. He was granted the hereditary 'iron-cap' princely rank and was a core pillar of the Yongzheng administration.

description.zh-cn: 康熙四十七年（1708年）废太子事件后，康熙帝在上谕中提及“十三阿哥，朕另有处置”，将其与罪臣之子并列，显示了康熙晚年对胤祥的打压。
description.en: After the incident of deposing the crown prince in 1708 (the 47th year of the Kangxi reign), the Kangxi Emperor mentioned in an edict, 'As for the 13th Prince, I have other arrangements,' listing him alongside sons of convicted officials, indicating his suppression of Yinxiang in his later years.

position.zh-cn: 皇子、和硕怡亲王、总理事务大臣、首席军机大臣
position.en: Imperial Prince, Prince Yi of the First Rank, Grand Minister of State Affairs, Chief Grand Council Minister

description.zh-cn: 胤祥是清朝皇子，在雍正朝担任核心大臣。
description.en: Yinxiang was a Qing dynasty imperial prince and served as a core minister during the Yongzheng era.

description.zh-cn: 康熙六十一年（1722年），雍正帝即位后封胤祥为和硕怡亲王，为第一代怡亲王。
description.en: In 1722 (the 61st year of the Kangxi reign), after ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor created Yinxiang as Prince Yi of the First Rank, making him the first Prince Yi.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥去世后，其第七子弘晓承袭怡亲王爵位。
description.en: After Yinxiang's death, his seventh son Hongxiao inherited the title of Prince Yi.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥因对雍正朝的巨大贡献，获雍正帝赐予其爵位世袭罔替的恩典，成为清朝第九位铁帽子王。
description.en: Due to his immense contributions to the Yongzheng court, Yinxiang was granted the privilege of a perpetually hereditary peerage by the Yongzheng Emperor, becoming the ninth 'iron-cap' prince of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 兆佳氏是胤祥的嫡福晋（正妻）。
description.en: Lady Zhaojia was Yinxiang's primary consort.

description.zh-cn: 兆佳氏是吏部尚书玛尔汉的女儿。
description.en: Lady Zhaojia was the daughter of Marhan, the Minister of Personnel.

description.zh-cn: 弘晓是胤祥的第七子。
description.en: Hongxiao was the seventh son of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 弘晓的生母是胤祥嫡福晋兆佳氏。
description.en: Hongxiao's birth mother was Yinxiang's primary consort, Lady Zhaojia.

description.zh-cn: 和硕和惠公主是胤祥的第四女。
description.en: Princess Heshuo Hehui was the fourth daughter of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 和硕和惠公主的生母是胤祥嫡福晋兆佳氏。
description.en: Princess Heshuo Hehui's birth mother was Yinxiang's primary consort, Lady Zhaojia.

description.zh-cn: 雍正七年十二月，和硕和惠公主下嫁喀尔喀博尔济锦氏多尔济塞布腾。
description.en: In the twelfth month of the seventh year of the Yongzheng reign (1729), Princess Heshuo Hehui married Dorjisebten of the Khalkha Borjigin clan.

description.zh-cn: 桑斋多尔济是和硕和惠公主的儿子。
description.en: Sangjaidorji was the son of Princess Heshuo Hehui.

description.zh-cn: 和惠公主去世后，其子桑斋多尔济由外祖母兆佳氏在北京抚养。
description.en: After Princess Hehui's death, her son Sangjaidorji was raised in Beijing by his maternal grandmother, Lady Zhaojia.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥与和硕温恪公主是同胞兄妹，生母均为敬敏皇贵妃章佳氏。
description.en: Yinxiang and Princess Heshuo Wenke were full siblings, both born to Imperial Noble Consort Jingmin of the Janggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥与和硕敦恪公主是同胞兄妹，生母均为敬敏皇贵妃章佳氏。
description.en: Yinxiang and Princess Heshuo Dunke were full siblings, both born to Imperial Noble Consort Jingmin of the Janggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 弘晈是胤祥的第四子。
description.en: Hongjiao was the fourth son of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 弘晈的生母是胤祥嫡福晋兆佳氏。
description.en: Hongjiao's birth mother was Yinxiang's primary consort, Lady Zhaojia.

description.zh-cn: 孙策是孙坚的长子。
description.en: Sun Ce is the eldest son of Sun Jian.

description.zh-cn: 孙策是吴夫人的儿子。
description.en: Sun Ce is the son of Lady Wu.

description.zh-cn: 孙权是孙策的二弟。
description.en: Sun Quan is Sun Ce's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 孙策在攻克皖城后娶大桥为妻。
description.en: Sun Ce married Da Qiao after conquering Wan Castle.

description.zh-cn: 周瑜在攻克皖城后娶小桥为妻。
description.en: Zhou Yu married Xiao Qiao after conquering Wan Castle.

description.zh-cn: 大桥是桥公的长女。
description.en: Da Qiao is the elder daughter of Qiao Gong.

description.zh-cn: 小桥是桥公的次女。
description.en: Xiao Qiao is the younger daughter of Qiao Gong.

description.zh-cn: 孙策在父亲孙坚死后，为讨回旧部曾一度在袁术麾下效力。
description.en: After his father Sun Jian's death, Sun Ce briefly served under Yuan Shu to reclaim his father's former troops.

description.zh-cn: 袁术僭越称帝后，孙策与其断绝关系，并参与了对袁术的讨伐。
description.en: After Yuan Shu declared himself emperor, Sun Ce broke ties with him and participated in the campaign against him.

description.zh-cn: 孙策通过平定江东，为日后孙吴政权的建立奠定了坚实的基础。
description.en: By conquering Jiangdong, Sun Ce laid a solid foundation for the future state of Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 孙策通过平定江东一系列战役，建立了自己在该地区的统治。
description.en: Through a series of battles to conquer Jiangdong, Sun Ce established his rule in the region.

description.zh-cn: 孙策在曲阿之战中击败了时任扬州刺史的刘繇，夺取了其在江东的控制权。
description.en: Sun Ce defeated Liu Yao, then Inspector of Yang Province, in the Battle of Qu'e, seizing his control over Jiangdong.

description.zh-cn: 孙策进攻会稽，击败了太守王朗，平定了会稽郡。
description.en: Sun Ce attacked Kuaiji, defeated its administrator Wang Lang, and pacified the commandery.

description.zh-cn: 孙策进攻吴郡，击败了当地贼帅严白虎。
description.en: Sun Ce attacked Wu Commandery and defeated the local bandit leader Yan Baihu.

description.zh-cn: 在襄阳之战中，孙坚遭到刘表部下黄祖的伏击而阵亡。
description.en: During the Battle of Xiangyang, Sun Jian was ambushed and killed by Huang Zu, a subordinate of Liu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 孙策用计袭击刘勋的根据地皖城，将其击败并夺取庐江郡。
description.en: Sun Ce used a strategy to attack Liu Xun's base at Wan Castle, defeating him and seizing Lujiang Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 孙策因忌惮吴郡太守许贡的名望而将其诛杀。
description.en: Sun Ce executed Xu Gong, the Administrator of Wu Commandery, out of fear of his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 孙策被已故吴郡太守许贡的门客刺杀身亡。
description.en: Sun Ce was assassinated by the retainers of the late Wu Commandery Administrator Xu Gong.

position.en: General Who Attacks Rebels, Marquis of Wu

description.zh-cn: 因孙策讨伐袁术有功，曹操表奏朝廷授予孙策讨逆将军官职并加封为吴侯。
description.en: Due to Sun Ce's merits in the campaign against Yuan Shu, Cao Cao petitioned the court to grant Sun Ce the title of 'General Who Attacks Rebels' and ennoble him as the Marquis of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 张纮在江都为孙策分析天下大势，规划了平定江东的战略蓝图（江都对），坚定了孙策创立基业的决心。
description.en: In Jiangdu, Zhang Hong analyzed the political landscape for Sun Ce and devised a strategic blueprint for conquering Jiangdong (the Jiangdu Dialogue), solidifying Sun Ce's determination to establish his own domain.

description.zh-cn: 太史慈原为刘繇部下，在神亭岭与孙策交战。后被孙策俘获，孙策亲自为其松绑并委以重任，太史慈遂归顺。
description.en: Tai Shi Ci initially served Liu Yao and fought Sun Ce at Shenting Ridge. He was later captured by Sun Ce, who personally untied him and entrusted him with important tasks, leading to Tai Shi Ci's allegiance.

description.zh-cn: 在孙策被祖郎围困时，程普奋勇当先，策马持矛突围，保护孙策得以脱险。
description.en: When Sun Ce was besieged by Zu Lang, Cheng Pu bravely charged forward with his horse and spear, breaking through the encirclement and protecting Sun Ce to safety.

description.zh-cn: 孙权称帝后，追谥其兄孙策为长沙桓王。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Sun Quan posthumously honored his elder brother Sun Ce as Prince Huan of Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平担任第13届台北县议员。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping served as a member of the 13th Taipei County Council.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平于2002年加入国民党，2019年退党，后于2022年通过“同舟计划”重返国民党。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping joined the Kuomintang in 2002, left the party in 2019, and returned in 2022 through the 'Tongzhou Project'.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平于1993年加入新党，并代表其首次当选公职。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping joined the New Party in 1993 and was first elected to public office as its representative.

description.zh-cn: 2023年9月，国民党提名钟小平参选台北市第五选举区立法委员。
description.en: In September 2023, the Kuomintang nominated Chung Hsiao-ping to run for legislator in Taipei City's 5th electoral district.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年中国国民党台北市长初选中，连胜文击败钟小平等对手获得提名。
description.en: In the 2014 Kuomintang primary for Taipei Mayor, Sean Lien defeated opponents including Chung Hsiao-ping to win the nomination.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平在2016年宣布参选国民党主席时，表示若当选将立即开除连战的党籍。
description.en: When Chung Hsiao-ping announced his candidacy for KMT chairman in 2016, he stated that if elected, he would immediately expel Lien Chan from the party.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年国民党台北市党部主委选举中，黄吕锦茹击败钟小平当选。
description.en: In the 2017 election for the chairperson of the KMT's Taipei City chapter, Huang Lu Chin-ju defeated Chung Hsiao-ping.

description.zh-cn: 在2019年国民党立法委员党内初选中，林郁方击败钟小平。
description.en: In the 2019 KMT legislative primary, Lin Yu-fang defeated Chung Hsiao-ping.

description.zh-cn: 2019年退出国民党后，曾宣布以无党籍身份参选立委，并寻求与台湾民众党合作。
description.en: After leaving the Kuomintang in 2019, he announced his intention to run for legislator as an independent and sought cooperation with the Taiwan People's Party.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平通过中国国民党发起的“同舟计划”重返该党。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping returned to the Kuomintang through the 'Tongzhou Project' initiated by the party.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年中华民国立法委员选举中，民主进步党候选人吴沛忆击败钟小平当选。
description.en: In the 2024 Republic of China legislative election, Democratic Progressive Party candidate Wu Pei-yi defeated Chung Hsiao-ping.

description.zh-cn: 就京华城案向台北地检署告发时任台北市长柯文哲涉嫌图利，后续引发柯文哲提出诽谤自诉，双方于2025年8月5日和解。
description.en: Accused then-Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je of illicitly benefiting from the Core Pacific City case by filing a complaint with the Taipei District Prosecutors Office, which later led to a defamation lawsuit by Ko. The two parties reached a settlement on August 5, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 就京华城案向台北地检署一并告发时任台北市副市长彭振声涉嫌图利。
description.en: Also accused then-Taipei Deputy Mayor Peng Chen-sheng of illicitly benefiting from the Core Pacific City case in a complaint filed with the Taipei District Prosecutors Office.

description.zh-cn: 向台北地检署按铃告发京华城案，促使司法调查展开。
description.en: Initiated judicial investigation into the Core Pacific City case by filing a formal complaint with the Taipei District Prosecutors Office.

description.zh-cn: 在工程补助款案中，驳回检方上诉，使钟小平等人获判无罪定谳。
description.en: In the engineering subsidy case, the Supreme Court rejected the prosecutor's appeal, leading to the final acquittal of Chung Hsiao-ping and others.

description.zh-cn: 与时任立委邱毅共同召开记者会，质疑高雄银行协助高雄市长陈菊渎职。
description.en: Held a joint press conference with then-Legislator Chiu Yi to question whether Bank of Kaohsiung was assisting Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chu in malfeasance.

description.zh-cn: 质疑高雄市长陈菊利用其对高雄银行的影响力，涉嫌渎职炒高台北市房价。
description.en: Accused Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chu of using her influence over the Bank of Kaohsiung for malfeasance to inflate Taipei's housing prices.

description.zh-cn: 质疑高雄银行协助高雄市长陈菊渎职。
description.en: Accused the Bank of Kaohsiung of assisting Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chu in malfeasance.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年初，围绕康师傅TDR案，一方告发连胜文涉嫌背信。另一方因不满钟小平就此案的不实指控，对钟小平提出诽谤告诉。此后，告发方在同年4月国民党市长初选落败后，表示将全力支持连胜文。
description.en: In early 2014, regarding the Tingyi TDR case, one party accused Sean Lien of breach of trust. Another party, dissatisfied with Chung Hsiao-ping's false accusations concerning the case, filed a defamation lawsuit against Chung Hsiao-ping. Subsequently, after losing the KMT mayoral primary in April of the same year, the initial accusing party pledged full support for Sean Lien.

description.zh-cn: 发动罢免时任立法委员林昶佐，该罢免案于2022年1月9日投票但未通过。
description.en: Initiated a recall campaign against then-Legislator Freddy Lim, which failed to pass in a vote on January 9, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要发起人，推动对立法委员林昶佐的罢免案。
description.en: As a main initiator, he promoted the recall case against Legislator Freddy Lim.

description.zh-cn: 与民进党籍的陈文治一同被控在担任台北县议员期间诈领工程补助款，后经最高法院判决无罪定谳。
description.en: Was accused along with DPP member Chen Wen-chih of fraudulently obtaining engineering subsidies while serving as a Taipei County Councilor; both were later acquitted by the Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央外事工作委员会办公室主任期间，向中共中央总书记习近平汇报工作。
description.en: As Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, he reported to CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 在担任国务委员期间，向时任国务院总理李克强汇报工作。
description.en: As a State Councilor, he reported to then-Premier of the State Council Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 在担任外交部长期间，向时任国务院总理温家宝汇报工作。
description.en: As Minister of Foreign Affairs, he reported to then-Premier of the State Council Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 杨洁篪在南京大学攻读博士学位时，钱乘旦是其导师。
description.en: Qian Chengdan was Yang Jiechi's supervisor when he was pursuing his doctoral degree at Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 杨洁篪与王光亚在上海外国语学院附属中学就读时是室友。
description.en: Yang Jiechi and Wang Guangya were roommates while studying at the Shanghai Foreign Language School.

description.zh-cn: 受文化大革命的影响，杨洁篪于1968年被迫中止学业。
description.en: Affected by the Cultural Revolution, Yang Jiechi was forced to drop out of school in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 1972年尼克松访华后，周恩来指示加速培养外语人才，杨洁篪因此被选中派到国外留学。
description.en: After Nixon's visit to China in 1972, Zhou Enlai instructed to accelerate the training of foreign language talents, which led to Yang Jiechi being selected to study abroad.

description.zh-cn: 根据1971年毛泽东的指示精神，中国选拔了一批学生到国外留学，杨洁篪是其中之一。
description.en: Following Mao Zedong's instructions in 1971, China selected a group of students to study abroad, and Yang Jiechi was among them.

description.zh-cn: 为杨洁篪取了“老虎杨”（Tiger Yang）的绰号。
description.en: Gave Yang Jiechi the nickname 'Tiger Yang'.

description.zh-cn: 1977年，乔治·H·W·布什访问中国时，杨洁篪担任其全程陪同翻译。
description.en: In 1977, when George H. W. Bush visited China, Yang Jiechi served as his full-time accompanying interpreter.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁与黄兴、刘揆一、陈天华、章士钊等人共同成立华兴会。
description.en: Song Jiaoren co-founded the Huaxinghui with Huang Xing, Liu Kuiyi, Chen Tianhua, Zhang Shizhao, and others.

description.zh-cn: 在华兴会中，宋教仁担任副会长，会长为黄兴。
description.en: In the Huaxinghui, Song Jiaoren served as Vice President under President Huang Xing.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁支持孙中山成立中国同盟会，并担任司法部检事长。
description.en: Song Jiaoren supported Sun Yat-sen in establishing the Tongmenghui and served as the Procurator of its Judicial Department.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁是国民党的主要筹建人，主持了同盟会的改组工作。
description.en: Song Jiaoren was the main founder of the Kuomintang, presiding over the reorganization of the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 1903年8月，宋教仁与黄兴在武昌相识，从此成为挚友。
description.en: In August 1903, Song Jiaoren and Huang Xing met in Wuchang and became close friends thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 因对孙中山处理国旗及军火购买等事宜产生误会和不满，宋教仁产生恶感，并参与了第一次倒孙高潮。
description.en: Due to misunderstandings and dissatisfaction with Sun Yat-sen's handling of the national flag and arms procurement issues, Song Jiaoren developed animosity and participated in the first wave of anti-Sun movements.

description.zh-cn: 在国民党成立大会上，唐群英因党纲中没有“男女平权”而质问宋教仁，并掌击其脸颊。
description.en: At the founding meeting of the Kuomintang, Tang Qunying questioned Song Jiaoren about the absence of 'gender equality' in the party platform and slapped his cheeks.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁倡导的责任内阁制威胁到袁世凯的统治地位，袁世凯被广泛认为是刺杀宋教仁的幕后主使。
description.en: The cabinet responsibility system advocated by Song Jiaoren threatened Yuan Shikai's ruling position, and Yuan is widely believed to be the mastermind behind Song's assassination.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务总理赵秉钧被认为是直接布置暗杀宋教仁的执行者。
description.en: Then Premier Zhao Bingjun is considered to have been the direct organizer of Song Jiaoren's assassination.

description.zh-cn: 作为赵秉钧的秘书，洪述祖通过电报“毁宋酬勋”具体安排了刺杀行动。
description.en: As Zhao Bingjun's secretary, Hong Shuzu specifically arranged the assassination through the telegram 'destroy Song for a reward'.

description.zh-cn: 受洪述祖指使，雇佣武士英在上海北站刺杀了宋教仁。
description.en: Under instructions from Hong Shuzu, he hired Wu Shiying to assassinate Song Jiaoren at Shanghai North Railway Station.

description.zh-cn: 在上海北站开枪射杀宋教仁的直接凶手。
description.en: The direct assassin who shot Song Jiaoren at Shanghai North Railway Station.

description.zh-cn: 部分观点（如北一辉、袁克文等）认为，由于国民党内部的权力斗争，陈其美是刺杀宋教仁的幕后主使之一。
description.en: Some theories (e.g., from Kita Ikki, Yuan Kewen) suggest that due to internal power struggles within the Kuomintang, Chen Qimei was one of the masterminds behind Song Jiaoren's assassination.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁遇刺身亡是二次革命爆发的直接导火索。
description.en: The death of Song Jiaoren after his assassination was the direct trigger for the Second Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁死后，孙中山果断发动了二次革命以武力反袁。
description.en: After Song Jiaoren's death, Sun Yat-sen decisively launched the Second Revolution to oppose Yuan Shikai by force.

description.zh-cn: 与孙中山主张武力反袁不同，黄兴全力反对在宋案后立即使用武力。
description.en: Unlike Sun Yat-sen who advocated for armed opposition to Yuan, Huang Xing strongly opposed the immediate use of force after the Song case.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁是中华民国初期第一位倡导并极力推广责任内阁制的政治家。
description.en: Song Jiaoren was the first politician in the early Republic of China to advocate for and vigorously promote the cabinet responsibility system.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯通过段祺瑞买凶，刺杀了北洋第六镇统制吴禄贞。
description.en: Yuan Shikai hired assassins through Duan Qirui to kill Wu Luzhen, the commander of the 6th Division of the Beiyang Army.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯通过汪精卫和黄复生，指使彭家珍刺杀了其政敌良弼。
description.en: Yuan Shikai, through Wang Jingwei and Huang Fusheng, instructed Peng Jiazhen to assassinate his political rival Liangbi.

description.zh-cn: 在公开斥责袁世凯刺宋后，林述庆在袁世凯秘书长梁士诒的宴席上被毒死。
description.en: After publicly denouncing Yuan Shikai for assassinating Song, Lin Shuqing was poisoned at a banquet hosted by Yuan's chief secretary Liang Shiyi.

description.zh-cn: 为替袁世凯掩盖罪证，京畿军政执法处的侦探在火车上将应桂馨刺死灭口。
description.en: To cover up evidence for Yuan Shikai, detectives from the Capital's Military and Political Law Enforcement Office assassinated Ying Guixin on a train to silence him.

description.zh-cn: 1919年，洪述祖被北洋政府大理院以杀人罪判处死刑，并执行绞刑。
description.en: In 1919, Hong Shuzu was sentenced to death for murder by the Supreme Court of the Beiyang Government and was executed by hanging.

description.zh-cn: 在1958年的军委扩大会议上，彭德怀等人将刘伯承作为军事教条主义的代表进行批判。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the Military Commission in 1958, Peng Dehuai and others criticized Liu Bocheng as a representative of military dogmatism.

description.zh-cn: 1928年底至1930年8月，刘伯承在苏联伏龙芝军事学院学习。
description.en: From late 1928 to August 1930, Liu Bocheng studied at the Frunze Military Academy in the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，刘伯承担任八路军129师师长，领导开辟晋冀鲁豫边区，并指挥了百团大战等多项重要战役。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Liu Bocheng served as the commander of the 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army, led the establishment of the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan border region, and commanded many important campaigns, including the Hundred Regiments Offensive.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，刘伯承担任晋冀鲁豫军区、中原军区及第二野战军司令员，指挥了上党战役、淮海战役、渡江战役等一系列决定性战役。
description.en: During the second Chinese Civil War, Liu Bocheng served as commander of the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Military Region, Central Plains Military Region, and Second Field Army, commanding a series of decisive campaigns including the Shangdang Campaign, Huaihai Campaign, and Yangtze River Crossing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 刘伯承参加了长征，期间担任中央革命军事委员会总参谋长等职，指挥了强渡乌江、金沙江等战斗。
description.en: Liu Bocheng participated in the Long March, during which he served as Chief of the General Staff of the Central Revolutionary Military Commission and commanded battles such as the forced crossings of the Wu and Jinsha rivers.

description.zh-cn: 1951年，刘伯承受命组建中国人民解放军军事学院并担任首任院长兼政委，为解放军正规化建设做出重要贡献。
description.en: In 1951, Liu Bocheng was ordered to establish the PLA Military Academy and served as its first president and political commissar, making significant contributions to the regularization of the PLA.

description.zh-cn: 倪亦方是亦舒的胞兄。
description.en: Ni Yifang is Yi Shu's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 倪亦靖是亦舒的胞弟。
description.en: Ni Yijing is Yi Shu's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 倪震是亦舒的侄子。
description.en: Joe Nieh is Yi Shu's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 周慧敏是亦舒的侄媳。
description.en: Vivian Chow is Yi Shu's niece-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 在此任职七年。
description.en: Worked here for seven years.

description.zh-cn: 于1993年移民加拿大。
description.en: Immigrated to Canada in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 亦舒的早期作品多刊于《中国学生周报》。
description.en: Yi Shu's early works were mostly published in the China Student Weekly.

description.zh-cn: 亦舒后期的作品交予香港天地图书有限公司出版。
description.en: Yi Shu's later works were published by Hong Kong's Cosmos Books Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 亦舒的科幻作品不时会看到兄长倪匡作品的角色客串出现。
description.en: Characters from her elder brother Ni Kuang's works occasionally make guest appearances in Yi Shu's science fiction works.

description.zh-cn: 袁定阳是袁隆平的三子。
description.en: Yuan Dingyang is Yuan Longping's third son.

description.zh-cn: 担任第六届至第十二届全国政协常委。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 6th to 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 担任第六届至第十一届湖南省政协副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the 6th to 11th Hunan Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 袁隆平在1960年目睹大饥荒的惨状后，深受刺激，决意研究提高粮食产量。
description.en: After witnessing the devastating effects of the Great Famine in 1960, Yuan Longping was deeply moved and resolved to research ways to increase grain production.

description.zh-cn: 在文革期间，袁隆平遭到红卫兵和群众批判，其实验稻田的育种甚至被恶意拔除。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Yuan Longping was criticized by Red Guards and the masses, and his experimental rice paddies were even maliciously uprooted.

description.zh-cn: 国家科委在读到袁隆平的论文后，发公函责成湖南省科委将其列为“保护对象”并支持其研究。
description.en: After reading Yuan Longping's paper, the State Science and Technology Commission issued an official letter instructing the Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Commission to designate him as a "protected individual" and support his research.

description.zh-cn: 李必湖是袁隆平的助手和学生。
description.en: Li Bihu was Yuan Longping's assistant and student.

description.zh-cn: 李必湖在海南试验田发现了一株关键的野生稻雄性不育株“野败”，为杂交水稻“三系法”研究带来了决定性突破。
description.en: Li Bihu discovered a crucial wild rice plant with male sterility, named "Yebai," in an experimental field in Hainan, which brought a decisive breakthrough to the "three-line system" research for hybrid rice.

description.zh-cn: 袁隆平致力于杂交水稻的研究和推广，成功培育出三系法、两系法、超级杂交稻等品种，大幅提高了水稻产量。
description.en: Yuan Longping dedicated his life to the research and promotion of hybrid rice, successfully developing varieties through the three-line system, two-line system, and creating super hybrid rice, which significantly increased rice yields.

description.zh-cn: 林巧稚是负责为袁隆平接生的医生。
description.en: Lin Qiaozhi was the doctor who delivered Yuan Longping.

description.zh-cn: 在袁隆平逝世后，习近平发来唁电表示悼念，并委托湖南省委书记许达哲看望其家属。
description.en: After Yuan Longping's passing, Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence and entrusted Xu Dazhe, Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee, to visit his family.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次和第二次鸦片战争中，清朝与大英帝国是主要交战方。
description.en: The Qing dynasty and the British Empire were the main belligerents in the First and Second Opium Wars.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次鸦片战争中，清朝与法兰西第二帝国是交战方。
description.en: The Qing dynasty and the Second French Empire were belligerents in the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 英国东印度公司向中国走私鸦片是导致战争的根本原因之一。
description.en: The British East India Company's smuggling of opium into China was one of the root causes of the war.

description.zh-cn: 《南京条约》使中国丧失了领土主权（割让香港岛），并被迫开放通商口岸和支付巨额赔款，损害了清朝的国家利益。
description.en: The Treaty of Nanking led to China's loss of territorial sovereignty (cession of Hong Kong Island) and forced the opening of treaty ports and payment of large indemnities, harming the national interests of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京条约》，清朝将香港岛割让给大英帝国。
description.en: Under the Treaty of Nanking, the Qing dynasty ceded Hong Kong Island to the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 第二次鸦片战争的第一阶段以英法联军的胜利告终，迫使清政府签订《天津条约》。
description.en: The first phase of the Second Opium War ended with the victory of the Anglo-French forces, forcing the Qing government to sign the Treaty of Tientsin.

description.zh-cn: 第二次鸦片战争的第二阶段以英法联军占领北京告终，迫使清政府签订《北京条约》以结束战争。
description.en: The second phase of the Second Opium War concluded with the occupation of Beijing by Anglo-French forces, compelling the Qing government to sign the Convention of Peking to end the war.

description.zh-cn: 根据《北京条约》，清朝将九龙半岛割让给大英帝国。
description.en: Under the Convention of Peking, the Qing dynasty ceded the Kowloon Peninsula to the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 《中俄北京条约》将乌苏里江以东包括库页岛在内的约40万平方公里领土割让给俄国。
description.en: The Sino-Russian Convention of Peking ceded approximately 400,000 square kilometers of territory east of the Ussuri River, including Sakhalin Island, to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 通过签订《中俄北京条约》，俄罗斯帝国获得了清朝割让的外东北大片领土。
description.en: By signing the Sino-Russian Convention of Peking, the Russian Empire acquired a large swathe of territory in Outer Manchuria ceded by the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 鸦片战争的失败及随后一系列不平等条约的签订，被普遍视为中国近代“百年国耻”的开端。
description.en: The defeat in the Opium Wars and the subsequent signing of a series of unequal treaties are widely regarded as the beginning of China's modern "Century of Humiliation".

description.zh-cn: 强加给中国的一系列不平等条约是“百年国耻”时期的核心组成部分和重要象征。
description.en: The series of unequal treaties imposed on China are a core component and important symbol of the "Century of Humiliation" period.

description.zh-cn: 叶名琛在处理“亚罗号事件”时扣押了船员，这一行动被英国视为挑衅，成为发动第二次鸦片战争的借口。
description.en: Ye Mingchen's seizure of the crew during the Arrow Incident was seen as a provocation by the British and became the pretext for launching the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 亚罗号事件是英国发动第二次鸦片战争的直接借口（导火索）。
description.en: The Arrow Incident served as the direct pretext (casus belli) for the United Kingdom to launch the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 广西西林教案是法国加入第二次鸦片战争的直接借口（导火索）。
description.en: The Father Chapdelaine Incident served as the direct pretext (casus belli) for France to join the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 英法联军攻占广州后，俘虏了两广总督叶名琛，并将其押往印度。
description.en: After capturing Guangzhou, the Anglo-French forces captured the Viceroy of Liangguang, Ye Mingchen, and exiled him to India.

description.zh-cn: 在通州谈判破裂后，僧格林沁下令截获并俘虏了包括巴夏礼在内的英法谈判代表团。
description.en: After the breakdown of negotiations in Tongzhou, Sengge Rinchen ordered the interception and capture of the Anglo-French negotiation delegation, including Harry Parkes.

description.zh-cn: 额尔金下令英军焚烧圆明园，以作为对清政府虐待外交使节的惩罚。
description.en: Lord Elgin ordered the British forces to burn the Old Summer Palace as a punishment for the Qing government's mistreatment of diplomatic envoys.

description.zh-cn: 在八里桥决战中，僧格林沁率领的清军主力被英法联军彻底击败。
description.en: In the decisive battle of Baliqiao, the main Qing army led by Sengge Rinchen was completely defeated by the Anglo-French forces.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国利用第二次鸦片战争之机，以武力强迫清政府签订《瑷珲条约》。
description.en: The Russian Empire took advantage of the Second Opium War to force the Qing government to sign the Treaty of Aigun under military threat.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国以“调停有功”为由，在战后迫使清政府签订《中俄北京条约》，攫取更多领土。
description.en: Under the pretext of its 'meritorious mediation,' the Russian Empire forced the Qing government to sign the Sino-Russian Convention of Peking after the war, seizing more territory.

description.zh-cn: 战争的惨败使清朝统治集团部分官员认识到与西方的差距，从而推动了以“师夷长技以制夷”为目标的洋务运动。
description.en: The disastrous defeat in the war made some officials in the Qing ruling clique realize the gap with the West, thereby promoting the Self-Strengthening Movement with the goal of 'learning from the barbarians to counter the barbarians'.

description.zh-cn: 为应对战后复杂的外交局势，清政府于1861年设立了总理各国事务衙门。
description.en: To handle the complex post-war diplomatic situation, the Qing government established the Zongli Yamen in 1861.

description.zh-cn: 恭亲王奕䜣作为清方全权代表，与英方代表额尔金进行谈判并签订了《中英北京条约》。
description.en: As the Qing's plenipotentiary representative, Prince Gong Yixin negotiated with the British representative Lord Elgin and signed the Sino-British Convention of Peking.

description.zh-cn: 南昌起义后，中国共产党开始建立自己的正式武装部队，即中国工农红军。
description.en: After the Nanchang Uprising, the Chinese Communist Party began to establish its own formal armed forces, the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 在三大会战中，国军主力部队遭到歼灭性打击，从而丧失了在内战中的军事优势。
description.en: In the Three Great Campaigns, the main forces of the Nationalist army suffered devastating blows, thereby losing their military superiority in the civil war.

description.zh-cn: 苏军在1946年撤离东北前，将缴获的日本关东军武器移交给林彪的东北野战军，为中共抢占东北提供了便利。
description.en: Before withdrawing from Northeast China in 1946, the Soviet Army handed over captured weapons from the Japanese Kwantung Army to Lin Biao's Northeast Field Army, facilitating the CCP's occupation of the region.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国总统李登辉于1991年宣布废止《动员戡乱时期临时条款》，正式结束了两岸的敌对状态。
description.en: Then-ROC President Lee Teng-hui announced the abolition of the 'Temporary Provisions Effective During the Period of Communist Rebellion' in 1991, formally ending the state of hostility across the Taiwan Strait.

description.zh-cn: 在第五次反围剿战争中失败后，中国工农红军主力被迫展开长征进行战略转移。
description.en: After being defeated in the Fifth Encirclement Campaign, the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army were forced to embark on the Long March as a strategic retreat.

description.zh-cn: 立法院职权修法争议被视为引发大罢免运动的主要原因之一。
description.en: The controversy over the amendments to the Legislative Yuan's powers is considered one of the main causes that triggered the Great Recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 反对国会改革的青鸟运动中，开始酝酿罢免国民党籍立委的行动，为大罢免埋下伏笔。
description.en: During the Bluebird Movement against legislative reforms, actions to recall KMT legislators began to brew, setting the stage for the Great Recall.

description.zh-cn: 民进党正式投入大罢免运动，将全国各县市党部与党公职服务处转为“民主连署站”，以行动支持罢免泛蓝公职人员。
description.en: The DPP formally joined the Great Recall movement, turning its party offices and service centers nationwide into 'Democracy Petition Stations' to actively support the recall of Pan-Blue public officials.

description.zh-cn: 作为民进党主席，赖清德在全代会宣示“民进党必须与公民同行”，标志着执政党全力投入支持罢免运动。
description.en: As the chairman of the DPP, Lai Ching-te declared at the party's national congress that the 'DPP must walk with the citizens,' signaling the ruling party's full commitment to supporting the recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 为反制泛绿阵营发起的罢免，国民党采取“以罢制罢”策略，发动对民进党籍民意代表的罢免，成为大罢免潮的另一股推动力量。
description.en: To counter the recalls initiated by the Pan-Green camp, the KMT adopted a 'recall for recall' strategy, launching recalls against DPP representatives, which became another driving force in the Great Recall wave.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民众党发动“扫除绿卫兵”行动，参与罢免民进党籍民意代表，以此反制泛绿阵营发起的罢免潮。
description.en: The Taiwan People's Party launched the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign, participating in the recall of DPP representatives to counter the recall wave initiated by the Pan-Green camp.

description.zh-cn: 作为国民党主席，朱立伦领导并下令推动对民进党籍立委的罢免，作为对泛绿罢免行动的反制。
description.en: As the chairman of the KMT, Eric Chu led and ordered the promotion of recalls against DPP legislators as a countermeasure to the Pan-Green camp's recall actions.

description.zh-cn: 作为民众党立法院党团总召，黄国昌发动“扫除绿卫兵”行动，并号召集会，积极参与对民进党籍民意代表的罢免。
description.en: As the caucus convener of the TPP in the Legislative Yuan, Huang Kuo-chang initiated the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign and called for rallies, actively participating in the recall of DPP representatives.

description.zh-cn: 时任新竹市长高虹安在大罢免运动中成为罢免对象。针对她的罢免案最终投票未通过。
description.en: Then-Hsinchu Mayor Ann Kao became a recall target during the Great Recall movement. The recall vote against her ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 大罢免运动中所有罢免案均未通过，此结果被广泛认为是社会对赖清德政府与作为执政党的民主进步党投下的不信任投票。
description.en: The failure of all recall proposals in the Great Recall movement was widely interpreted as a vote of no confidence from society against the Lai Ching-te administration and the ruling Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 大罢免运动的失败所引发的政治效应，促使了卓荣泰内阁在后续进行局部改组。
description.en: The political fallout from the failure of the Great Recall movement prompted a subsequent partial reshuffle of the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 西乡隆盛回到鹿儿岛统率士族，以“质问政府”为名发动西南战争，反对明治政府的改革政策。
description.en: Saigō Takamori returned to Kagoshima to lead the samurai, launching the Satsuma Rebellion under the pretext of 'questioning the government', to oppose the reform policies of the Meiji government.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉于1885年3月16日在《时事新报》上发表社论《脱亚论》，倡导日本脱离亚洲、学习西方文明。
description.en: On March 16, 1885, Fukuzawa Yukichi published the editorial 'Datsu-A Ron' in the Jiji Shinpō, advocating for Japan to leave Asia and learn from Western civilization.

description.zh-cn: 作为旧幕府代表，与新政府代表西乡隆盛谈判，促成了江户的无血开城。
description.en: As the representative of the old shogunate, he negotiated with the new government's representative, Saigō Takamori, leading to the bloodless surrender of Edo.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上发表批判斯大林的“秘密报告”，开启“去斯大林化”，引发了毛泽东等中共高层的不满，成为中苏交恶的缘起。
description.en: Khrushchev's "Secret Speech" criticizing Stalin at the 20th CPSU Congress initiated "de-Stalinization," which caused dissatisfaction among Mao Zedong and other high-level CCP leaders, becoming the origin of the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政府正式照会中国外交部，决定召回全部在华工作的1390名苏联专家，并终止了数百份经济和科技合作合同，使中苏关系走向破裂。
description.en: The Soviet government officially notified the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs of its decision to recall all 1390 Soviet experts working in China and terminated hundreds of economic and technological cooperation contracts, leading to the rupture of Sino-Soviet relations.

description.zh-cn: 在苏共二十二大上，因苏共公开批判阿尔巴尼亚，中共代表团团长周恩来当场予以驳斥，并率团提前回国以示抗议。
description.en: At the 22nd CPSU Congress, due to the CPSU's public criticism of Albania, Zhou Enlai, head of the CCP delegation, refuted it on the spot and led the delegation to return to China early in protest.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，毛泽东号召“反苏修”，中苏两国关系彻底冻结，冲突升级。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Mao Zedong called for "opposing Soviet revisionism," which completely froze Sino-Soviet relations and escalated the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 珍宝岛事件是中苏边界冲突中规模最大、最激烈的武装冲突，导致两国关系紧张到核战争边缘。
description.en: The Zhenbao Island incident was the largest and most intense armed conflict in the Sino-Soviet border dispute, pushing relations between the two countries to the brink of nuclear war.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联考虑对中国进行核打击时，时任美国总统尼克松及其政府进行了干预，向苏联表明美国不会容忍此类行为，从而阻止了潜在的核攻击。
description.en: When the Soviet Union considered a nuclear strike against China, then-U.S. President Nixon and his administration intervened, indicating to the Soviets that the U.S. would not tolerate such an action, thereby preventing a potential nuclear attack.

description.zh-cn: 面对苏联的严重军事和核威胁，毛泽东等中共领导层开始谋求与美国发展关系，最终促成了1972年的尼克松访华。
description.en: Facing severe military and nuclear threats from the Soviet Union, Mao Zedong and other CCP leaders began to seek better relations with the United States, ultimately leading to Nixon's visit to China in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 为应对苏联的扩张势头，毛泽东提出了“一条线、一大片”的外交战略构想。
description.en: To counter Soviet expansionism, Mao Zedong proposed the foreign policy strategy of "one line, one large area."

description.zh-cn: 1982年，勃列日涅夫在塔什干发表讲话，对中国释放友好信号，被认为是中苏关系解冻的讯号。
description.en: In 1982, Brezhnev delivered a speech in Tashkent sending friendly signals to China, which is considered a sign of a thaw in Sino-Soviet relations.

description.zh-cn: 在中共早期，斯大林不信任毛泽东，支持“二十八个半布尔什维克”等苏联路线的领导人，并将毛泽东排除在中央委员会之外。
description.en: In the early days of the CCP, Stalin distrusted Mao Zedong, supported leaders who followed the Soviet line, such as the "28 Bolsheviks," and excluded Mao from the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 苏联以正在谈判禁止核试验条约为由，暂缓向中国提供核武器样品和技术资料，撕毁了《中苏国防新技术协定》。
description.en: Citing ongoing negotiations for a nuclear test ban treaty, the Soviet Union suspended the provision of nuclear weapon samples and technical data to China, tearing up the 'Sino-Soviet Agreement on New Technology for National Defense'.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放带来的思想解放、对西方民主观念的接触以及对政治体制改革的讨论，为八六学潮的发生提供了重要的社会和思想背景。
description.en: The intellectual liberation, exposure to Western democratic concepts, and discussions on political system reform brought by the Reform and Opening-up provided a significant social and ideological background for the 1986 student demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国科学技术大学副校长方励之在校内的竞选演讲中，宣扬民主需要靠自己争取，其言论和公开支持极大地鼓舞了学生，推动了学潮的发生和发展。
description.en: In his campaign speech at the university, then-Vice President Fang Lizhi advocated that democracy must be fought for, which greatly inspired the students and propelled the outbreak and development of the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国作家协会副主席刘宾雁与方励之一同前往上海多所高校发表演讲，对学生思想产生影响，推动了学潮的酝酿。
description.en: Then-Vice Chairman of the Chinese Writers Association, Liu Binyan, delivered speeches at several universities in Shanghai along with Fang Lizhi, influencing student thought and contributing to the fomentation of the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 八六学潮是改革开放时期第一次全国范围的学潮，是中华人民共和国民主运动中的一个重要事件，推动了民主思想的传播。
description.en: The 1986 student demonstrations were the first nationwide student movement during the Reform and Opening-up era, a significant event in the democracy movement of the People's Republic of China that promoted the spread of democratic ideas.

description.zh-cn: 中共保守派将学潮的爆发归咎于胡耀邦对资产阶级自由化的纵容，并向邓小平等核心领导人施压，最终促使其下台。
description.en: CCP conservatives blamed the outbreak of the student movement on Hu Yaobang's tolerance of bourgeois liberalization and pressured paramount leader Deng Xiaoping and others, ultimately leading to his ousting.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在与胡耀邦等人的谈话中严厉批评其应对学潮不力，并主持了决定胡耀邦辞职的中央政治局扩大会议，起到了决定性作用。
description.en: In a talk with Hu Yaobang and others, Deng Xiaoping severely criticized his ineffective response to the student unrest and presided over the enlarged Politburo meeting that decided Hu's resignation, playing a decisive role.

description.zh-cn: 在1987年1月16日的中共中央政治局扩大会议上，胡耀邦辞去中共中央总书记职务。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the CCP Politburo on January 16, 1987, Hu Yaobang resigned from his position as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦辞职后，赵紫阳被一致推选为代理中共中央总书记。
description.en: Following Hu Yaobang's resignation, Zhao Ziyang was unanimously elected as the acting General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 为了肃清学潮的思想影响，中共中央在学潮平息后发起了“反对资产阶级自由化”运动。
description.en: To eliminate the ideological influence of the student movement, the CCP Central Committee launched the 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign' after the unrest was suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在1986年12月30日的谈话中，强调必须“旗帜鲜明地反对资产阶级自由化”，为该运动的展开奠定了基调。
description.en: In his speech on December 30, 1986, Deng Xiaoping emphasized the need to 'take a clear-cut stand against bourgeois liberalization,' setting the tone for the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，方励之被撤销中国科学技术大学副校长职务，并于1987年1月17日被开除党籍。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Fang Lizhi was removed from his post as Vice President of the University of Science and Technology of China and was expelled from the party on January 17, 1987.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，管惟炎被撤销中国科学技术大学校长职务。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Guan Weiyan was removed from his post as President of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，刘宾雁被开除党籍。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Liu Binyan was expelled from the party.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，王若望被开除党籍。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Wang Ruowang was expelled from the party.

description.zh-cn: 八六学潮为1989年的六四事件埋下伏笔，部分学潮的参与者后来也成为六四事件的发起人和组织者。
description.en: The 1986 student demonstrations set the stage for the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, and some of its participants later became initiators and organizers of the 1989 events.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在1980年代实际主导最高决策，决定并推动了废除干部领导职务终身制这项重要的政治制度改革。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping, as the paramount leader in the 1980s, decided on and promoted the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres, an important political system reform.

description.zh-cn: 废除干部领导职务终身制改革的重要内容之一是建立起领导干部的任期制。
description.en: A key component of the reform to abolish the lifelong tenure system was the establishment of a term limit system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 废除干部领导职务终身制改革的重要内容之一是建立起领导干部的退休制度。
description.en: A key component of the reform to abolish the lifelong tenure system was the establishment of a retirement system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 中共十二大通过决议，决定建立中央顾问委员会作为废除领导干部职务终身制的过渡性机构。
description.en: The 12th CPC National Congress passed a resolution to establish the Central Advisory Commission as a transitional body for abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 中央顾问委员会作为一项过渡性制度安排，通过安置老干部，为废除领导职务终身制铺平了道路。
description.en: As a transitional institutional arrangement, the Central Advisory Commission paved the way for the abolition of the lifelong tenure system by accommodating veteran cadres.

description.zh-cn: 《八二宪法》规定国家主席等领导人“连续任职不得超过两届”，象征着领导干部职务终身制被正式废除。
description.en: The '82 Constitution stipulated that leaders such as the President 'shall serve no more than two consecutive terms,' symbolizing the formal abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛在中共十八大上卸任所有职务，实现“裸退”，被习近平称赞为“高风亮节”，此举被视为进一步完善了废除干部领导职务终身制的制度。
description.en: Hu Jintao stepped down from all positions at the 18th CPC National Congress, achieving a 'naked retirement,' which was praised by Xi Jinping as a 'noble act' and seen as a further step in perfecting the system of abolishing lifelong tenure for cadres.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央总书记、中共中央军委主席
position.en: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 在中共十八大上，习近平接替胡锦涛，成为中国共产党的主要领导人。
description.en: At the 18th CPC National Congress, Xi Jinping succeeded Hu Jintao to become the primary leader of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 取消国家主席任期限制的修宪被普遍认为是习近平为了谋求长期执政而推动的举动。
description.en: The constitutional amendment to remove the presidential term limit is widely seen as a move pushed by Xi Jinping to secure long-term rule.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案取消了国家主席的任期限制，此举被外界解读为对邓小平时代确立的废除领导干部职务终身制原则的逆转，有媒体认为干部领导职务终身制已经复辟。
description.en: This amendment removed the term limit for the President, a move interpreted by outsiders as a reversal of the principle of abolishing lifelong tenure established during the Deng Xiaoping era, with some media suggesting the lifelong system has been restored.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民在主政期间延续了废除干部领导职务终身制的政策。
description.en: During his tenure, Jiang Zemin continued the policy of abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 《朴茨茅斯条约》的签订标志着日俄战争的正式结束。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Portsmouth marked the official end of the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 作为中间人斡旋日俄双方进行停战谈判并达成协议。
description.en: Acted as a mediator to facilitate peace negotiations between Japan and Russia, leading to the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国在战争中的失败和巨大消耗，加剧了国内社会矛盾，是引发1905年革命的直接导火索。
description.en: The Russian Empire's defeat and enormous costs in the war exacerbated domestic social conflicts, acting as a direct catalyst for the 1905 Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 日本以君主立宪政体战胜专制俄国，给清廷上下带来巨大震动，认为“立宪能战胜于专制”，从而推动了清末的立宪运动。
description.en: Japan, a constitutional monarchy, defeating autocratic Russia sent shockwaves through the Qing court, leading to the belief that 'constitutionalism can defeat autocracy' and thus promoting the constitutional movement in the late Qing.

description.zh-cn: 日本在日俄战争中获胜，俄国承认日本对朝鲜的指导及监督权，日本随即迫使大韩帝国签订该协约，使其成为日本的保护国。
description.en: After Japan's victory in the Russo-Japanese War, Russia recognized Japan's right to guide and supervise Korea. Japan then compelled the Korean Empire to sign this treaty, making it a Japanese protectorate.

description.zh-cn: 鲁迅在观看日俄战争中中国人作俄军间谍被日军处决的幻灯片后，认识到改变国民精神的重要性，从而决定弃医从文。
description.en: After watching a slide show depicting a Chinese person being executed by the Japanese army as a Russian spy during the war, Lu Xun realized the importance of changing the national spirit and decided to abandon medicine for literature.

description.zh-cn: 俄国舰队在对马海峡海战中几乎全军覆没，使其彻底丧失扭转战局的希望，从而开始与日本进行停战谈判。
description.en: The near-total annihilation of the Russian fleet at the Battle of Tsushima destroyed Russia's hopes of turning the tide of the war, prompting it to begin peace negotiations with Japan.

description.zh-cn: 联合舰队在此战中以极小的代价取得了决定性胜利。
description.en: The Combined Fleet achieved a decisive victory in this battle with minimal losses.

description.zh-cn: 日本在甲午战争后通过《马关条约》获得辽东半岛，直接引发了俄、德、法三国的干涉。
description.en: Japan's acquisition of the Liaodong Peninsula through the Treaty of Shimonoseki after the First Sino-Japanese War directly triggered the intervention of Russia, Germany, and France.

description.zh-cn: 日本被迫归还辽东半岛，视之为国耻，加剧了与在东北亚扩张势力的俄国之间的矛盾，成为日俄战争的远因。
description.en: Japan was forced to return the Liaodong Peninsula, which it considered a national humiliation, exacerbating tensions with the expanding Russian Empire in Northeast Asia and becoming a long-term cause of the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄国的盟友，黑山公国向日本宣战，但战后被遗忘，两国在法律上的战争状态直到2006年才结束。
description.en: As an ally of Russia, the Principality of Montenegro declared war on Japan, but was forgotten after the war. The legal state of war between the two countries did not end until 2006.

description.zh-cn: 日英同盟的签订使日本在与俄国的对抗中获得了外交上的支持，使其有底气发动战争。
description.en: The signing of the Anglo-Japanese Alliance gave Japan diplomatic support in its confrontation with Russia, providing it with the confidence to start the war.

description.zh-cn: 俄军在奉天会战中战败并撤退，这是日俄战争中规模最大的一次陆战失利。
description.en: The Russian army was defeated and retreated in the Battle of Mukden, its largest land battle loss in the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 担任日俄战争时期大日本帝国的国家元首和名义上的最高统帅。
description.en: Served as the head of state and nominal commander-in-chief of the Empire of Japan during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 担任日俄战争时期俄罗斯帝国的国家元首和最高统帅。
description.en: Served as the head of state and commander-in-chief of the Russian Empire during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 在日俄战争期间担任日本海军联合舰队的司令长官。
description.en: Served as the Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese Combined Fleet during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 清零政策是为应对2019冠状病毒病疫情而采取的一种防疫策略。
description.en: The zero-COVID policy was an epidemic prevention strategy adopted in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

description.zh-cn: 公开表示中国的清零政策不可持续。
description.en: Publicly stated that China's zero-COVID policy was unsustainable.

description.zh-cn: 公开表示不认为中国大陆推行的清零政策可以持久进行。
description.en: Publicly stated that he did not believe the zero-COVID policy pursued by mainland China was sustainable.

description.zh-cn: 公开承认变种病毒毒力减弱，表示中国疫情处于“新形势新任务”，提早宣布了清零政策开始松动。
description.en: Publicly acknowledged the weakening virulence of the virus variant, stating that China's epidemic was in a 'new situation with new tasks', thus pre-announcing the loosening of the zero-COVID policy.
