description.zh-cn: 因疫情防控要求，一辆深夜违规行驶的隔离转运客车发生侧翻，导致27人死亡。
description.en: Due to epidemic control requirements, a quarantine transfer bus operating illegally late at night overturned, resulting in 27 deaths.

description.zh-cn: 据路透社报道，在执行宽松防疫措施后，习近平希望放缓开放，但李强反驳了习近平的要求，并继续推动放宽政策。
description.en: According to Reuters, after implementing relaxed epidemic measures, Xi Jinping wished to slow down the reopening, but Li Qiang rebutted his request and continued to push for policy relaxation.

description.zh-cn: 据媒体人士王向伟透露，时任中共广东省委书记黄坤明曾向习近平反映尽快结束清零政策的紧迫性，间接推动了政策终结。
description.en: According to media personality Wang Xiangwei, Huang Kunming, then Party Secretary of Guangdong, reported to Xi Jinping on the urgency of ending the zero-COVID policy, indirectly contributing to its termination.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年10月下旬召开闭门会议，要求与会官员和专家制定出各种重新开放的路线图，为结束清零政策做准备。
description.en: In late October 2022, convened a closed-door meeting, asking attending officials and experts to formulate various reopening roadmaps in preparation for ending the zero-COVID policy.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在与欧洲理事会主席夏尔·米歇尔的会谈中，承认国内示威源于抗疫三年民众感到沮丧，并承认奥密克戎株致命性远不如德尔塔株。
description.en: During a meeting with European Council President Charles Michel, Xi Jinping acknowledged that domestic protests stemmed from public frustration after three years of pandemic response and admitted the Omicron variant was far less lethal than Delta.

description.zh-cn: 在回应谭德塞对清零政策的批评时，时任外交部发言人赵立坚警告对方“不要发表不负责任的言论”。
description.en: In response to Tedros's criticism of the zero-COVID policy, then-Foreign Ministry spokesman Zhao Lijian warned him 'not to make irresponsible remarks'.

description.zh-cn: 越南在2021年底放弃了清零政策。
description.en: Vietnam abandoned the zero-COVID policy in late 2021.

description.zh-cn: 该次会议后，以习近平为首的新一届中共中央领导集体开启了大规模的反腐败运动。
description.en: After this congress, the new CCP central leadership collective headed by Xi Jinping launched a large-scale anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中纪委是该运动的主要执行机构，负责调查党员干部的违纪违法行为。
description.en: The CCDI is the main executive body of the campaign, responsible for investigating disciplinary and legal violations by party officials.

description.zh-cn: 王岐山在2012年至2017年间担任第十八届中共中央纪律检查委员会书记。
description.en: Wang Qishan served as the Secretary of the 18th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CCP from 2012 to 2017.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局常委周永康在运动中被立案审查，成为首位因腐败问题被公开查处的正国级领导人。
description.en: Former Politburo Standing Committee member Zhou Yongkang was investigated during the campaign, becoming the first national-level leader to be publicly prosecuted for corruption.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局委员徐才厚是此次反腐运动中落马的高级将领之一。
description.en: Former Politburo member Xu Caihou was one of the high-ranking military officials purged during this anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局委员郭伯雄是此次反腐运动中落马的高级将领之一。
description.en: Former Politburo member Guo Boxiong was one of the high-ranking military officials purged during this anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局委员孙政才是此次反腐运动中落马的副国级领导人之一。
description.en: Former Politburo member Sun Zhengcai was one of the vice-national level leaders purged during this anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 有观点认为，反腐运动在客观上加强了习近平的个人权威，导致中共自改革开放以来推行的集体领导制度向个人集权的强人统治回归。
description.en: Some argue that the anti-corruption campaign objectively strengthened Xi Jinping's personal authority, leading to a shift from the collective leadership system implemented since the Reform and Opening-up to a strongman rule of personal power.

description.zh-cn: 中央巡视组在“中央巡视工作领导小组”的协调下开展工作并向其汇报。
description.en: The Central Inspection Teams operate under the coordination of and report to the Central Leading Group for Inspection Work.

description.zh-cn: 受反腐行动影响，中华人民共和国政府的国际廉洁指数得分和排名在2014年至2022年期间有所上升。
description.en: Influenced by the anti-corruption campaign, the international Corruption Perception Index score and ranking of the Government of the People's Republic of China improved between 2014 and 2022.

description.zh-cn: 该案件涉及解放军高层，被部分观察家视为习近平主导的十年反腐工作未能取得根除军队腐败的预期成果。
description.en: This case, involving high-ranking PLA officials, is seen by some observers as an indication that Xi Jinping's decade-long anti-corruption campaign has failed to achieve its intended results in eradicating military corruption.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后因仇视外国势力，从默许纵容转向公开支持义和团，并最终决定向十一国宣战，将义和团运动推向高潮。
description.en: Driven by her hostility towards foreign powers, Empress Dowager Cixi's stance shifted from tacit approval to open support for the Boxers, eventually deciding to declare war on eleven nations, thus pushing the Boxer Rebellion to its climax.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军以解救使馆和镇压拳乱为名出兵中国，击败了义和团和清军，最终导致了义和团运动的失败。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance dispatched troops to China under the pretext of rescuing the legations and suppressing the Boxers. They defeated the Boxers and Qing forces, ultimately leading to the failure of the Boxer Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 义和团运动的失败直接导致清政府被迫与十一国签订《辛丑条约》，承担巨额赔款及丧失多项主权。
description.en: The failure of the Boxer Rebellion directly led to the Qing government being forced to sign the Boxer Protocol with eleven nations, incurring massive indemnities and the loss of various sovereign rights.

description.zh-cn: 在慈禧太后决定对外宣战后，清朝官方军队与义和团结为盟友，共同抵抗八国联军。
description.en: After Empress Dowager Cixi decided to declare war, the official Qing army and the Boxers became allies, jointly resisting the Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 清政府于1900年6月21日向十一国宣战，与八国联军进入战争状态。
description.en: The Qing government declared war on eleven nations on June 21, 1900, entering a state of war with the Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 义和团以“灭洋”为主要目标，与前来镇压的八国联军进行了直接的武装对抗。
description.en: With 'exterminating foreigners' as their main goal, the Boxers engaged in direct armed conflict with the invading Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 端郡王载漪因其子立储问题遭外国公使反对而仇视洋人，极力主张利用义和团向列强开战，是清廷主战派的核心人物。
description.en: Prince Duan, Zaiyi, harbored resentment towards foreigners after they opposed his son's appointment as heir apparent. He strongly advocated for using the Boxers to wage war against the foreign powers and was a central figure in the court's pro-war faction.

description.zh-cn: 吏部尚书刚毅是朝廷中支持义和团的主要官员之一，他向慈禧太后报告“拳民忠贞，神术可用”，力主抚、用义和团。
description.en: Grand Secretary Gangyi was one of the main court officials supporting the Boxers. He reported to Empress Dowager Cixi that the 'Boxers are loyal and their divine arts can be used,' strongly advocating for appeasing and utilizing them.

description.zh-cn: 作为山东巡抚，毓贤对义和团采取纵容和招抚政策，将“义和拳”改名为“义和团”，助长了其发展势头。
description.en: As Governor of Shandong, Yuxian adopted a policy of appeasement and co-optation towards the Boxers, renaming the 'Righteous and Harmonious Fists' to 'Righteous and Harmonious Militia' (Yihetuan) and fueling their growth.

description.zh-cn: 以张之洞、刘坤一为首的东南各省督抚拒绝响应清廷支持义和团的命令，维持地方稳定，客观上限制了义和团运动的蔓延。
description.en: Led by Zhang Zhidong and Liu Kunyi, governors of the southeastern provinces refused to obey the imperial court's command to support the Boxers, maintaining regional stability and objectively limiting the spread of the Boxer Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 清军神机营军官恩海在北京街头射杀了德国公使克林德。
description.en: En Hai, an officer of the Qing Manchu Banner Corps, shot and killed the German minister Clemens von Ketteler on a street in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 因许景澄反对向列强开战，主张剿灭义和团，被慈禧太后下令处死。
description.en: Xu Jingcheng was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi because he opposed declaring war on the foreign powers and advocated for the suppression of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 因袁昶反对向列强开战，主张剿灭义和团，被慈禧太后下令处死。
description.en: Yuan Chang was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi because he opposed declaring war on the foreign powers and advocated for the suppression of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 时任湖广总督的张之洞是“东南互保”的主要策划者之一。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong, then Viceroy of Huguang, was one of the main architects of the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China'.

description.zh-cn: 时任两江总督的刘坤一是“东南互保”的主要策划者之一。
description.en: Liu Kunyi, then Viceroy of Liangjiang, was one of the main architects of the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China'.

description.zh-cn: 时任两广总督的李鸿章参与了“东南互保”。
description.en: Li Hongzhang, then Viceroy of Liangguang, participated in the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China'.

description.zh-cn: 董福祥率领的甘军在廊坊等地与西摩尔率领的联军援军激战，成功阻击了其前进。
description.en: The Kansu Braves led by Dong Fuxiang engaged in fierce battles with the allied relief force led by Seymour at Langfang and other locations, successfully blocking their advance.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争战败后，西方列强在中国划分势力范围，加剧了社会矛盾和排外情绪，为义和团运动的兴起提供了背景。
description.en: After the defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War, Western powers carved out spheres of influence in China, exacerbating social tensions and anti-foreign sentiment, which provided the backdrop for the rise of the Boxer Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军于1900年8月14日攻入并占领北京。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance attacked and occupied Beijing on August 14, 1900.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军于1900年7月14日攻克天津城。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance captured the city of Tianjin on July 14, 1900.

description.zh-cn: 外国公使反对“己亥建储”，加深了慈禧太后对外国的仇视，成为其支持义和团的动因之一。
description.en: The opposition of foreign ministers to the 'Jihai Establishment' deepened Empress Dowager Cixi's hostility towards foreigners, becoming one of the motives for her support of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党领导国民革命军发动了北伐战争。
description.en: The Kuomintang led the National Revolutionary Army to launch the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 北伐战争最终瓦解了北洋军阀及其掌控的北洋政府。
description.en: The Northern Expedition ultimately dismantled the Beiyang warlords and the Beiyang government under their control.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军北伐的主要目标是消灭北洋军阀。
description.en: The main objective of the National Revolutionary Army's Northern Expedition was to eliminate the Beiyang warlords.

description.zh-cn: 被国民政府任命为国民革命军总司令，领导北伐。
description.en: Appointed by the Nationalist Government as Commander-in-Chief of the National Revolutionary Army to lead the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次国共合作期间，两党合作进行国民革命，包括北伐战争初期。
description.en: During the First United Front, the two parties cooperated in the National Revolution, including the initial phase of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 苏联向国民政府提供军事顾问、武器弹药等援助，支持其建立军队和进行北伐。
description.en: The Soviet Union provided military advisors, weapons, and ammunition to the Nationalist Government, supporting the establishment of its army and the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 东北易帜标志着国民政府在形式上完成了中国统一，象征着北伐的结束。
description.en: The Northeast Flag Replacement marked the nominal unification of China by the Nationalist Government, symbolizing the end of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府内部分裂为南京和武汉两个政府，导致北伐一度停顿。
description.en: The split of the Nationalist Government into two rival governments in Nanjing and Wuhan caused the Northern Expedition to halt temporarily.

description.zh-cn: 北伐军在湖南、湖北战场上，通过汀泗桥、贺胜桥等战役，基本消灭了吴佩孚的军事主力。
description.en: On the Hunan and Hubei battlefields, the Northern Expeditionary Army essentially eliminated the main military forces of Wu Peifu through battles like Tingsiqiao and Heshengqiao.

description.zh-cn: 北伐军在江西、福建、浙江、江苏等战场上与孙传芳军队作战，并最终将其击败。
description.en: The Northern Expeditionary Army fought and ultimately defeated Sun Chuanfang's forces on the battlefields of Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang, and Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正在上海发动清党，清洗国民党内的共产党员及左派。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek initiated the party purge in Shanghai to eliminate communists and leftists within the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 清党后，蒋中正在南京另立国民政府，与武汉的国民政府对立，形成宁汉分裂局面。
description.en: After the purge, Chiang Kai-shek established a separate Nationalist Government in Nanjing, opposing the government in Wuhan and leading to the Nanjing-Wuhan split.

description.zh-cn: 在宁汉分裂期间，武汉国民政府开除蒋中正党籍并下令讨伐。
description.en: During the Nanjing-Wuhan split, the Wuhan Nationalist Government expelled Chiang Kai-shek from the party and ordered a punitive expedition against him.

description.zh-cn: 日本出兵山东制造济南惨案，对北伐的顺利进行造成了阻碍。
description.en: Japan's dispatch of troops to Shandong, which caused the Jinan Incident, obstructed the smooth progress of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 日本军队于1928年4月出兵山东，最终在5月3日与北伐军发生冲突，制造了济南惨案。
description.en: Japanese troops were dispatched to Shandong in April 1928, eventually clashing with the Northern Expeditionary Army on May 3, creating the Jinan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在龙潭战斗中，孙传芳的部队被国民革命军决定性地击败，使其丧失了反攻南京的能力。
description.en: In the Battle of Longtan, Sun Chuanfang's forces were decisively defeated by the National Revolutionary Army, eliminating his ability to counter-attack Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥的西北军在北伐期间加入国民革命军序列，成为第二集团军。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang's Northwestern Army joined the National Revolutionary Army during the Northern Expedition, becoming the Second Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 章太炎将北伐视为“叛国行为”。
description.en: Zhang Taiyan regarded the Northern Expedition as an 'act of treason'.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山一贯主张发动北伐战争以统一中国，其思想是北伐战争的理论基础和动员力量。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen consistently advocated for launching a Northern Expedition to unify China; his ideas formed the theoretical basis and mobilizing force for the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来逝世是四五天安门事件的直接导火索，群众自发悼念活动演变为大规模抗议。
事件后，邓小平被错误地认定为幕后总指挥，导致其被撤销党内外一切职务。
事件后，中共中央政治局通过决议，任命华国锋为中共中央第一副主席和国务院总理，巩固了其作为毛泽东接班人的地位。
中共中央政治局将事件定性为“反革命政治事件”，并出动民兵、公安和卫戍部队进行暴力镇压。
四五天安门事件是文化大革命后期社会矛盾激化的产物，群众借悼念周恩来表达对文革和“四人帮”的不满。
毛泽东因不能容忍邓小平系统地纠正文革的错误，发动了“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动。
陈云在中央工作会议上率先提出为天安门事件平反，对最终平反起到了关键的推动作用。
经中共中央政治局常委会批准，北京市委正式宣布为四五天安门事件平反，称其是完全革命的行动。
南京的学生工人在列车上刷写标语，将悼念周恩来、反对“四人帮”的呼声传向全国，是四五运动的前奏。
《文汇报》在转发纪念雷锋的报道时，删去了周恩来的题词，并于3月25日发文影射周恩来，引发了南京事件。
作为毛泽东的联络员，毛远新向毛泽东汇报天安门广场的情况，并传达其指示。
姚文元为《人民日报》撰写了题为《天安门广场的反革命政治事件》的文章，将事件定性为反革命。
吴忠在事件期间担任北京卫戍区司令员。
中国普遍存在的校园欺凌问题是江油事件发生的社会背景，为该具体事件的爆发提供了土壤。
description.en: The widespread problem of school bullying in China served as the social context for the Jiangyou incident, creating fertile ground for this specific event to occur.

description.zh-cn: 于8月4日发布的警情通报因被民众认为对受害者伤情鉴定过轻、对施暴者处罚不足，进一步加剧了民愤，直接推动了事件从事态关注升级为大规模线下抗议。
description.en: The police report issued on August 4 was perceived by the public as downplaying the victim's injuries and insufficiently punishing the perpetrators, which further exacerbated public anger and directly pushed the event from a matter of public concern to a large-scale offline protest.

description.zh-cn: 政府官员对受害者家属的冷漠态度未能安抚民情，反而激化了矛盾，并协同警方对后续的民众抗议活动进行了压制。
description.en: Government officials' indifferent attitude towards the victim's family failed to appease public sentiment, instead escalating the conflict, and they collaborated with the police to suppress the subsequent public protests.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府在事件发酵后采取了信息封锁措施，包括在江油街头部署信号干扰车以及在社交媒体上进行广泛审查，以阻止相关信息的传播。
description.en: After the incident escalated, the Chinese government implemented information blockade measures, including deploying signal jamming vehicles on the streets of Jiangyou and conducting widespread censorship on social media to prevent the dissemination of related information.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 新修订的法律增加了对校园欺凌的处置措施，并允许对情节严重的14至18岁违法人员执行拘留，旨在更有效地遏制此类行为。
description.en: The newly revised law adds measures for handling school bullying and allows for the detention of offenders aged 14 to 18 in serious cases, aiming to more effectively deter such behavior.

description.zh-cn: 作为江油事件前发生的一起类似的大规模民众抗议事件，蒲城事件为公众在面对官方处理校园相关问题不当时采取集体行动提供了参照，影响了江油事件的抗议模式。
description.en: As a similar large-scale public protest that occurred before the Jiangyou incident, the Pucheng incident provided a reference for collective public action in response to official mishandling of school-related issues, influencing the protest pattern in the Jiangyou event.

description.zh-cn: 网民借用电影《南京照相馆》中揭露暴行和对抗封锁的主题，创造出“江油照相馆”这一代称，用以在网络审查下讨论江油事件并讽刺官方行为，影响了该事件的网络话语体系。
description.en: Netizens borrowed the theme of exposing atrocities and resisting blockades from the film 'Nanjing Photo Studio' to create the code name 'Jiangyou Photo Studio', using it to discuss the Jiangyou incident under internet censorship and satirize official actions, thereby influencing the event's online discourse.

description.zh-cn: 由于江油事件发生在该运动会于邻近的成都开幕前夕，维稳的政治压力极大，这影响并可能加剧了地方政府对示威活动采取迅速而强硬的镇压手段。
description.en: Because the Jiangyou incident occurred just before the opening of the World Games in nearby Chengdu, the political pressure to maintain stability was immense, which influenced and likely intensified the local government's swift and harsh crackdown on the protests.

description.zh-cn: 指控前市长郝龙斌需要为“台智光案”负责，此举引发郝龙斌反击，从而引爆京华城案。
description.en: Accused former mayor Hau Lung-pin of being responsible for the 'Tpe-Gateway case', which provoked Hau to retaliate, thereby igniting the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 反击柯文哲对台智光案的指控，直指柯文哲在京华城案中给予不当容积奖励，促使司法机关展开调查。
description.en: Countered Ko Wen-je's accusations regarding the Tpe-Gateway case by pointing out that Ko granted improper floor area ratio bonuses in the Core Pacific City case, prompting judicial investigation.

description.zh-cn: 在京华城案审理过程中，裁定将柯文哲羁押禁见。
description.en: During the trial of the Core Pacific City case, the court ruled to detain Ko Wen-je and prohibit visits and correspondence.

description.zh-cn: 被检方指控为京华城案向台北市议员应晓薇行贿，以换取其向市府官员游说。
description.en: Accused by prosecutors of bribing Taipei City Councilor Ying Hsiao-wei in the Core Pacific City case in exchange for her lobbying of city government officials.

description.zh-cn: 涉嫌收受沈庆京贿赂后，为京华城容积奖励一事多次召开协调会并游说市府官员。
description.en: After allegedly accepting bribes from Shen Ching-ching, she held multiple coordination meetings and lobbied city officials regarding the floor area ratio bonus for Core Pacific City.

description.zh-cn: 在柯文哲因京华城案遭羁押后，多次举办集会活动声援柯文哲，并主张其遭受司法迫害。
description.en: After Ko Wen-je was detained in the Core Pacific City case, the party held multiple rallies to support him, claiming he was a victim of judicial persecution.

description.zh-cn: 就京华城容积率认定争议提出纠正案，促使台北市政府处理此案，并于2018年发函确认容积率为560%，成为后续变更的基础。
description.en: Issued a corrective measure regarding the dispute over Core Pacific City's floor area ratio, prompting the Taipei City Government to address the case, and confirmed the ratio as 560% in a 2018 letter, which became the basis for subsequent changes.

description.zh-cn: 在市议会质询时，质疑柯文哲市府给予京华城不合理的超高容积率。
description.en: During a city council inquiry, she questioned the Ko Wen-je administration for granting an unreasonably high floor area ratio to Core Pacific City.

description.zh-cn: 在柯文哲担任台北市长期间，彭振声担任其副市长。
description.en: Peng Chen-sheng served as Deputy Mayor under Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je.

position.zh-cn: 台北市市长办公室主任
position.en: Director of the Taipei City Mayor's Office

description.zh-cn: 在柯文哲担任台北市长期间，李文宗担任其办公室主任。
description.en: Li Wen-tsung served as the Director of the Mayor's Office under Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je.

description.zh-cn: 杨忠是杨坚的父亲。
description.en: Yang Zhong was Yang Jian's father.

description.zh-cn: 吕苦桃是杨坚的母亲。
description.en: Lü Kutao was Yang Jian's mother.

description.zh-cn: 独孤伽罗是杨坚的妻子和皇后。
description.en: Dugu Qieluo was Yang Jian's wife and empress.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚篡夺北周政权，建立隋朝，改元开皇。
description.en: Yang Jian usurped the Northern Zhou regime, established the Sui dynasty, and changed the era name to Kaihuang.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚逼迫北周静帝禅位，取代北周，并屠杀了北周宇文皇族。
description.en: Yang Jian forced Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou to abdicate, replaced the Northern Zhou, and massacred the Yuwen imperial family of Northern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚发动隋灭陈之战，攻占建康，俘虏陈后主，灭亡了陈朝。
description.en: Yang Jian launched the Sui campaign against Chen, captured Jiankang, captured Chen Shubao, and destroyed the Chen dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚废黜西梁后主萧琮，吞并了西梁政权。
description.en: Yang Jian deposed the last ruler of Western Liang, Xiao Cong, and annexed the state.

description.zh-cn: 北周宣帝驾崩后，刘昉与郑译等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政，为杨坚夺取政权创造了条件。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Xuan of Northern Zhou, Liu Fang, along with Zheng Yi and others, forged an edict to make Yang Jian regent, creating the conditions for Yang Jian to seize power.

description.zh-cn: 北周宣帝驾崩后，郑译与刘昉等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政，为杨坚夺取政权创造了条件。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Xuan of Northern Zhou, Zheng Yi, along with Liu Fang and others, forged an edict to make Yang Jian regent, creating the conditions for Yang Jian to seize power.

description.zh-cn: 尉迟迥不满杨坚专政，在相州起兵讨伐杨坚，但最终兵败。
description.en: Dissatisfied with Yang Jian's dictatorship, Yuchi Jiong launched a rebellion against him in Xiangzhou, but was ultimately defeated.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚派兵迅速平定了尉迟迥的叛乱。
description.en: Yang Jian dispatched troops and quickly suppressed Yuchi Jiong's rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 宇文招设下鸿门宴，企图在宴会上刺杀杨坚，但未能成功。
description.en: Yuwen Zhao set up a feast with the intent to assassinate Yang Jian, but the attempt was unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚在得知宇文招的刺杀企图后，诬陷其谋反并将其及诸子诛杀。
description.en: After learning of Yuwen Zhao's assassination attempt, Yang Jian framed him for treason and had him and his sons executed.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚在位期间励精图治，实行了一系列有效的政治经济改革，开创了开皇之治的盛世局面。
description.en: During his reign, Yang Jian governed diligently and implemented a series of effective political and economic reforms, creating the prosperous era known as the Reign of Kaihuang.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚即位后，废除了自魏晋以来施行的九品中正制，以改革官员选拔制度。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Yang Jian abolished the Nine-rank system that had been in place since the Wei and Jin dynasties to reform the official selection system.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚开创了科举制度的先河，规定各州每年向中央选送人才参加考试，合格者录用为官，打破了门阀对官职的垄断。
description.en: Yang Jian pioneered the Imperial Examination system, stipulating that each prefecture should recommend talents to the central government for examinations annually, with successful candidates being appointed as officials, thus breaking the monopoly of aristocratic clans on official positions.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚因长子杨勇生活奢华等原因，废黜了他的太子之位。
description.en: Emperor Wen of Sui deposed his eldest son Yang Yong from the position of crown prince due to his extravagant lifestyle and other reasons.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚在废黜杨勇后，册立善于伪装的次子杨广（即隋炀帝）为太子。
description.en: After deposing Yang Yong, Emperor Wen of Sui installed his second son Yang Guang (later Emperor Yang), who was skilled at dissimulation, as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 有说法称隋文帝杨坚是被其子太子杨广所谋杀。
description.en: It is said that Emperor Wen of Sui was murdered by his son, Crown Prince Yang Guang.

description.zh-cn: 北周齐王宇文宪曾对北周武帝评价杨坚相貌非常，认为他颇为狡诈，请求尽早除掉他。
description.en: Yuwen Xian, Prince of Qi of Northern Zhou, once commented to Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou that Yang Jian had an extraordinary appearance, considered him quite cunning, and requested his early elimination.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿接替黄克诚担任中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: Luo Ruiqing succeeded Huang Kecheng as the Chief of the General Staff of the PLA.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿被免去总参谋长职务后，由杨成武代理。
description.en: After Luo Ruiqing was dismissed from his post as Chief of the General Staff, Yang Chengwu served as the acting chief.

description.zh-cn: 谢富治接替罗瑞卿担任中华人民共和国公安部部长。
description.en: Xie Fuzhi succeeded Luo Ruiqing as the Minister of Public Security of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，因罗瑞卿事件而被批判，后跳楼负重伤，并被撤销全部职务及监护。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, he was criticized due to the Luo Ruiqing Incident, suffered severe injuries from a suicide attempt by jumping from a building, was dismissed from all his posts, and placed under surveillance.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件中，罗瑞卿被指责为“反对突出政治”、“反对林彪”，随后被调离军事工作领导岗位并受到批判。
description.en: In the Luo Ruiqing Incident, Luo was accused of 'opposing the prominence of politics' and 'opposing Lin Biao,' and was subsequently removed from his military leadership position and criticized.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委内部日渐分裂，林彪与罗瑞卿分属不同派别，最终在1965年12月的上海会议上，林彪等人对罗瑞卿进行突然袭击，导致罗瑞卿事件。
description.en: The Central Military Commission gradually split, with Lin Biao and Luo Ruiqing in opposing factions. This culminated in the Shanghai Conference of December 1965, where Lin Biao and others launched a surprise attack on Luo Ruiqing, leading to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，叶群与林彪等人一同对罗瑞卿进行突然袭击，导致罗瑞卿事件。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Ye Qun, along with Lin Biao and others, launched a surprise attack on Luo Ruiqing, leading to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，吴法宪与林彪等人一同对罗瑞卿进行突然袭击，导致罗瑞卿事件。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Wu Faxian, along with Lin Biao and others, launched a surprise attack on Luo Ruiqing, leading to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，李作鹏与林彪等人一同对罗瑞卿进行突然袭击，导致罗瑞卿事件。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Li Zuopeng, along with Lin Biao and others, launched a surprise attack on Luo Ruiqing, leading to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，贺龙、罗瑞卿为首的一派与林彪等人对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with one led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing in opposition to Lin Biao and others.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，叶剑英与林彪等人为一派，与贺龙、罗瑞卿一派对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with Ye Jianying, Lin Biao, and others in one faction opposing the faction led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，聂荣臻与林彪等人为一派，与贺龙、罗瑞卿一派对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with Nie Rongzhen, Lin Biao, and others in one faction opposing the faction led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，杨成武与林彪等人为一派，与贺龙、罗瑞卿一派对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with Yang Chengwu, Lin Biao, and others in one faction opposing the faction led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东首肯了林彪等人对罗瑞卿的攻击，导致罗瑞卿事件的发生。
description.en: Mao Zedong approved the attack on Luo Ruiqing by Lin Biao and others, which led to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东表示其是“听了林彪一面之辞，错整了罗瑞卿”，为罗瑞卿的平反奠定了基础。
description.en: Mao Zedong stated that he had 'wrongly purged Luo Ruiqing based on Lin Biao's one-sided account,' laying the groundwork for Luo's rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 在京西宾馆会议上，罗瑞卿被挂上“篡军反党”、“反对毛主席”、“反对毛泽东思想”而受到批判。
description.en: At the Jingxi Hotel Conference, Luo Ruiqing was criticized under the labels of 'usurping the army and opposing the Party,' 'opposing Chairman Mao,' and 'opposing Mao Zedong Thought'.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇主持召开中共中央政治局扩大会议，批判“彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆的‘反党错误’”，并决定停止和撤销罗瑞卿的全部职务。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi presided over an enlarged meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, criticizing the 'anti-Party errors' of Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun, and decided to suspend and dismiss Luo Ruiqing from all his posts.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇主持召开中共中央政治局扩大会议，批判“彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆的‘反党错误’”。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi presided over an enlarged meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, criticizing the 'anti-Party errors' of Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇主持召开中共中央政治局扩大会议，批判“彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆的‘反党错误’”。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi presided over an enlarged meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, criticizing the 'anti-Party errors' of Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun.

description.zh-cn: “文化大革命”结束后，罗瑞卿在政治上得到平反。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution ended, Luo Ruiqing was politically rehabilitated.

description.zh-cn: 该文章的发表引发了关于真理标准问题的大讨论。
description.en: The publication of this article triggered the great discussion on the criterion of truth.

description.zh-cn: 促成《马克思主义的一个最基本的原则》在《解放军报》上发表，推动了“真理标准大讨论”的开展。
description.en: He facilitated the publication of 'A Most Fundamental Principle of Marxism' in the 'Liberation Army Daily', promoting the 'great discussion on the criterion of truth'.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿逝世后，邓小平前往机场迎灵，并于8月12日的追悼会上致悼词。
description.en: After Luo Ruiqing's death, Deng Xiaoping went to the airport to receive his remains and delivered the eulogy at the memorial service on August 12.

description.zh-cn: 因叶剑英就罗瑞卿跳楼一事作诗表达同情，周恩来严厉批判其“完全站到罗瑞卿一边”。
description.en: Because Ye Jianying wrote a poem expressing sympathy for Luo Ruiqing's suicide attempt, Zhou Enlai severely criticized him for 'completely siding with Luo Ruiqing'.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞是洋务派后期的主要代表人物。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong was a major representative figure of the Westernization Movement in its later stages.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞早年是清流派的健将。
description.en: In his early years, Zhang Zhidong was a stalwart of the Qingliu school.

description.zh-cn: 据说因为慈禧太后喜欢张之洞的文章，在其考中进士后破例提拔。后来又扶植他以抗衡湘军和淮军势力。
description.en: It is said that Empress Dowager Cixi appreciated Zhang Zhidong's writings and promoted him exceptionally after he passed the imperial examination. She later supported him to counterbalance the power of the Xiang and Huai armies.

description.zh-cn: 在担任湖广总督期间，张之洞创办了汉阳铁厂。
description.en: During his tenure as Viceroy of Huguang, Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞镇压了自立军起义并处决了其领导者唐才常。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong suppressed the Self-Supporting Army Uprising and executed its leader, Tang Caichang.

description.zh-cn: 在义和团运动期间，张之洞会同两江总督刘坤一与各国领事议订“东南互保”。两人后又于1901年联衔上奏推行新政。
description.en: During the Boxer Rebellion, Zhang Zhidong, together with Viceroy of Liangjiang Liu Kunyi, negotiated the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China' with foreign consuls. They later jointly submitted a memorial in 1901 to implement new policies.

description.zh-cn: 文本记载张之洞对李鸿章似有成见，尤其不满其身后谥为文忠。
description.en: The text states that Zhang Zhidong seemed to hold a prejudice against Li Hongzhang, particularly being dissatisfied with Li's posthumous title 'Wenzhong'.

description.zh-cn: 1884年中法战争时，张之洞由山西巡抚升任两广总督。
description.en: During the Sino-French War in 1884, Zhang Zhidong was promoted from Governor of Shanxi to Viceroy of Liangguang.

description.zh-cn: 升任两广总督后，张之洞起用了退休老将冯子材以抵抗法军。
description.en: After being promoted to Viceroy of Liangguang, Zhang Zhidong re-employed the retired general Feng Zicai to resist the French forces.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞作为两广总督，支持并指挥了包括镇南关之役在内的对法军事行动。
description.en: As Viceroy of Liangguang, Zhang Zhidong supported and commanded military operations against the French, including the Battle of Zhennan Pass.

description.zh-cn: 1893年，时任湖广总督的张之洞奏请光绪帝创办自强学堂。
description.en: In 1893, Zhang Zhidong, then Viceroy of Huguang, petitioned the Guangxu Emperor to establish the Ziqiang Institute.

description.zh-cn: 在张之洞的奏请下，光绪帝批准创办了自强学堂。
description.en: At the request of Zhang Zhidong, the Guangxu Emperor approved the establishment of the Ziqiang Institute.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞与袁世凯、徐世昌等人都列名参加了强学会。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong, along with Yuan Shikai and Xu Shichang, was listed as a member of the Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞曾出资赞助强学会。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong provided financial sponsorship to the Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯与张之洞、徐世昌等人都列名参加了强学会。
description.en: Yuan Shikai, along with Zhang Zhidong and Xu Shichang, was listed as a member of the Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening.

description.zh-cn: 1898年，张之洞发表《劝学篇》，提出“旧学为体，新学为用”的思想。
description.en: In 1898, Zhang Zhidong published 'Exhortation to Study,' proposing the idea of 'Chinese learning as the essence, Western learning for practical use'.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞力主镇压义和团运动，并联合东南督抚实行东南自保。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong strongly advocated for the suppression of the Boxer Rebellion and joined with southeastern governors to implement the Mutual Protection of Southeast China.

description.zh-cn: 1906年12月，湖广总督张之洞派新军会剿萍浏醴起义军。
description.en: In December 1906, Viceroy of Huguang Zhang Zhidong dispatched the New Army to help suppress the Ping-Liu-Li Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后去世后，张之洞作为顾命大臣，力劝摄政王载沣不要杀袁世凯。
description.en: After the death of Empress Dowager Cixi, Zhang Zhidong, as a regent minister, strongly persuaded Prince Regent Zaifeng not to execute Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞与以康有为、梁启超为代表的激进改良派持有不同的政治主张。梁启超曾撰文批评张之洞“爱名爱身甚于爱国”。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong held different political views from the radical reformists represented by Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao. Liang Qichao once wrote an article criticizing Zhang for 'loving his reputation and himself more than his country'.

description.zh-cn: 1905年，张之洞认为留日学生风潮为革命党孙文煽动，电请各省督抚设法开导解散，以消除革命隐患。
description.en: In 1905, Zhang Zhidong believed that the student unrest among those studying in Japan was instigated by the revolutionary Sun Yat-sen, and he telegraphed provincial governors to find ways to persuade and disperse them to eliminate the threat of revolution.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞位于南皮县的原墓在文化大革命期间被毁。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong's original tomb in Nanpi County was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1966年，红卫兵刨开了张之洞的坟墓，并对其遗体进行了破坏。
description.en: In 1966, Red Guards dug up Zhang Zhidong's grave and desecrated his remains.

description.zh-cn: 张瑛是张之洞的父亲。
description.en: Zhang Ying was Zhang Zhidong's father.

description.zh-cn: 张之万是张之洞的从兄（堂兄）。
description.en: Zhang Zhiwan was Zhang Zhidong's paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 张权是张之洞的长子。
description.en: Zhang Quan was Zhang Zhidong's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 张仁蠡是张之洞的幼子。
description.en: Zhang Renli was Zhang Zhidong's youngest son.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌六君子之一的杨锐是张之洞的得意弟子。
description.en: Yang Rui, one of the Six Gentlemen of the Hundred Days' Reform, was a favorite disciple of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 辜鸿铭曾担任张之洞的幕僚。
description.en: Gu Hongming once served as an aide to Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞曾师从古琴家黄勉之学习古琴。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong studied the guqin under the tutelage of master Huang Mianzhi.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞在光绪十五年至光绪三十三年间，曾四度出任湖广总督。
description.en: Between 1889 and 1907, Zhang Zhidong served as the Viceroy of Huguang on four separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞于光绪十年至十五年间担任两广总督。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong served as the Viceroy of Liangguang from 1884 to 1889.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞于光绪三十三年被任命为军机大臣，直至去世。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong was appointed as a Grand Councilor in 1907 and held the position until his death.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什是第41任美国总统乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什的儿子。
description.en: George W. Bush is the son of the 41st U.S. President, George H. W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什是芭芭拉·布什的儿子。
description.en: George W. Bush is the son of Barbara Bush.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1977年11月5日与劳拉·威尔士结婚。
description.en: George W. Bush married Laura Welch on November 5, 1977.

description.zh-cn: 杰布·布什是乔治·沃克·布什的弟弟。
description.en: Jeb Bush is the younger brother of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1968年在耶鲁大学取得历史学学士学位。
description.en: George W. Bush received a Bachelor of Arts degree in history from Yale University in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1975年获得哈佛大学工商管理硕士学位。
description.en: George W. Bush earned a Master of Business Administration degree from Harvard University in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什是美国共和党成员，并代表该党当选州长和总统。
description.en: George W. Bush is a member of the Republican Party and was elected Governor and President as its nominee.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1995年至2000年间担任第46任德克萨斯州州长。
description.en: George W. Bush served as the 46th Governor of Texas from 1995 to 2000.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于2001年至2009年间担任第43任美国总统。
description.en: George W. Bush served as the 43rd President of the United States from 2001 to 2009.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什接替比尔·克林顿成为美国总统。
description.en: George W. Bush succeeded Bill Clinton as President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 巴拉克·奥巴马接替乔治·沃克·布什成为美国总统。
description.en: Barack Obama succeeded George W. Bush as President of the United States.

position.en: Vice President of the United States

description.zh-cn: 迪克·切尼在乔治·沃克·布什的总统任期内担任副总统。
description.en: Dick Cheney served as Vice President during George W. Bush's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 九一一袭击事件是布什总统任内的转捩点，促使他发动了一连串反恐战争。
description.en: The September 11 attacks were a turning point in Bush's presidency, leading him to launch a series of campaigns in the War on Terror.

description.zh-cn: 在九一一袭击事件后，乔治·沃克·布什发动了一连串反恐战争。
description.en: Following the September 11 attacks, George W. Bush launched a series of campaigns in the War on Terror.

description.zh-cn: 作为反恐战争的一部分，乔治·沃克·布什于2001年10月发动了阿富汗战争。
description.en: As part of the War on Terror, George W. Bush launched the War in Afghanistan in October 2001.

description.zh-cn: 阿富汗战争旨在推翻塔利班政权。
description.en: The War in Afghanistan was intended to overthrow the Taliban regime.

description.zh-cn: 阿富汗战争旨在铲除基地组织势力。
description.en: The War in Afghanistan was intended to eliminate the presence of al-Qaeda.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于2003年3月发动了伊拉克战争。
description.en: George W. Bush launched the Iraq War in March 2003.

description.zh-cn: 伊拉克战争推翻了萨达姆·侯赛因的政权。
description.en: The Iraq War overthrew the regime of Saddam Hussein.

description.zh-cn: 2001年，乔治·沃克·布什主导帮助中国大陆进入世界贸易组织。
description.en: In 2001, George W. Bush led efforts to facilitate Mainland China's entry into the World Trade Organization.

description.zh-cn: 在2000年美国总统选举中，乔治·沃克·布什击败了民主党候选人艾尔·戈尔。
description.en: George W. Bush defeated Democratic candidate Al Gore in the 2000 United States presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在2004年美国总统选举中，乔治·沃克·布什击败了民主党参选人约翰·克里，成功连任。
description.en: George W. Bush defeated Democratic candidate John Kerry in the 2004 United States presidential election to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 布什政府在飓风卡特里娜救灾工作上的处置遭遇到众多批评，使其支持度下滑。
description.en: The Bush administration's handling of the Hurricane Katrina relief efforts faced widespread criticism, leading to a decline in his approval ratings.

description.zh-cn: 唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德在布什总统任内担任国防部长。
description.en: Donald Rumsfeld served as Secretary of Defense under President Bush.

description.zh-cn: 克林·鲍威尔在布什总统任内担任国务卿。
description.en: Colin Powell served as Secretary of State under President Bush.

description.zh-cn: 康多莉扎·赖斯在布什总统的第二任期内担任国务卿。
description.en: Condoleezza Rice served as Secretary of State during President Bush's second term.

description.zh-cn: 罗伯特·盖茨在布什总统任内接替拉姆斯菲尔德担任国防部长。
description.en: Robert Gates succeeded Donald Rumsfeld as Secretary of Defense under President Bush.

description.zh-cn: 2006年4月20日，布什总统与时任中国国家主席胡锦涛在白宫会面。
description.en: On April 20, 2006, President Bush met with then-Chinese President Hu Jintao at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 布什与时任英国首相托尼·布莱尔保持亲密的合作关系和感情。
description.en: Bush maintained a close cooperative and personal relationship with then-British Prime Minister Tony Blair.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫在第六届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上当选为中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Ulanhu was elected Vice President of the People's Republic of China at the First Session of the Sixth National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 王震接替乌兰夫出任中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Wang Zhen succeeded Ulanhu as the Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 布赫是乌兰夫的长子。
description.en: Buhe is the eldest son of Ulanhu.

description.zh-cn: 1923年，乌兰夫进入北平蒙藏学校学习。
description.en: In 1923, Ulanhu entered the Mongolian and Tibetan School in Beiping to study.

description.zh-cn: 1925年9月，被派赴莫斯科中山大学学习。
description.en: In September 1925, he was sent to study at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University.

description.zh-cn: 在北京蒙藏学校学习期间，在李大钊、赵世炎、邓中夏等共产党人的帮助下，乌兰夫参加了马克思主义研究小组。
description.en: During his studies at the Mongolian and Tibetan School in Beijing, with the help of communists like Li Dazhao, Zhao Shiyan, and Deng Zhongxia, Ulanhu joined a Marxism study group.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫领导组建内蒙古自治政府，并被选为主席。
description.en: Ulanhu led the formation of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Government and was elected its chairman.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫组织成立了内蒙古自治运动联合会，并出任主席。
description.en: Ulanhu organized the establishment of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Movement Federation and served as its chairman.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫成功解散了以补英达赖为首的内蒙古人民共和国临时政府。
description.en: Ulanhu successfully dissolved the Provisional Government of the Inner Mongolian People's Republic led by Buyandalai.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫成功解散了以补英达赖为首的内蒙古人民共和国临时政府。
description.en: Ulanhu successfully dissolved the Provisional Government of the Inner Mongolian People's Republic led by Buyandalai.

description.zh-cn: “文化大革命”开始后，乌兰夫因“内人党”问题被批斗，并被撤销党政军领导职务软禁于北京。
description.en: After the start of the 'Cultural Revolution', Ulanhu was persecuted over the 'Inner Mongolian People's Party' issue, removed from his party, government, and military leadership positions, and placed under house arrest in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫在文革中因“内人党”问题被批斗和撤职。
description.en: Ulanhu was persecuted and removed from office during the Cultural Revolution due to the 'Inner Mongolian People's Party' incident.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫在文革期间受到国务院总理周恩来的保护。
description.en: Ulanhu was protected by Premier Zhou Enlai during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据中共中央主席毛泽东的意见，乌兰夫等13位老干部被宣布解放。
description.en: According to the opinion of CPC Chairman Mao Zedong, Ulanhu and 12 other veteran cadres were declared liberated.

description.zh-cn: 1983年6月10日，国家副主席候选人廖承志因突发心脏病逝世。
description.en: On June 10, 1983, Liao Chengzhi, a candidate for Vice President, died of a sudden heart attack.

description.zh-cn: 在廖承志逝世后，中共中央政治局召开扩大会议，决定由乌兰夫替补为国家副主席候选人。
description.en: After the death of Liao Chengzhi, the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged meeting and decided that Ulanhu would be the replacement candidate for Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 朱济熿娶李景隆之女为正妃，是其女婿。
担任《明太祖实录》的监修。
担任《明太祖实录》的副监修。
担任《明太祖实录》的总裁。
因李景隆举止雍容华贵而多次瞩目于他。
信任李景隆，在耿炳文战败后任命其为大将军，北伐燕王。
在靖难之役中，作为建文帝的大将军，与燕王朱棣为敌对关系，并屡次败于朱棣。
与谷王朱橞开金川门投降，归顺燕王朱棣。
永乐二年，在群臣弹劾下，朱棣下诏削去李景隆的爵位并将其合家软禁。
洪武二十年随军参加进攻纳哈出的战役。
奉建文帝之命，至开封将周王朱橚全家押回南京。
在耿炳文战败后，向建文帝举荐李景隆接任大将军。
在李景隆兵败还京后，愤怒地在朝廷上抓住李景隆，请求将他处死。
极力反对黄子澄的提议，认为不应任命李景隆为大将军。
在围攻北平时，因嫉妒都督瞿能之功，在其即将攻破张掖门时下令停止，导致功败垂成。
在李景隆退守济南后，盛庸奉命替代他为大将军。
在燕军渡江后，请求建文帝诛杀李景隆。
与谷王朱橞一同打开金川门，迎接燕军入城，是此事件的核心人物。
与李景隆一同打开金川门，迎接燕军入城。
永乐二年，周王朱橚揭发李景隆在建文年间收受贿赂之事，成为弹劾李景隆的开端之一。
与群臣一同当廷弹劾李景隆及其弟李增枝谋逆。
与群臣一同当廷弹劾李景隆及其弟李增枝谋逆。
弹劾李景隆在家中接受守门人跪拜，行君臣之礼，大逆不道。
继承父亲李文忠的爵位。
担任行宪后第一任中华民国监察院院长，直至逝世。
description.en: Served as the first President of the Control Yuan of the Republic of China after the constitution was enacted, holding the position until his death.

description.zh-cn: 担任国民政府时期第三任监察院院长。
description.en: Served as the third President of the Control Yuan during the Nationalist Government period.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋中正担任总统期间，于右任任监察院院长。
description.en: Yu Youren served as the President of the Control Yuan while Chiang Kai-shek was the President.

description.zh-cn: 李嗣璁在于右任逝世后接替其监察院院长职务。
description.en: Li Si-tsung succeeded Yu Youren as the President of the Control Yuan after Yu's death.

description.zh-cn: 于右任接替赵戴文担任国民政府监察院院长。
description.en: Yu Youren succeeded Zhao Daiwen as the President of the Control Yuan of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 宋哲元接替于右任担任陕西省政府主席。
description.en: Song Zheyuan succeeded Yu Youren as the Chairman of the Shaanxi Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 在许世英担任国务总理期间，于右任任内务总长。
description.en: Yu Youren served as the Minister of the Interior while Xu Shiying was the Premier.

description.zh-cn: 因遭清廷通缉流亡上海，化名“刘学裕”进入震旦公学学习。
description.en: After becoming a fugitive wanted by the Qing court, he fled to Shanghai and enrolled in Aurora University under the alias 'Liu Xueyu'.

description.zh-cn: 因于右任刊印《半哭半笑楼诗草》，时任陕甘总督升允以“逆竖昌言革命，大逆不道”的罪名密奏朝廷，导致于右任被革除功名并遭通缉。
description.en: Due to Yu Youren's publication of 'Poems from the Half-Crying Half-Laughing Tower', Sheng Yun, the Viceroy of Shaanxi and Gansu, secretly reported him to the throne on charges of 'treasonous remarks advocating revolution,' leading to Yu being stripped of his official honors and becoming a wanted man.

description.zh-cn: 在于右任就读震旦学院期间，院长马相伯十分赏识他。
description.en: During Yu Youren's studies at Aurora University, President Ma Xiangbo held him in high regard.

description.zh-cn: 因负面报导遭到清廷控告，被迫停刊。
description.en: Forced to cease publication after being sued by the Qing government for negative reporting.

description.zh-cn: 因报导伊藤博文遇刺事件倾向性明显，遭到日方抗议，租界当局查封了该报。
description.en: Due to its biased coverage of the assassination of Itō Hirobumi, the newspaper faced protests from the Japanese side, leading to its seizure by the concession authorities.

description.zh-cn: 推举于右任担任陕西靖国军总司令。
description.en: Nominated Yu Youren to be the commander-in-chief of the Shaanxi Pacification Army.

description.zh-cn: 其领导的广东军政府任命于右任为陕西督军。
description.en: The Guangzhou Military Government led by him appointed Yu Youren as the Military Governor of Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 参与创办上海大学，并担任首任校长。
description.en: Participated in the founding of Shanghai University and served as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 代表中国国民党赴苏联促使冯玉祥回国参加国民革命军北伐。
description.en: On behalf of the Kuomintang, traveled to the Soviet Union to persuade Feng Yuxiang to return to China and participate in the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 筹备建设国立西北农林专科学校（今西北农林科技大学），并就任首任校长。
description.en: He prepared for the establishment of the National Northwest Agricultural and Forestry College (now Northwest A&F University) and became its first president.

description.zh-cn: 在占领立法院事件中，示威群众拆下了由于右任题写的“立法院”匾额。
description.en: During the occupation of the Legislative Yuan, protesters removed the plaque inscribed with 'Legislative Yuan' written by Yu Youren.

position.zh-cn: 首相经济和金融高级顾问
position.en: Senior Advisor on Economics and Finance to the Prime Minister

description.zh-cn: 安华委任其女儿努鲁依莎为首相经济和金融高级顾问。
description.en: Anwar appointed his daughter Nurul Izzah as Senior Advisor on Economics and Finance to the Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 1982年，时任首相马哈迪·莫哈末邀请安华加入执政党巫统，开启了安华的政府官职生涯。
description.en: In 1982, then-Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad invited Anwar to join the ruling party UMNO, launching Anwar's career in government.

description.zh-cn: 安华于1982年加入巫统，并逐步晋升至署理主席，直至1998年被开除党籍。
description.en: Anwar joined UMNO in 1982 and rose through the ranks to become Deputy President, until his expulsion in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年亚洲金融危机期间，安华作为财长与首相马哈迪在应对政策上发生严重分歧，这直接导致了安华于1998年被革除所有职务。
description.en: During the 1997 Asian financial crisis, Anwar, as Finance Minister, had serious policy disagreements with Prime Minister Mahathir, which directly led to his dismissal from all posts in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 1998年9月2日，首相马哈迪·莫哈末革除了安华的副首相兼财政部长职位。
description.en: On September 2, 1998, Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad dismissed Anwar from his positions as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 安华被革职后，他的支持者发动了“烈火莫熄”社会政治改革运动。
description.en: After Anwar's dismissal, his supporters launched the "Reformasi" socio-political reform movement.

description.zh-cn: 烈火莫熄运动直接促使了新的多元种族政党——国民公正党（后为人民公正党）的成立。
description.en: The Reformasi movement directly spurred the formation of a new multi-racial political party, the National Justice Party (later the People's Justice Party).

description.zh-cn: 安华先后两次因鸡奸案被判入狱，这些审判严重阻碍了他的政治生涯。
description.en: Anwar was twice sentenced to prison on sodomy charges, trials that significantly hampered his political career.

description.zh-cn: 1987年，时任教育部长安华指示教育部派遣不谙华文的教师出任华小高职，引发了华社的强烈抗议，成为“茅草行动”大逮捕的导火索之一。
description.en: In 1987, then-Minister of Education Anwar instructed the ministry to appoint non-Mandarin-speaking teachers to senior positions in Chinese primary schools, sparking strong protests from the Chinese community and becoming one of the triggers for the "Operation Lalang" crackdown.

description.zh-cn: 安华重返政坛后，与时任人民公正党署理主席阿兹敏阿里的政治斗争加剧，最终导致阿兹敏在2020年带领其派系出走，引发政治危机。
description.en: After Anwar's return to politics, his political struggle with then-PKR Deputy President Azmin Ali intensified, culminating in Azmin leading his faction out of the party in 2020, triggering a political crisis.

description.zh-cn: 阿兹敏阿里带领10名公正党议员退出希望联盟，是导致2020年政治危机和希盟政府倒台的关键事件之一。
description.en: Azmin Ali's move to lead 10 PKR MPs out of Pakatan Harapan was one of the key events that led to the 2020 political crisis and the collapse of the PH government.

description.zh-cn: 2020年的政治危机导致希望联盟政府垮台。
description.en: The 2020 political crisis led to the collapse of the Pakatan Harapan government.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年大选后出现悬峙议会的情况下，国家元首苏丹阿都拉任命安华为马来西亚第十任首相。
description.en: Following the hung parliament after the 2022 general election, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong Sultan Abdullah appointed Anwar as the 10th Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 宋任穷是宋彬彬的父亲。
description.en: Song Renqiong is Song Binbin's father.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命使宋彬彬成为全国闻名的红卫兵领袖。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution made Song Binbin a nationally famous Red Guard leader.

description.zh-cn: 在北京“红八月”期间，副校长卞仲耘被师大女附中的红卫兵批斗致死。
description.en: During Beijing's 'Red August', Vice Principal Bian Zhongyun was beaten to death by Red Guards from the Affiliated Girls' Middle School of Beijing Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 作为北京师范大学女附中的红卫兵领袖，宋彬彬对该校副校长卞仲耘在“红八月”期间被批斗致死的事件负有责任。她本人在2014年为此道歉。
description.en: As a leader of the Red Guards at the Beijing Normal University Affiliated Girls' Middle School, Song Binbin bore responsibility for the death of Vice Principal Bian Zhongyun, who was beaten to death during 'Red August'. She apologized for this in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 在天安门城楼上为毛泽东佩戴红卫兵袖章，并被毛泽东建议改名为“要武”。
description.en: On the Tiananmen Rostrum, she put a Red Guard armband on Mao Zedong, who then suggested she change her name to 'Yaowu'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在天安门城楼接见宋彬彬，并为其建议名字“要武”，此举使宋彬彬闻名全国，推动了她的红卫兵领袖地位。
description.en: Mao Zedong received Song Binbin on the Tiananmen Rostrum and suggested the name 'Yaowu' for her. This act made her nationally famous and promoted her status as a Red Guard leader.

description.zh-cn: 批准成立文化大革命工作组以指导运动。
description.en: Approved the establishment of Cultural Revolution work groups to guide the movement.

description.zh-cn: 批准成立文化大革命工作组以指导运动。
description.en: Approved the establishment of Cultural Revolution work groups to guide the movement.

description.zh-cn: 在一次大会上点名批评宋任穷，导致宋家失势。
description.en: Publicly criticized Song Renqiong at a large meeting, leading to the Song family's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 批评宋彬彬去武汉保湖北省委的行为，导致宋彬彬和其母亲被软禁于沈阳。
description.en: Criticized Song Binbin for going to Wuhan to support the Hubei Provincial Party Committee, which led to Song Binbin and her mother being placed under house arrest in Shenyang.

description.zh-cn: 作为工农兵学员就读。
description.en: Studied as a Worker-Peasant-Soldier student.

description.zh-cn: 作为卞仲耘的丈夫，王晶垚发表声明，拒绝接受宋彬彬的道歉，并称其虚伪。
description.en: As the husband of Bian Zhongyun, Wang Jingyao issued a statement rejecting Song Binbin's apology, calling it insincere.

description.zh-cn: 发表文章，首次将卞仲耘之死与宋彬彬联系起来，并指其为导致卞仲耘死亡的暴力事件的负责人。
description.en: Published articles that first linked the death of Bian Zhongyun to Song Binbin, identifying her as the person in charge of the violent event that led to Bian's death.

description.zh-cn: 在文革初期共同担任北京师大女附中革命师生代表会及文化革命筹备委员会的领导人。
description.en: Served together as leaders of the Revolutionary Teachers and Students Representative Council and the Cultural Revolution Preparatory Committee at the Beijing Normal University Affiliated Girls' Middle School in the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 徐榛蔚是傅兆林的儿媳。
description.en: Hsu Chen-wei is Fu Zhaolin's daughter-in-law.

position.zh-cn: 重机械工程大队队员、工程司、副工程司、正工程司
position.en: Member of Heavy Machinery Engineering Brigade, Engineer, Deputy Engineer, Senior Engineer

description.zh-cn: 18岁时经公务人员普考分发至台湾省政府建设厅，曾担任中部六县市美援自来水供水系统兴建工程督导。
description.en: At the age of 18, he was assigned to the Department of Construction of the Taiwan Provincial Government after passing the civil service examination. He served as the construction supervisor for the US-aided water supply system in six central counties and cities.

description.zh-cn: 傅兆林在就读高雄中学时亲身经历二二八事件中的高雄镇压。
description.en: Fu Zhaolin personally experienced the Kaohsiung suppression during the February 28 Incident while studying at Kaohsiung Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年亚洲金融风暴期间，为保持公司股价，傅兆林私自贷款给子公司，此举违反公司法并导致其后来被判刑。
description.en: During the 1997 Asian financial crisis, to maintain his company's stock price, Fu Zhaolin privately lent money to a subsidiary, which violated company law and led to his subsequent conviction.

description.zh-cn: 担任台湾省政府住宅及都市发展局东区工程处长期间，主导花莲县的重大基础建设。
description.en: While serving as the Director of the Eastern District Engineering Office of the Housing and Urban Development Bureau of the Taiwan Provincial Government, he led major infrastructure projects in Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 担任台湾省政府住宅及都市发展局东区工程处长期间，主导台东县的重大基础建设。
description.en: While serving as the Director of the Eastern District Engineering Office of the Housing and Urban Development Bureau of the Taiwan Provincial Government, he led major infrastructure projects in Taitung County.

description.zh-cn: 冯君衡是高力士（本名冯元一）的生父。
高力士被宦官高延福收为养子。
高力士幼年入宫，受到武则天赏识，并被其赐姓高。
高力士追随李隆基发动唐隆政变，拥立唐睿宗复辟。
唐肃宗即位后，高力士在朝中任职，但不久后因得罪当权宦官李辅国而被贬谪。
追随李隆基发动唐隆政变，杀死韦皇后与安乐公主。
在唐隆政变中被杀死。
李辅国弄权，因高力士当众呵斥其对太上皇玄宗不敬而怀恨在心，将其弹劾流放至巫州。
高力士为维护唐玄宗，当众呵斥弄权的李辅国，因此被其记恨并弹劾流放。
唐玄宗驾崩的消息传到正被赦免回京途中的高力士耳中，他哀痛欲绝，最终吐血而亡。
追念高力士侍奉玄宗有功，追赠其为扬州大都督，并允许其陪葬泰陵。
高力士曾清楚地预见安禄山将要造反的隐患，并提醒唐玄宗，但未被采纳。
据《酉阳杂俎》记载，高力士因被李白要求为其脱靴而怀恨在心，后向杨贵妃进谗言导致李白被赐金放还，但此事的真实性存疑。
安史之乱爆发后，高力士随唐玄宗逃往蜀地。
夏宝龙担任中共中央港澳工作办公室主任。
description.en: Xia Baolong serves as the Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙兼任国务院港澳事务办公室主任。
description.en: Xia Baolong concurrently serves as the Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任第十三届全国政协副主席（2018年3月14日至2023年3月10日），并兼任秘书长（2018年3月14日至2020年5月19日）。
description.en: Xia Baolong served as the Vice Chairman of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC (March 14, 2018 - March 10, 2023), and concurrently as its Secretary-General (March 14, 2018 - May 19, 2020).

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任中共浙江省委书记。
description.en: Xia Baolong served as the Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任浙江省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Xia Baolong served as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙于2011年8月任浙江省代省长，2012年1月正式当选为省长。
description.en: Xia Baolong became the Acting Governor of Zhejiang in August 2011 and was officially elected Governor in January 2012.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任中央港澳工作领导小组常务副组长。
description.en: Xia Baolong serves as the Executive Deputy Head of the Central Leading Group on Hong Kong and Macao Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙于1973年11月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Xia Baolong joined the Communist Party of China in November 1973.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京大学经济学院政治经济学专业在职研究生学习，获得经济学博士学位。
description.en: Xia Baolong studied in the Political Economy major at the School of Economics, Peking University, as an on-the-job postgraduate student, and obtained a Doctor of Economics degree.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京大学攻读博士学位期间的导师为吴树青。
description.en: Wu Shuqing was Xia Baolong's advisor during his doctoral studies at Peking University.

position.en: Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CPC

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在担任中共浙江省委副书记期间，是时任省委书记习近平的副手。
description.en: When Xia Baolong served as Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, he was the deputy to then-Provincial Party Secretary Xi Jinping.

position.zh-cn: 全国政协副主席、秘书长
position.en: Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在担任全国政协副主席和秘书长期间，主席是汪洋。
description.en: While Xia Baolong served as Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee, the Chairman was Wang Yang.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任浙江省省长期间，省委书记是赵洪祝。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Governor of Zhejiang, the Provincial Party Secretary was Zhao Hongzhu.

position.zh-cn: 国务院港澳事务办公室主任
position.en: Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任国务院港澳事务办公室主任期间，国务院总理是李克强。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, the Premier was Li Keqiang.

position.zh-cn: 国务院港澳事务办公室主任
position.en: Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任国务院港澳事务办公室主任期间，国务院总理是李强。
description.en: While Xia Baolong is Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, the Premier is Li Qiang.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任
position.en: Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 周霁是中共中央港澳工作办公室主任夏宝龙的副手。
description.en: Zhou Ji is a deputy to Xia Baolong, Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

position.zh-cn: 中共浙江省委副书记、省长
position.en: Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CPC, Governor

description.zh-cn: 在夏宝龙担任浙江省委书记期间，车俊接替李强担任省委副书记、省长。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, Che Jun succeeded Li Qiang as Deputy Secretary and Governor.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任浙江省省长期间，龚正任常务副省长。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Governor of Zhejiang, Gong Zheng served as Executive Vice Governor.

position.zh-cn: 国务院港澳事务办公室副主任（正部长级）
position.en: Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council (Ministerial Level)

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙接任国务院港澳事务办公室主任后，原主任张晓明改任为副主任。
description.en: After Xia Baolong took over as Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, the former director Zhang Xiaoming was reassigned as Deputy Director.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在宁波会见了马来西亚前首相马哈迪·莫哈末一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad and his delegation in Ningbo.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在杭州会见了马来西亚最高元首端姑阿都哈林一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with the Supreme Head of State of Malaysia, Tuanku Abdul Halim, and his delegation in Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在杭州会见了来访的苏丹总统巴希尔一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with the visiting Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir and his delegation in Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在深圳主持座谈会，会见了香港特区行政长官李家超。
description.en: Xia Baolong chaired a symposium in Shenzhen and met with Hong Kong SAR Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港机场管理局主席林天福一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Fred Lam Tin-fuk, Chairman of the Airport Authority Hong Kong, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港特区政府律政司司长林定国一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Paul Lam Ting-kwok, Secretary for Justice of the HKSAR Government, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港特区政府环境及生态局局长谢展寰一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Tse Chin-wan, Secretary for Environment and Ecology of the HKSAR Government, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港特区政府财政司司长陈茂波一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Paul Chan Mo-po, Financial Secretary of the HKSAR Government, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在此期间会见了香港特区政府律政司副司长张国钧。
description.en: During this period, Xia Baolong met with Horace Cheung Kwok-kwan, Deputy Secretary for Justice of the HKSAR Government.

description.zh-cn: 在2019年反对逃犯条例修订草案运动后，夏宝龙于2020年2月13日被任命兼任国务院港澳事务办公室主任，以应对香港局势。
description.en: Following the 2019 Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement, Xia Baolong was appointed to concurrently serve as Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council on February 13, 2020, to handle the situation in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙将“反修例运动”定性为“颜色革命”和“黑暴”，并做出强硬表态准备出手抗击，体现其反对立场。
description.en: Xia Baolong labeled the 'Anti-Extradition Law Movement' as a 'color revolution' and 'black violence,' and made a tough stance to prepare for a counterattack, reflecting his opposition.

description.zh-cn: 因被指“损害香港自治”，夏宝龙被美国财政部依据《香港自治法》制裁。
description.en: Xia Baolong was sanctioned by the U.S. Department of the Treasury under the Hong Kong Autonomy Act for 'undermining Hong Kong's autonomy'.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部依据《香港自治法》对夏宝龙等官员实施制裁。
description.en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury imposed sanctions on officials including Xia Baolong based on the Hong Kong Autonomy Act.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在讲话中表示，游行不是表达诉求的唯一方式，且容易被骑劫，诱发社会对抗，不鼓励此种行为。
description.en: In a speech, Xia Baolong stated that protest marches are not the only way to express demands and can be easily hijacked, leading to social confrontation, thereby discouraging such activities.

description.zh-cn: 在全民国家安全教育日致辞中，夏宝龙回应并反驳了美国副总统万斯的“乡巴佬”言论。
description.en: In his speech on National Security Education Day, Xia Baolong responded to and refuted the 'hillbilly' remarks made by U.S. Vice President J. D. Vance.

description.zh-cn: 大学士孙承宗巡视辽东后，采纳了袁崇焕在宁远设防的意见，并在此后镇守山海关时更加倚重袁崇焕，视其为防御后金的关键人物。
description.en: After inspecting Liaodong, Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong adopted Yuan Chonghuan's proposal to fortify Ningyuan. He subsequently relied heavily on Yuan while defending Shanhai Pass, viewing him as a key figure in the defense against the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 后金大汗努尔哈赤亲率大军进攻宁远，发动了宁远之战。
description.en: The Later Jin khan Nurhaci personally led a large army to attack Ningyuan, initiating the Battle of Ningyuan.

description.zh-cn: 袁崇焕在宁远之战和宁锦之战中，两次成功指挥明军击败后金的进攻。
description.en: Yuan Chonghuan successfully commanded the Ming forces to defeat the Later Jin invasions twice, in the Battle of Ningyuan and the Battle of Ningjin.

description.zh-cn: 袁崇焕是关宁锦防线的主要构筑者和执行者，他主持修筑了宁远、锦州等重镇，形成了抵御后金的坚固防线。
description.en: Yuan Chonghuan was the main architect and implementer of the Guan-Ning-Jin Defense Line. He oversaw the construction of key fortresses like Ningyuan and Jinzhou, forming a solid defensive barrier against the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝即位后，清除魏忠贤党羽，随即任命袁崇焕为兵部尚书兼蓟辽督师，并赐予尚方宝剑，委托其处理辽东事务。
description.en: After ascending the throne and purging the faction of Wei Zhongxian, the Chongzhen Emperor appointed Yuan Chonghuan as Minister of War and Viceroy of Jiliao, granting him an imperial sword and entrusting him with the affairs of Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 袁崇焕以毛文龙骄横跋扈、虚报兵饷、不受节制等十二条罪状，用尚方宝剑将其在皮岛斩杀。
description.en: Yuan Chonghuan executed Mao Wenlong on Pi Island with an imperial sword, citing twelve crimes including arrogance, insubordination, and fraudulent reporting of military strength and expenses.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极亲自率领后金军队，绕道蒙古地区，突破长城喜峰口，发动了己巳之变，兵临北京城下。
description.en: Hong Taiji personally led the Later Jin army to bypass the Ming defenses via Mongolia, broke through the Great Wall at Xifengkou, and launched the Jisi Incident, bringing his forces to the gates of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 己巳之变中，袁崇焕虽千里驰援，但京城被围，朝野怨谤纷起，加上后金的反间计，最终导致崇祯帝将其逮捕并处死。
description.en: During the Jisi Incident, although Yuan Chonghuan rushed to defend the capital, the siege of Beijing led to widespread blame and slander at court. This, combined with a Later Jin deception stratagem, resulted in his arrest and execution by the Chongzhen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 后金在己巳之变期间使用反间计，故意让被俘的明朝宦官听到袁崇焕与后金有密约的假消息并放其逃回，成功使崇祯帝对袁崇焕产生怀疑。
description.en: During the Jisi Incident, the Later Jin employed a deception stratagem by allowing captured Ming eunuchs to 'overhear' false information about a secret pact between Yuan Chonghuan and the Later Jin before releasing them. This successfully sowed suspicion in the mind of the Chongzhen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 受反间计和朝臣诬陷影响，崇祯帝于1629年12月将袁崇焕下狱，并于次年9月以“通虏谋叛”等罪名将其凌迟处死。
description.en: Influenced by the deception stratagem and slander from court officials, the Chongzhen Emperor imprisoned Yuan Chonghuan in December 1629 and had him executed by lingchi in September of the following year on charges including treasonous collusion with the enemy.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆皇帝下诏为袁崇焕平反，肯定他“尚能忠于所事”，认为其罹难是因“主暗政昏”，深表悯恻。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor issued an edict posthumously rehabilitating Yuan Chonghuan, affirming that he was 'loyal to his duty' and attributing his tragic fate to a 'dim-witted and muddle-headed ruler,' expressing deep sympathy.

description.zh-cn: 宁锦之战后，魏忠贤党羽以袁崇焕不救锦州为由进行弹劾，导致袁崇焕被迫请求辞官归乡。
description.en: After the Battle of Ningjin, allies of Wei Zhongxian impeached Yuan Chonghuan on the grounds of failing to relieve Jinzhou, forcing Yuan to request retirement from his post.

description.zh-cn: 在位期间，明熹宗采纳朝臣建议，提拔袁崇焕至兵部任职，并在宁远之战后多次予以升迁和嘉奖，支持其在辽东的军事活动。
description.en: During his reign, the Tianqi Emperor adopted the advice of his officials to promote Yuan Chonghuan to a position in the Ministry of War. Following the Battle of Ningyuan, he repeatedly promoted and rewarded Yuan, supporting his military activities in Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 祖大寿是袁崇焕麾下的重要将领，长期跟随其镇守辽东，是关宁军的核心人物。
description.en: Zu Dashou was a key general under Yuan Chonghuan's command and a core figure of the Guanning Army, having long followed him in defending Liaodong.

position.zh-cn: 普鲁士王国首相, 北德意志邦联首相, 德意志帝国首相
position.en: Minister President of Prussia, Chancellor of the North German Confederation, Chancellor of the German Empire

description.zh-cn: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦长期担任普鲁士及统一后的德国的政府首脑。
description.en: Otto von Bismarck served for a long time as the head of government of Prussia and later the unified Germany.

description.zh-cn: 在威廉一世担任普鲁士国王和德意志皇帝期间，被其任命为首相，两人形成了十分特别的牢固关系。
description.en: During Wilhelm I's reign as King of Prussia and German Emperor, Bismarck was appointed as his Minister President, and the two formed a particularly strong bond.

description.zh-cn: 在腓特烈三世短暂的99天统治期间，俾斯麦继续担任首相。
description.en: During Frederick III's brief 99-day reign, Bismarck continued to serve as Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 在威廉二世执政初期担任首相，后因分歧被其解职。
description.en: Served as Chancellor during the early years of Wilhelm II's reign, but was later dismissed due to disagreements.

description.zh-cn: 因政策分歧和权力斗争，年少气盛的威廉二世解除了俾斯麦的首相职务，迫使其下野。
description.en: Due to policy disagreements and power struggles, the young and ambitious Wilhelm II dismissed Bismarck from his position as Chancellor, forcing him into retirement.

description.zh-cn: 列奥·冯·卡普里维接替俾斯麦担任德意志帝国首相。
description.en: Leo von Caprivi succeeded Bismarck as Chancellor of the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 通过三场统一战争（普丹、普奥、普法战争），主导并完成了德意志的统一。
description.en: Orchestrated and completed the unification of Germany through three wars of unification (Second Schleswig, Austro-Prussian, and Franco-Prussian).

description.zh-cn: 就石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因问题制造与丹麦的争端，并联合奥地利发动战争。
description.en: Created a dispute with Denmark over Schleswig and Holstein and launched a war in alliance with Austria.

description.zh-cn: 在普丹战争中与奥地利联合击败丹麦，逼使其放弃石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因。
description.en: In the Second Schleswig War, allied with Austria to defeat Denmark, forcing it to cede Schleswig and Holstein.

description.zh-cn: 为将奥地利排除出德意志邦联，通过外交手段孤立奥地利后，策划并发动了普奥战争。
description.en: To exclude Austria from the German Confederation, he diplomatically isolated Austria and then planned and initiated the Austro-Prussian War.

description.zh-cn: 在普奥战争中击败奥地利，将其势力逐出德意志邦联，为德国统一铺平了道路。
description.en: Defeated Austria in the Austro-Prussian War, expelling its influence from the German Confederation and paving the way for German unification.

description.zh-cn: 以西班牙王位继承问题制造争端，逼使法国对普鲁士宣战，以团结德意志民族，完成统一大业。
description.en: Used the Spanish succession issue to provoke a dispute, compelling France to declare war on Prussia, thereby uniting the German nation to complete the unification.

description.zh-cn: 在普法战争中击败法国，促成德国统一，并夺取阿尔萨斯和洛林。
description.en: Defeated France in the Franco-Prussian War, leading to German unification and the annexation of Alsace-Lorraine.

description.zh-cn: 在色当会战中战胜法军，导致拿破仑三世投降。
description.en: Defeated the French army at the Battle of Sedan, leading to the surrender of Napoleon III.

description.zh-cn: 普法战争的胜利直接促成了德意志帝国的成立。
description.en: The victory in the Franco-Prussian War directly led to the proclamation of the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 与意大利签订攻守同盟条约，在普奥战争中共同对奥地利作战。
description.en: Signed an offensive and defensive alliance treaty with Italy to fight together against Austria in the Austro-Prussian War.

description.zh-cn: 为孤立法国，与奥匈帝国、俄罗斯帝国缔结“三帝同盟”。
description.en: To isolate France, he formed the 'League of the Three Emperors' with Austria-Hungary and the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 在俄国退出三帝同盟后，随即与奥匈帝国重订盟约，建立德奥同盟。
description.en: After Russia's withdrawal from the League of the Three Emperors, he promptly renegotiated an alliance with Austria-Hungary, establishing the Dual Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 在俄土战争后主持柏林会议，协调欧洲大国纷争，自称“诚实经纪人”。
description.en: After the Russo-Turkish War, he presided over the Congress of Berlin to mediate disputes among European great powers, calling himself an 'honest broker'.

description.zh-cn: 柏林会议的结果使俄国在巴尔干地区的扩张受阻，成为大输家，导致德俄关系恶化。
description.en: The outcome of the Congress of Berlin thwarted Russia's expansion in the Balkans, making it a major loser and causing a deterioration in German-Russian relations.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是卡尔·路德维希大公的长子。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was the eldest son of Archduke Karl Ludwig.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是玛丽亚·安农齐亚塔的儿子。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was the son of Maria Annunciata.

description.zh-cn: 于1900年与霍恩贝格女公爵苏菲结婚。
description.en: Married Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg in 1900.

description.zh-cn: 马克西米利安是弗朗茨·斐迪南的儿子。
description.en: Maximilian was the son of Franz Ferdinand.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是弗兰茨·约瑟夫一世皇帝的侄子。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was the nephew of Emperor Franz Joseph I.

description.zh-cn: 自1896年起担任奥匈帝国皇储，直至1914年遇刺身亡。
description.en: Served as the Crown Prince of Austria-Hungary from 1896 until his assassination in 1914.

position.zh-cn: 中尉、上尉、上校、少将、总司令
position.en: Lieutenant, Captain, Colonel, Major General, Inspector General

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南14岁时加入奥匈陆军，并逐步晋升，最终成为军队总司令。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand joined the Austro-Hungarian Army at age 14, was progressively promoted, and eventually became its Inspector General.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是哈布斯堡-洛林王朝的成员。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was a member of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫皇太子在梅耶林惨案中自杀，使得弗朗茨·斐迪南成为奥匈帝国的皇位继承人。
description.en: The suicide of Crown Prince Rudolf in the Mayerling incident made Franz Ferdinand the heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne.

description.zh-cn: 普林齐普在萨拉热窝刺杀了弗朗茨·斐迪南。
description.en: Princip assassinated Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo.

description.zh-cn: 普林齐普在萨拉热窝刺杀了弗朗茨·斐迪南的妻子苏菲。
description.en: Princip assassinated Sophie, the wife of Franz Ferdinand, in Sarajevo.

description.zh-cn: 普林齐普的刺杀行为直接引发了萨拉热窝事件。
description.en: Princip's assassination directly caused the Sarajevo incident.

description.zh-cn: 萨拉热窝事件是第一次世界大战的导火线。
description.en: The Sarajevo incident was the catalyst for World War I.

description.zh-cn: 由于其父母的婚姻属于贵贱通婚，马克西米利安·霍恩贝格没有皇位继承权。
description.en: Due to his parents' morganatic marriage, Maximilian, Duke of Hohenberg had no succession rights to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南遇刺后，卡尔一世成为皇位继承人。
description.en: After Franz Ferdinand's assassination, Charles I became the heir to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通出身于萨摩藩下级藩士家庭，并以萨摩藩士的身份效命。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi was from a lower-ranking samurai family of the Satsuma Domain and served as a Satsuma samurai.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通是萨摩藩实际领导人岛津久光的心腹。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi was a trusted confidant of Shimazu Hisamitsu, the de facto leader of the Satsuma Domain.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通对推动明治维新做出了巨大贡献。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi made significant contributions to advancing the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 早期与西乡隆盛同为萨摩藩士，共同致力于推翻幕府和推动明治维新。
description.en: Early in his career, he worked alongside Saigō Takamori as fellow Satsuma samurai, dedicated to overthrowing the shogunate and promoting the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 因征韩论问题与西乡隆盛发生政治对立，最终在西南战争中成为敌对双方。
description.en: He became politically opposed to Saigō Takamori over the Seikanron debate, eventually becoming adversaries during the Satsuma Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 与木户孝允、西乡隆盛并称“维新三杰”，共同推动明治维新。
description.en: Along with Kido Takayoshi and Saigō Takamori, he was known as one of the 'Three Great Nobles of the Restoration,' working together to advance the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 1871年，大久保利通与木户孝允等人一同参加岩仓使节团，出使欧洲及美国。
description.en: In 1871, Ōkubo Toshimichi, along with Kido Takayoshi and others, joined the Iwakura Mission to Europe and the United States.

description.zh-cn: 西乡隆盛是征韩论的主要倡导者。
description.en: Saigō Takamori was a leading proponent of the Seikanron (Debate on Conquering Korea).

description.zh-cn: 围绕征韩论的辩论最终演变为“明治六年政变”，导致武断派参议辞职。
description.en: The debate over the Seikanron culminated in the 'Meiji-roku no Seihen,' leading to the resignation of the war-faction councillors.

description.zh-cn: 在政变中，征韩论被否决，西乡隆盛辞去参议等职务下野。
description.en: During the political crisis, the Seikanron was rejected, and Saigō Takamori resigned from his positions, including that of Councillor.

description.zh-cn: 西南战争以政府军胜利告终，西乡隆盛在战斗中身亡。
description.en: The Satsuma Rebellion ended in victory for the government forces, and Saigō Takamori died in battle.

description.zh-cn: 岛田一郎率领六名刺客在纪尾井坂发动了对大久保利通的暗杀。
description.en: Shimada Ichirō led six assassins in carrying out the assassination of Ōkubo Toshimichi at Kioizaka.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通在纪尾井坂之变中被暗杀身亡。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi was assassinated in the Kioizaka Incident.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通作为全权大臣前往中国就牡丹社事件进行交涉，最终促成《北京专约》的签订。
description.en: As plenipotentiary minister, Ōkubo Toshimichi went to China to negotiate over the Mudan Incident, ultimately leading to the signing of the Sino-Japanese Treaty of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 日本将《北京专约》中“保民义举”的措辞解释为清廷承认琉球为日本属地，并随后进行了琉球处分。
description.en: Japan interpreted the phrase 'a just undertaking to protect our people' in the treaty as the Qing court's recognition of Ryukyu as a Japanese territory, and subsequently carried out the Ryukyu Disposition.

description.zh-cn: 就读于联合国译员培训班。
description.en: Studied at the UN Interpreter Training Program.

description.zh-cn: 在外交部翻译室工作期间，曾为邓小平等国家领导人担任翻译。
description.en: While working at the Department of Translation and Interpretation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, he served as an interpreter for state leaders such as Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 张维为提出中国是一个“文明型国家”的概念。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei proposed the concept that China is a 'civilizational state'.

description.zh-cn: 张维为在英国学者马丁·雅克的基础上，提出了中国是一个“文明型国家”的概念。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei proposed the concept of China as a 'civilizational state' based on the work of British scholar Martin Jacques.

description.zh-cn: 张维为在中共中央政治局第三十次集体学习上，就“加强中国国际传播能力建设”主题进行讲解。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei gave a lecture on 'strengthening China's international communication capabilities' at the 30th collective study session of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张维为与弗朗西斯·福山在上海就“中国模式”进行辩论，反对其提出的“历史终结论”。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei debated with Francis Fukuyama in Shanghai on the 'China model', opposing his 'End of History' thesis.

description.zh-cn: 张维为在与福山的辩论中称“历史终结论”已经终结，并持续批判该理论。
description.en: In his debate with Fukuyama, Zhang Weiwei claimed that the 'End of History thesis' has itself ended, and has continued to criticize the theory.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗西斯·福山是“历史终结论”的提出者。
description.en: Francis Fukuyama is the originator of the 'End of History' thesis.

description.zh-cn: 在与福山的辩论中，张维为对阿拉伯之春持悲观态度，并反对其可能在中国发生的观点。
description.en: In his debate with Fukuyama, Zhang Weiwei expressed pessimism about the Arab Spring and opposed the idea that it could happen in China.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗西斯·福山预言中国也会出现类似阿拉伯之春的革命。
description.en: Francis Fukuyama predicted that a revolution similar to the Arab Spring would also occur in China.

description.zh-cn: 张维为认为类似阿拉伯之春的革命在中国绝无可能发生。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei argued that a revolution similar to the Arab Spring was absolutely impossible in China.

description.zh-cn: 张小圃于1947年在江苏南通遭国民党还乡团杀害。
description.en: Zhang Xiaopu was killed by the Kuomintang Homecoming Corps in Nantong, Jiangsu in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 冯玮公开质疑张维为的学术资质，称其曾任职的日内瓦外交与国际关系学院是“野鸡大学”。
description.en: Feng Wei publicly questioned Zhang Weiwei's academic credentials, calling the Geneva School of Diplomacy and International Relations where he worked a 'diploma mill'.

description.zh-cn: 相蓝欣撰文批评张维为对“洋教授”头衔的看法，并认为张所鼓吹的中国模式优越论十分荒谬。
description.en: Xiang Lanxin wrote articles criticizing Zhang Weiwei's views on 'foreign professor' titles and considered Zhang's advocacy for the superiority of the China model to be absurd.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南是蒋介石的心腹之一，深受其器重与信任。
description.en: Hu Zongnan was one of Chiang Kai-shek's confidants and was highly valued and trusted by him.

description.zh-cn: 因胡宗南身高不足，经时任军校党代表廖仲恺特许被录取。
description.en: Due to Hu Zongnan's insufficient height, he was admitted to the military academy with special permission from Liao Zhongkai, the party representative at the time.

description.zh-cn: 参与组织力行社。
description.en: Participated in the organization of the Lixing Society.

description.zh-cn: 参与组织复兴社。
description.en: Participated in the organization of the Fuxing Society.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共间谍，将胡宗南的军事行动计划泄露给中共方面，导致国军多次作战失利。
description.en: As a CCP spy, he leaked Hu Zongnan's military operational plans to the CCP, leading to several operational failures for the Nationalist army.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南晚年曾感慨称周恩来是其“政治克星”。
description.en: In his later years, Hu Zongnan lamented that Zhou Enlai was his 'political nemesis'.

description.zh-cn: 在胡宗南遭监察院弹劾后，蒋介石出面庇护，使其未被交付军法会审。
description.en: After Hu Zongnan was impeached by the Control Yuan, Chiang Kai-shek protected him, preventing him from facing a court-martial.

description.zh-cn: 介绍其学生叶霞翟与胡宗南相识，促成两人婚事。
description.en: Introduced his student Ye Xiazhai to Hu Zongnan, which led to their marriage.

description.zh-cn: 两人曾在西安相处多年，交往甚密。
description.en: The two spent many years together in Xi'an and had a very close relationship.

description.zh-cn: 在宜川战役中阵亡。
description.en: Killed in action during the Yichuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在宜川战役中阵亡。
description.en: Killed in action during the Yichuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战后期，胡宗南指挥的部队屡战失利，最终全军覆没。
description.en: In the later stages of the Second Chinese Civil War, the troops commanded by Hu Zongnan suffered repeated defeats and were eventually annihilated.
